title: Classroom of the Elite: Year 3
synopsis:
RISE TOGETHER OR FALL APART

Now recognized as the leader of Class C, Ayanokouji works on deepening his relationships with his new classmates. Meanwhile, a mysterious new exam is announced, and the only scraps of information the students are given are: “a new exam will begin starting tomorrow” and “details will be announced in a week.” Without a clue to work off of, Class C immediately starts brainstorming what the exam might entail and how to tackle it. Class A, on the other hand, can’t seem to get back on track following the damage dealt to them at the start of the term. Can Horikita work together with Karuizawa, Kushida, and Ibuki to unite their classmates and dominate in the upcoming exam, or will their place as Class A slip from their grasp?

title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
synopsis:
A GRAND FINALE!

The great Fuuga’s reign has come to an end, and the world of the south has been reorganized with King Souma at its center. As peace settles across the southern hemisphere, the world of the north enters a new era of excitement and adventure. The lives of Souma and the others who laid the foundation for this new age are now filled with joy and unexpected surprises! Yet Souma, the man who gained a family after being summoned to another world, has one lingering regret… What could it be? The revolutionary isekai fantasy series reaches its bold and heartwarming conclusion in this twentieth volume—packed with happiness, fulfillment, and the rewards of a life well lived!

FINAL VOLUME

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
synopsis:
After being banished from her home country, Nia’s new life has begun in the Mech Kingdom of Marvelia. As the land known for its coldness to foreigners, she had not anticipated a warm welcome, but when her first month ends with her home being destroyed in a night attack, she finds the royal family at her doorstep with an unreasonable request: pretend none of it ever happened.

With much reluctance, Nia acquiesces and agrees to follow their narrative—only to find herself faced with all of her belongings taken and a bill for repairs for the whole area in her name. In the midst of feeling humiliation the likes of which she has never experienced in this life, Shylrane confides in her the truth of a secret threat to Marvelia which necessitated the development of the mech knights. It is here that Nia sees an opportunity in more ways than one.

It’s time to take the kid gloves off! If Marvelia wants her to pay, the Merciless Maiden will do just that—and far, far more!

title: Royal Spirits Are a Royal Pain! Give Me a Regular Romance
synopsis:
At the academy, wintry weather persists, but for some of Deirdre’s friends, spring may have come early... Oblivious as she can be, even Deirdre senses that love is in the air. She’s prepared to support all her friends’ love lives—even if that means forcing some of them to take an interest in romance in the first place! Now that only two candidates for crown princess remain, will Deirdre’s master plan to bring smiles to all their faces succeed?

And what about Deirdre’s own romantic ambitions? On paper, she’s the most eligible bachelorette in the entire empire. In reality, her unique status as the fairy princess—and her equally “unique” personality—make it next to impossible for anyone to approach her... And her overprotective family isn’t making things any easier!

Fortunately for Deirdre, the upcoming celebrations for the crown prince’s coming-of-age may be just the opportunity she needs. Could it finally be Deirdre’s turn to get lucky in love...?

title: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
synopsis:
LET THE FESTIVITIES BEGIN!

This year’s school festival has finally begun, and the maid café Melody and her friends have worked so hard on is a smashing success! And now that the festival is here, it’s also time for the Festival Ball…and a bit of romance, perhaps?

Though who knows if it’ll come to Melody, as she’s too busy with her side quests of crushing Schue in bowling, getting in hot water with Luciana for daring to attend the festivities with Lect, and dressing the imperial princess in her handmade uniforms—all while blissfully unaware of the fact she’s avoiding every major plot beat possible! But when darkness falls over the city and a monster appears, the time for distractions is over, and the magical mad maid Melody faces the crisis head-on. After all, it’s a maid’s duty to protect her lady!

title: Reborn as an Assassin's Apprentice
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

SCHEME, PERSEVERE, AND SEIZE ALL YOU CAN

Though our training grows harsher, I’ll do whatever it takes to survive my rebirth as an assassin apprentice. Just you wait! Using my unique skills and ability to think outside the box, I will drag my superior rivals down to my level. I will be no easy kill.

But my schemes to establish myself among my peers are interrupted by a competition: our cohort versus the ones preceding us—assassin candidates who have stood on the brink of death uncountable times. For the coming trials, to gain more strength, I’ll need to make decisions I can’t take back.

title: Revenge of the Soul Eater: Cast Out as a Weakling by My Sword Saint Father
synopsis: Sora and company’s adventures in the Catalan Desert aren’t over just yet! After battling the behemoth, Sora, Wisteria and the others head straight to the dark elf kingdom of Andora to take Gardr down once and for all. But when Gardr transforms into a terrible monster, Wisteria needs to master her Shinsou fast! Later, when Lunamaria’s Anima finally manifests, will Alarune’s brazen advances on Sora prove too shameless for the young elf to bear?

title: Invaders of the Rokujouma!?
synopsis:
With the newly rebuilt battleship Blue Knight at the head of his additional forces, Koutarou launches an attack on the enemy’s headquarters. However, that was just what the Gray Knight wanted! In the chaos of the massive battle, Kenji and Nalfa are kidnapped!

With his friends taken hostage, Koutarou is deeply depressed. But when everyone comes to his aid, he is dragged out of the darkness and uses this glimmer of hope to save his friends. Meanwhile, Kenji discovers the Gray Knight’s identity and is closing in on the truth!

title: Infinite Dendrogram SP
synopsis: In the year 2043, Infinite Dendrogram, the world's first successful full-dive VRMMO was released. In addition to its ability to perfectly simulate the five senses, along with its many other amazing features, the game promised to offer players a world full of infinite possibilities. Nearly two years later, soon-to-be college freshman, Reiji Mukudori, is finally able to buy a copy of the game and start playing. With some help from his experienced older brother, Shu, and his partner Embryo, Reiji embarks on an adventure into the world of Infinite Dendrogram. Just what will he discover and encounter in this game world known for its incredible realism and infinite possibilities?

title: Infinite Dendrogram SP
synopsis:
After an unexpectedly challenging journey, Ray and his party finally arrive at Gideon, The City of Duels.
The mere sight of the towering arenas and thriving fantasy townscapes is enough to instantly awe and enchant him. However — like anything that stands tall and proud — the city cast a great, dark shadow.
The name of this shadow is the Gouz-Maise gang — a loathsome band of cutthroats who turn their profit kidnapping children and demanding ransom.
Ray, wide-eyed and innocent, was blissfully unaware of just how cruel the hyper-realistic world of Infinite Dendrogram would become.

title: Making Magic: The Sweet Life of a Witch Who Knows an Infinite MP Loophole
synopsis: The stampede is over, and the souls lost outside space-time have been purified. After spending a year helping out at a refugee camp, Chise can finally head back home to the Wasteland of Nothingness (now renamed the Witch of Creation’s Forest). However, her respite is short-lived. Three thousand refugees of many different races move into the Forest all at once, so it’s only a matter of time before issues start to rear their ugly heads. Can Chise really keep the peace between all of her neighbors, new and old?

title: My Quiet Blacksmith Life in Another World
synopsis: Winter will soon descend upon the Black Forest, and Forge Eizo must prepare. Storing food and supplies, adding stoves to the cabin, sewing winter outerwear—their to-do list just keeps growing. Then, one day, a fire spirit appears at the cabin claiming to have been born from Eizo’s magical energy work in the forge! The family is excited to have this warm new addition to their household, but how does Lluisa feel about spirits encroaching on her forest? Meanwhile, Eizo receives a mysterious knife in the mail. Though the quality is poor, the form looks eerily similar to a Forge Eizo blade—the fake even has the fat cat insignia engraved on the pommel! Who would do such a thing? Can Eizo’s ironclad reputation withstand such slander, or will this riveting counterfeit ruin his business?

title: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
synopsis:
FIRST COMES LOVE, THEN COMES MARR—NOT SO FAST!!

Marie is now living a life she’s only ever dreamed of. Thanks to the love of Kyros, the richest man in the kingdom, she’s becoming stronger and more confident every day. And now that they’re engaged, the lovebirds are ready to get married.

But there’s just one hitch: They haven’t been granted permission! But why? Could it have something to do with the princess of the Dilts Kingdom, who wants Kyros for herself?

title: BLADE & BASTARD: Saga of the Unknown Adventurers
synopsis: As far as anyone in Scale knows, the dungeon is bottomless and unfathomable. Though Iarumas’s party delved deep to kill the jester demon Flack, their injuries required them to flee before they descended any farther. But what happens when the monstrosities that lurk below begin to rise? Strange parasitic beasts invade the upper levels of the dungeon, infesting the bodies of adventurers and then erupting from living tissue to claim more victims. This crisis is so great that even veterans like the All-Stars are missing in action. As the highest-ranking adventurers remaining on the surface, Iarumas and his companions are tasked with exterminating these beasts. However, the source of this malaise lies deeper than anyone has ever explored. With no map to guide them and no idea what horrors could lurk in the next burial chamber, can Scale’s adventurers navigate the abyss and purge the rot that threatens to consume everything?

title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
synopsis: Having been recognized for his achievements as the Vice Minister of Tourism, as well as his party’s victory against the demon lord, Satou and the girls receive medals of honor in the Shiga Kingdom! While making the most of their time in the capital, they’re able to reunite with Zena and the oracle priestess Sara, but they’re soon attacked by more red-rope monsters! Just as Satou steps in to dispatch them, they’re swiftly slain by the third prince Sharonik, wearing the Flue Empire relic known only as the Holy Husk Mobile Armor. But there seems to be more to this ancient armor than meets the eye…

title: Flung into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse!
synopsis:
Everything is finally looking up for Akira. He’s finally finished cleaning up the last of the apprentice’s messes, and he can now actually communicate with his many friends. While he’s definitely not bored (who knew taking care of kids could be so much work?), he’s looking forward to getting to know his new world without the constant threat of apocalypse— Wait, was that an earthquake?

With a new threat looming on the horizon, Akira will do whatever it takes to protect his family, even if it means turning to the power of darkness. But some weapons should never be wielded by human hands. Will he be able to save the forest—or will he bring about its destruction?

title: Four Child Life
synopsis: My name is Mifu Miyabi, and I live with my three identical sisters. We’re getting closer and closer every day, but we still butt heads sometimes. While we can usually count on our dependable older sister to lead us, she’s been acting strange lately. She’s rushing out of the house in a panic, staying out really late, and snapping at us… If she won’t tell us what’s going on with her, there’s only one thing we can do—put on our detective hats and trail her to solve this mystery!

title: I'm a Noble on the Brink of Ruin, So I Might as Well Try Mastering Magic
synopsis: Liam has had enough of the human nations picking fights with his country. It’s time to clean them all up in one fell swoop, and what better way to do that than to take over their land and hand them off to his trusted ally Sheila? Finally, the plan is set into motion. Sheila takes the first step of the conquest with one central theme in mind: Fear. With Liam accompanying her in the form of a fearsome magic sword, Sheila wields the power of the infamous Monster King to rampage across the battlefield and instill fear into their enemies’ hearts. Unfortunately for their foes, this is only the beginning of their long and arduous nightmare—even if, for Liam, this is just another chance to develop all sorts of new spells and magic.

title: Legend of the Far East's Savior
synopsis: Having turned the tide of battle in Kyushu piloting the prototype Mikage mech, Keita Kawakami is quickly rising through the ranks of the military. With this new reputation comes missions to safeguard Japan’s national security…or so he thinks. Instead, Keita receives an order from above to spearhead the development of a new powered exosuit model—a move that can only be the work of a rival faction that wants to see him sidelined. Little did they know this would lead to a battle that will announce the birth of a new hero to the world…

title: Lord of Mysteries
synopsis: Roaring past the glow of gas lamps, a colossal train charges into a realm of steam and mystery. On bustling train platforms that Detective Sherlock Moriarty walks with his head bowed. The past, present, and future are shrouded in secrecy. In the lamplight, a mere glimpse of the dark mausoleum is enough to make anyone tremble in fear. Here, maddened deities call out to Their progeny and danger...danger is coming…

title: Modern Villainess: It's Not Easy Building a Corporate Empire Before the Crash
synopsis:
RUNA TAKES THE SCHOOL BY STORM!

Keikain Runa is usually dealing with global turmoil and corporate catastrophes, but those high-stakes crises seem to have paused. Still, studying, social engagements, and even a side gig developing a makeup line are keeping her just as busy!

Her hectic academic life doesn’t stop Runa from ducking away when the occasion requires—for instance, when Teia Motor Co. needs trackside support at a big car race. But when the school festival rolls around, Runa needs to focus on helping her classmates pull off an event second to none.

The students decide to give the festival a boost by putting together a temporary maid café—a tricky project they’ll definitely need Runa’s help to pull off! But as she pursues so many projects, does Runa risk overlooking the signs that the wider world is growing turbulent again…?

title: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
synopsis: Reeling from the events of Royal Palace, Yuki comes face to face with another version of herself standing outside her apartment, a hallucination created from her extraordinary skills of perception. The encounter spurs memories of her first game, Maiden’s Race, where her younger and more foolish past self sailed to victory. But the other Yuki isn’t content with taking her on a trip down memory lane; she’s dead set on seizing control of Yuki’s body and relentlessly attacks her in pursuit of that end. Unable to strike back against her spectral foe, Yuki attempts to level the playing field by asking Rinrin to set up a mock game for her and her doppelganger to compete in: Snow Room. Yuki has overcome countless foes in her career as a death game player…but does she have any hope of defeating her very self?

title: She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man
synopsis:
INTRUDER ALERT!

Tasked by Queen Alma of Nirvana to protect the oracle, Mira ends up moving in with the girl. But the evil forces of Ira Muerte aren’t about to sit back and let the oracle keep hampering their criminal goals! When the very castle itself is infiltrated by a mysterious figure seeking to silence a captive before they can spill the beans, chaos ensues, and Mira must jump into action to neutralize the threat.

title: Spy Classroom
synopsis: Lamplight’s battle against world-class counterintelligence agent Nike has ended in disaster for them and their goal of starting a revolution in the Lylat Kingdom, with one member of the team now in custody. It’s unclear whether or not their teammates are safe, but the mission can’t end until the revolution is complete. Erna and her allies need serious backup, and they dedicate themselves to tracking down the mysterious LWS Troupe. But the loss to this invincible foe eats away at Erna’s resolve, and the path before her seems shrouded in darkness. But as despair closes in from all sides, Lamplight’s powerhouse makes her move.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School
synopsis: As Minoru and the parasites continue their infectious escapades, Tatsuya is hard at work on his typeless magic—the sealing orb. If perfected, it could be used to capture parasites in a single move. Meanwhile, the war between the Great Asian Alliance and the New Soviet Union comes to a head, and the Soviets begin moving to invade Japan. Mobilized to intercept them are Masaki Ichijou and Shinkurou Kichijouji. How will the two fare against their sworn enemies?! One after the other, strategic-class magicians converge on the Land of the Rising Sun!

title: The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess
synopsis: With the crisis in the Netherworld finally resolved, Komari comes home to her original world craving some serious rest and relaxation. But before she can go full shut-in mode, the Empress reminds her that, as a Crimson Lord, she must win a sports-war match every three months or be blown to smithereens. Salvation arrives in the form of Leona Flatt, who is hungry for a victory against the Seventh Unit, but can our hapless heroine survive the girl’s anti-Komari rules? Then it’s off to the Enchanted Lands, where the mysterious Smooch League is trying to set Komari up with Lingzi, which is then followed by an impromptu tour of the Foreworld to help little Pope Clenent DIV learn what it takes to be a leader. Amid all this hubbub, however, the Imperial Capital is rocked by a serial kidnapping spree, and the perpetrator has ties to a powerful new enemy…

title: To Sir, Without Love: I'm Divorcing You
synopsis: Byletta’s marriage to Lieutenant Colonel Arnald Swangan started as a purely political affair, one she never desired and once hoped to escape as soon as he returned from the war front. However, despite their tendency to butt heads, the two have come to share a deep, emotional bond—at least until the possibility of divorce arrives on their doorstep again. Between rumors, threats to House Swangan’s estate, and a troublesome prince from abroad, what will happen to the love of Byletta and Arnald?

title: Worthless at Home, Whiz to the World
synopsis:
At last, Noa has overcome the trials of his five sisters and secured the right to live as an adventurer. He accepts a job request for his rank advancement exam to defeat a golden dragon, but when he reaches the dragon town of Jiang, he discovers his client is none other than his fourth sister, Ciel!
He heads to the valley of dragons with Ciel to find the golden dragon, but instead they discover that a huge number of dragons have gathered. When he receives further information about a potential ceremony to revive the Dragon King, which would bring ruin to the land, he has to hurry to stop the rebirth!

title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
synopsis:
“INCREDIBLE! TODAY IS THE DAY SAINT HISTORY IS MADE!”

The day of the head saint selection is here, and it’s time for Fia to flex her saintly muscles! Of course, the first round is a breeze, and Fia gets the top score…and a lot of unwanted attention for it! Despite the pressure, Fia is ready for another demonstration of her talents: healing the legs of the ex-knight Maurice. It’s a piece of cake for Fia, but when she notices Priscilla’s strong desire to heal Maurice herself, Fia does the unexpected… Will Fia be the next head saint, or will her compassion cost her the role?

title: Chivalry of a Failed Knight
synopsis: After a tumultuous welcome, Ikki’s finally earned the respect of Vermillion’s people and is busy preparing for the upcoming “war” with Cradleland. He, Stella, and Lunaeyes visit Cradleland as part of those preparations, but little do they know that Puppet King Or Gol is scheming behind the scenes to transform the friendly competition between two allied nations into a genuine war! Ikki and Stella will have to work together to keep Vermillion from being engulfed in a sea of flames!

title: DUNGEON DIVE: Aim for the Deepest Level
synopsis:
My name is Liner Hellvilleshine, and I am the sworn knight of Sieg. After returning from a year in the Dungeon, I resumed my duties as a knight of Whoseyards, diligently carrying out a secret mission entrusted to me by Lastiara.
The objective: Recover the blood of Saint Tiara that was flowing within the Jewelculi. With that mission nearing completion, all that remained was to await the resurrection ritual.
But then, a person claiming to be Saint Tiara herself appeared before me, telling me to receive the blood into myself. She told me to aim for the deepest level of the Dungeon.
I stepped from the Eleventh Crossroads of Whoseyards and into something else entirely.

title: Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized!
synopsis:
NEW BONDS, OLD SCORES

Wim is a support caster and current member of the elite guild Nachtlibelle, and though he is still not fully used to his new surroundings, he starts to let his guard down and open up to his fellow guild members. After being behind the scenes for so long, maybe it’s not so bad being the center of attention after all!

The guild holds a grand Expedition Celebration to celebrate conquering a new floor, but rumors about his former guild Drachenflügel and its leader Chronos prove too big of a distraction for Wim to ignore. A whirlwind of events changes Wim’s fate, but will it all be for the better?

title: Predator Witches
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

With humanity on the brink of extinction due to the deadly Incubi invasion, only powerful magical girls can save the day—so long as they survive!

When the Incubi emerged, humanity was rocked to its core. These otherworldly monsters invaded the world and captured humans, using them for breeding purposes. Only the Witches, magical girls bestowed with powers from supernatural beings, stand a chance against the creatures. High schooler Renka Azuma happens to be one of them, and fights back as Silver Lotus, a witch who can control swarms of insects able to devour the Incubi. Her days are lonely but her mission is clear: destroy every last Incubi out there.

Things take a turn when Silver Lotus comes across a novice witch named Azure Nova, saving her from a close call. She’s surprised to learn that Azure is a self-proclaimed fan of hers and wants to work together! Suddenly, her dark, solitary days begin to grow a little brighter.

But the Witches have a responsibility to protect humanity so can they really afford to make friends and live like regular teenagers?

title: Private Tutor to the Duke's Daughter
synopsis: A lowborn boy with a gift for magic sets out to defy precedent and win a place in the prestigious Royal Academy. Its infamously challenging entrance exam forces him to team up with the daughter of one of the kingdom’s most powerful nobles in a meeting that will change both their lives forever. The aristocratic old guard scorns Allen for his humble origins, no matter how many times he proves himself as a sorcerer, and calls Lydia “cursed” because she can barely cast a spell, no matter how often she shows her skill with a sword. But as long as they support each other, they can be more than a match for anything the academy throws at them. Joined by a misfit princess and an enigmatic student from abroad, the pair take their first steps toward proving the world wrong. Meanwhile, whispers of a potent drug and a dragon-worshipping cult have the kingdom’s leaders on edge.

title: A Young Maiden's Growing Pains: I Reincarnated and All I Got Was This 100X Stat Buff!
synopsis:
Saving a cat-shaped plastic bag from certain death was not how Saki Osanai thought she’d go out. At least she’s got a wish out of it, and this time around, she won’t spend her life being looked down on—literally or figuratively. She’ll take a body that could knock any man off his feet.

The gods are happy to oblige.

Reborn as petite as ever, Saki—now called Satie—quickly learns her power lies not in the toweringly tall beauty she longed to have but instead in a stat buff that can take any enemy out. Worst of all, the god of the underworld warns she’s under a curse of eternal youth, one she’ll never be free of so long as she continues to repeat the mistakes of her past life.

If she wants to break the curse keeping her down (and short), she’ll need to put herself out there in a way she never dared try before. With a trusty hellhound to spoil, true love to find, and empires to conquer, this young maiden won’t let anyone stand in her way!

title: Father, Have You Sinned? An Assassin in Priest's Robes
synopsis:
Once feared as the kingdom’s legendary assassin, Zach “the Shadow” has abandoned his bloody past and now lives a quiet life as a priest of a rural church. There, he raises orphaned children and teaches them everything he knows: discipline, wisdom, and the combat skills to build a life outside the church walls.
When one of his beloved students—Emilia—returns with burdens she can’t conceal, Zach knows he can no longer hide and wait. Stealth and shadow are familiar aides as he begins a secret investigation into the troubles that haunt her. But while Father Zach may be content to fade back into the shadows, Emilia has other plans for the humble priest. She won’t stop until she drags him into the light—and reveals just how respected he should be!

title: Onmyoji and Tengu Eyes
synopsis:
Confronting Despair

After the possessed kagura mask escapes, the Abnormal Disaster Unit has no choice but to rely on ordinary citizens to resolve the case alongside the police and Akitakata City government. Never has the unit worked with so many nonspiritual people before, and disaster strikes when the demon lures one such person into its clutches… Yukiko.

“They shall know our pain. They shall know our resentment.”

Misato, Ryouji, and Takayuki bravely confront that embodiment of despair—which no one, not even Yukiko herself, had noticed simmering in her heart.

title: The Trials and Tribulations of My Next Life as a Noblewoman
synopsis:
“Karl and Wilhelmina have joined forces. There’s no turning back now.”

With the emperor and the imperial princess working together to keep Reinald off the throne, Karen has to teleport to the stronghold city of Estaverde to warn him. However, when the teleport spell goes astray, Karen ends up not in Reinald’s camp on the outskirts of the city, but in the middle of the city itself, where magic is prohibited and punishable by death. Worse yet, she’s teleported right at the feet of the clan chief in charge of the place!

The problems are mounting, and time is running out. The imperial capital is under the emperor’s control, the box’s sealing nears completion, and Reinald’s allies are being walled in and trapped with their leader away in a foreign land. With his window of opportunity closing, Reinald will have to move quickly and decisively to ensure himself a path to the imperial throne.

title: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon: My Trusted Companions Tried to Kill Me, But Thanks to the Gift of an Unlimited Gacha I Got LVL 9999 Friends and Am Out For Revenge on My Former Party Members and the World
synopsis:
Queen Lilith is throwing the grandest coronation ceremony the Human Kingdom has ever seen! The splashy festivities are designed not merely to celebrate her reign but also to crush the spirit of Clowe, the deposed crown prince who is confined to a tower prison.
Clowe hasn’t given up on reclaiming his throne, though, and he’s not the only one with designs on Lilith’s ceremony.
Cesta, a devious boy Master from the Dragonute Empire, has his own agenda—one involving explosives, chaos, and the downfall of the Wicked Witch of the Tower. Lilith has invited the Wicked Witch of the Tower to lend the festival an air of legitimacy, so when Cesta breaks Clowe out of prison and pulls him into Clowe’s scheme, a dangerous alliance is born.
Now Light and his companions, caught up in the celebrations, find themselves standing between a kingdom and a catastrophe. Can they unravel the conspiracy and stop the terroristic plot before the coronation literally goes up in flames?

title: Chronicles of an Aristocrat Reborn in Another World
synopsis:
IS CAIN ABLE?

When the God of Creation, Zenom, sends you on a journey to the Esfort Kingdom, you go. But running from school life to meeting the founder of the Esfort Kingdom—who reveals new information to Cain about his destiny—is no simple matter.

With the help of divine beasts Haku and Gin, Cain must take on a giant flood that threatens his hometown of Gracia, deal with an incident involving a fearsome new foe, and act as Lord over Drientl—a city plagued with problems. But will Cain’s reckless adventuring spell unending headaches for the King?

title: I'll Become an Elegant Villainess! Time to Enjoy My Second Life to the Fullest
synopsis:
Mitia Lumiol is set to be another selfish jerk of a noble, one among many who elevate only those with pure bloodlines and great magic. Then, suddenly, she remembers her past life—a lonely, stifled one where her only solace was books and the characters who broke ground where the corrupt stood.
Resolving to become just like her favorite villainess, Mitia targets the nobility who rule the land of Elmia with an iron fist. She’ll meet kindness with mercy and meet cruelty with ruthlessness. And she isn’t going to let anything get in her way—not nobles, not rioters, and certainly not the fact that she can only perform “worthless” household magic. 
Mitia will show them all what true evil is. And who knows? A cool, elegant villainess might be just what Elmia needs.

title: The Invincible Little Lady
synopsis: The series reaches its final arc! As Mary and her friends return from their adventure in Xeoral, they head to a certain barony to investigate an unusually long and heavy bout of rain that’s damaging the town and landscape. Determined to provide aid to the people, our heroine is however beaten to the punch by the Papacy’s “Dagian Holy Woman”—a character even more hellbent on being the people’s savior! Just who is this woman? And what’s the true cause of the suspiciously unnatural rain? As Mary delves further into danger, her beloved maid, Tutte, is kidnapped... As Tutte is living on a prayer, will her fate be up to the gods? Or will the invincible little lady defy even the Heavens?

title: The Ryuo's Work Is Never Done!
synopsis:
As the placement matches begin, Yaichi sees his chance to climb even higher in the Shogi world ranks. But while his own career surges forward beyond his expectations, his Master, Kousuke Kiyotaki, is staring down demotion and retirement. Now, Kiyotaki must come to terms with the decline in his skills and adapt to the younger generation’s playstyle or risk losing his long, hard-fought career.

Meanwhile, Ai Yashajin competes in the Mynavi Women’s Open. With research and the Shogi sense to back it up, she must prove that she’s earned her wings and can soar high above the competition...or come crashing down from her ascent.

title: The Ryuo's Work Is Never Done!
synopsis:
The reigning Yamashiro Ouka titleholder, Machi Kugui, earned her place by building elegant, defensive castles in Shogi. Ryou Tsukiyomizaka, the Challenger, intends to fly in and tear that stronghold apart. As their three-match showdown escalates, both players are forced to confront the limits of their main strategies...and then turn to unexpected sources of inspiration to win.

Watching their battle closely from the sidelines is Sasari Oga, a former Women’s League player who once dreamed of standing alongside Ryuo and Machi yet eventually chose to walk away. But as the two players she long admired refuse to give up, Sasari finds herself eager to retrace her steps and, maybe this time, find her own way forward.

title: The Ryuo's Work Is Never Done!
synopsis:
It’s the matchup of fairy tales: Ginko Sora, the undefeated Snow White and current Queen of Shogi, versus Ai Yashajin, the young Cinderella of the Women’s League! Both battle for the right to be called the Queen...and something neither is willing to put into words. But with their first match nearing its conclusion, a sudden rule violation changes their story’s course.

Behind the scenes, Yaichi faces his own battles: a grueling Crown League match against the Worldly Maestro and surprise romantic matchmaking coming at him in a pincer attack! Tougher still is the weight of being Master to both the current Queen and the challenger to her title. Breaking from precedent may be his only viable move, but what will the sacrifice cost him?

title: The Strange Adventure of a Broke Mercenary
synopsis:
THE MAD KING

The victorious army marches forward, only to encounter a town cloaked in eerie silence. In the enemy capital, Loren and his companions learn their foes are ruled by a mad king. Even better? The circumstances of his madness are somehow connected to the destruction of Loren’s former company. Now, Loren must face off against the man who started it all…

title: The Water Magician: Arc 1
synopsis:
Back in Lune, Ryo is trying to reclaim his cozy life when he receives a sudden summons from the guild master and learns that thousands of imperial troops have invaded the Kingdom of Knightley. What does Ryo do? Panic, of course! But not Abel, who knows that skirmishes of this magnitude are pretty common, so the Kingdom wastes no time deploying twenty thousand soldiers of its own.

When a betrayal from within rocks Knightley’s ranks, the enemy’s forces continue their momentum into the Kingdom, and the royal capital falls in just one day. At this rate, the Kingdom looks like it will become another vassal state in the Debuhi Empire’s vast holdings—not to mention how much danger the new crown prince is in!

To protect his friends and country, Ryo must eliminate the invaders. Hell-bent on reclaiming the throne, he and his allies set out for the battlefield on Gold Hill. The prologue to the adventures of the strongest, freewheeling water magician reaches a spectacular climax!

title: Villains Are Destined to Die
synopsis: Slandered, maimed, poisoned...Penelope has gone to hell and back trying to escape from this damned game world. And just when she thought she finally found her way out through death, the system chews her up and spits her back out onto the hidden route. Affection meters are gone, and all that separates Laila from achieving world destruction is a mirror fragment—if Penelope doesn’t find a way to beat the monster now, there are no more second chances. But all hope is not lost. Ivonne’s innocent charade isn’t fooling everyone, and with Callisto steadfastly fighting beside his future crown princess, Penelope is no longer alone. As the heroine and villain circle each, it’s do-or-die...and a happy ending may just be within reach.

title: The Diary of a Middle-Aged Sage's Carefree Life in Another World
synopsis:
Zelos and Ado’s hopes for a quick and easy journey are dashed when Solas, a powerful Observer from another world, tasks them with venturing into the mountains to slay a dragon, retrieve its life energy, and use that energy to help revive Alphia Magus, the Dark God.

Defeating a dragon is a tall order at the best of times, though—and this is no ordinary dragon. What’s it going to take for Zelos and Ado to get out of this one?

Back in Santor, a potion-making session gone awry results in some crazy new concoctions that could be dangerous in the wrong hands or life-changing in the right ones; a local fisherman, devastated by losing the love of his life, sets out to find the truth; and a threat far more familiar than any dragon closes in on her target. It doesn’t look like things will slow down anytime soon!

title: The Petty Villain Plays by the Rules: Rewriting This Otome Game with Honest Work!
synopsis: After successfully thwarting the plans of the faction opposed to his marriage to Princess Farah, Reid can now focus on his second objective for his trip to Lenarute: finding rute grass, the ingredient he needs to make the silver bullet that could cure his mother’s mana depletion disorder. Thanks to his memories from his previous life, Reid already has a lead—he’s confident that he’ll find rute grass in the Evil Forest. Of course, the “nonconventional prodigy” isn’t going to return home without some additional triumphs. Reid sets out on a third mission: recruiting skilled artisans to invite back to the Valdia Mark in hopes of getting the best of both countries’ technologies. To accomplish all of his goals, he’s going to need the help of an apothecary, a pair of dwarven blacksmiths, and some furry critters, which might not be so easy given the bad actors that stand in his way. Reid was fated to be a villain anyway, so he’s not opposed to playing dirty to take down his foes!

title: The Side Character Who Thought He Was the Protagonist Mistook the Real Hero for a Side Character and Accidentally Won Everything
synopsis:
"I want to be a protagonist!"

After a boy who would readily throw away even his own life for the sake of others was reincarnated, he found himself in the world of a game, reborn as a mere background character. His new identity was Fey, a disposable loser with no talent whatsoever for either swordsmanship or magic.

Thanks to a goddess's little prank, however, he never once doubted that he was the protagonist. Naturally, he was no match for the true heroes destined to shape the world. Yet his utterly abnormal passion would eventually shatter a scenario steeped in despair.

With sheer fighting spirit alone, he brought genuine protagonists to their knees. Striking his most determined hero pose, he won over a princess knight heroine. Through fiery training, his stats skyrocketed as well!?

Before long, aided by the thoughtful misunderstandings of those around him (?), people began recognizing him as a powerful figure entirely on their own.

Thus begins a tale of mistaken identities and heroic delusions, where an unremarkable mob character gradually grows into a true protagonist!

You there, who yearn for stories, would you like to become a real "protagonist"?

title: Adachi and Shimamura
synopsis:
PUTTING ON A SHOW

Despite being third-years in high school, Adachi and Shimamura somehow completely forgot that the Culture Festival was a thing—right up until they were invited to participate! The event’s only going to last a couple days, but it seems Adachi’s got a little something extra in mind…

title: Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned into a Pig-
synopsis:
After finally vanquishing the most atrocious mage, Mister Pig and his companions have reclaimed the royal capital. Now, it’s time to head to their happy ending—but unfortunately, rebuilding a country from the brink of ruin isn’t quite that simple. They have plenty of problems on their plates, including but not limited to: dealing with the chaos caused by the two merging worlds, restoring the royal court that was pushed to the edge of collapse, and tackling the cruel Yethma system.

Having found a hint leading to a special artifact that’s key to the Yethma’s liberation, Mister Pig and Jess prepare to begin their search—but an uncanny and enigmatic series of murders stand in their way. Under the request of the new king, Shravis, the pair launch an investigation to unravel the case...but are they ready to face the monster called truth?

title: D-Genesis: Three Years after the Dungeons Appeared
synopsis: After Keigo and Miyoshi’s eleventh-hour heroics, all dangerous radioactive material has been nuked from existence, throwing governments all across the planet into a state of utter turmoil. Despite that, though, the world remains eerily peaceful and calm, and daily life seems to be more or less business as usual. If word ever gets out about any individual country’s loss of nuclear abilities, though, all bets are off! Meanwhile, the members of D-Powers descend into a dungeon to complete a contract job, where they begin to discover some very interesting details about the fantasy metals they recently picked up. On top of that, the mysterious dungeon entity known as “Ms. Maker” has begun interacting with the world at large, providing some surprising information regarding her origin...and what’s this about a date in Shibuya?!

title: Imperial Reincarnation: I Came, I Saw, I Survived
synopsis:
“We’ll gladly fight for your sake, Divinity!” (That’s a total lie. I’m just going to use you.)
Though Carmine has managed a historic victory over the Garfure Republic—thanks in large part to the brutal tactics of Count Ethaiq—the war is still far from over. The three southern kingdoms carry on relentlessly with their assault, and rebellions throughout the Empire still need quashing as well. And as if that weren’t enough on its own, the Divinity of the Imperium has shown up on Carmine’s doorstep, asking for asylum!
Because things can never be easy, the Divinity and his party turn out to be quite the unruly lot in oh so many ways. With that in mind, will the emperor be able to make proper use of the man, or will he rip his head off in frustration first? And as the gears of war continue to turn, will he keep up with the pace, or is all of this too much for even Carmine to manage?
Outrageous guests and combat aplenty fill the pages of volume 7 of Imperial Reincarnation!

title: I'm the Heroic Knight of an Intergalactic Empire!
synopsis:
HOLDING DOWN THE FORT

Aboard the Melea , Emma’s got her nose to the grindstone—but when her diligence is recognized with a promotion, she’s told to put her work there on hold. She’s got to complete the training for senior officers, so she’ll need to head back to House Banfield’s home planet of Hydra!

On Hydra, the lord of House Banfield—Emma’s longtime role model—has gone missing. Naturally, that encourages those working against him. It starts to seem like House Banfield will have to actively stave off foes, and Emma is put in charge of those defensive measures! When and if House Banfield’s lord reappears on Hydra, will he discover his domain unscathed thanks to a heroic knight—or will Emma’s chance to shine devolve into disgrace?!

title: The Reincarnated Mastermind: Sundering Fate with Magic Swords
synopsis:
After overcoming Viscount Gieven’s schemes, Ren is offered a place to stay in Baron Clausell’s estate in the city for a while. Accepting this, Ren spends fulfilling days with Licia while also doing work for the baron and showing off his skills as an adventurer at the guild.

One day, he is sent out on a mission to a certain location where he meets a girl he’d never expected to and finds himself caught up in another crisis. It is for these exact moments that he wields his sword!

title: The Water Magician: Arc 1
synopsis:
Ryo’s life does a 180 after arriving in the city of Lune, where he spars with an expert sword-wielding elf, takes on guild jobs with Abel (his partner-in-adventuring), Abel’s party, and his roommates, and much more! Ryo never could have imagined discovering a whole different side of this new world!

But then monsters spill out of the dungeon in droves and plunge the city into an unprecedented crisis. When Abel and his party set out to investigate, they’re forcibly transferred to the lowest level of the dungeon. There, they encounter a life-and-death situation against devils—creatures who eventually awaken as demon lords. The Handalieu Federation’s meddling and a confrontation with the Inferno Magician ratchet tensions up even more...

With the dangers racking up one by one, Ryo finally gets serious?! “I won’t let you lay a single finger on this city or my friends.” Here comes the explosive second volume recounting the adventures of the strongest, freewheeling water magician!

title: Ayakashi à la Mode
synopsis: In this world, there are mysterious spiritual beings called ayakashi. Several of them look after a young girl named Yoshino, who was abandoned at a local shrine, and life there is anything but boring. There are scuffles between cursed dolls, and even a ghost who’s training to become a ninja! But if Yoshino is intent on being the shrine’s next priestess, she’ll have to accept that not all ayakashi are so harmless. What valuable and bittersweet lessons about life and loss will her quirky spirit friends teach her?

title: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in the Real World, Too
synopsis: Yuuya Tenjou pulled off what seemed impossible: He defeated the God of Destruction and saved the other world from the brink of collapse. But there’s no rest for the overpowered. After returning home to the real world, an unbelievable crisis occurs—an invasion from the stars! Thankfully, conflict is avoidable…as long as Yuuya cooperates with the alien Meruru. She’s on a mission to rescue her home planet and requires blueprints to a lost weapon, along with an energy source. And she’s not letting anyone get in her way. Yuuya goes to the other world for a solution, searching all the way to the planet’s core!

title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
synopsis:
CAUGHT IN THE CROSSHAIRS

When Hiro returns to the imperial capital, Chris has a lot of questions. In fact, she’s set on grilling him—less about his mercenary adventures, and more about Colonel Serena. If Serena herself gets wind of Chris’s prying, there’s no way she’ll let Hiro smooth things over. In fact, the prim and proper colonel will probably blow a gasket.

But Hiro will need to deal with something that poses a much greater threat than Chris’s pointed questions: an assassin who’s found their chance to strike. The situation has gone from awkward to deadly—and Hiro will have to fight tooth and nail to leave the capital in one piece!

title: Scarlet
synopsis:
THE PRICE OF FAILURE IS DEATH, BUT EVEN DEATH WILL NOT STAND IN THE WAY OF HER VENGEANCE. 

Princess Scarlet’s life in the royal palace is turned on its head when her uncle Claudius usurps the throne and executes the king. Forever changed, she vows to take revenge on her father’s enemies—but she fails. When she next opens her eyes, she finds herself in the land of the dead. It is a world of madness where fallen soldiers from across time cause mayhem day in and day out, a wasteland where the injured or weak cease to exist. In this place where hopelessness seems inevitable, Scarlet crosses paths with a man named Hijiri, a registered nurse from present-day Japan. Together they set out on a journey to ensure that her enemies never find salvation.

title: Secrets of the Silent Witch
synopsis: During her undercover visit to Duke Clockford’s estate, Monica begins to form a theory about the second prince. To confirm her dark suspicions, she contacts a mage from the Empire whose lord, in turn, presents her with a dangerous offer. Meanwhile, Felix, now with the disgraced Gem Mage under his influence, moves to execute his own terrible plans. Who is he really? And what can Monica do once she finds out?

title: Sentenced to Be a Hero
synopsis: With the arrival of spring, it's time to initiate Ragi Enseglef, humanity's last expedition against the Demon Blight. The penal heroes quickly learn they will be split up and assigned to two different forces, one group traveling overland, the other crossing the treacherous Valligarhi Channel by boat. And of course, no matter where they are, they're stuck with the worst jobs available. What's more, Xylo finds himself fighting not only demon lords and faeries, but pirates, too! As the operation gets off to a rocky start, the penal heroes will have to use everything they've got to make sure mankind still has a fighting chance.

title: The Holy Grail of Eris
synopsis: Trust in Adelbide’s royal family is shaken, and the conniving Baron Camille Miller has a few tricks up his sleeve to restore their public image. He asks Connie to be the star in his scheme, but when she refuses, Camille begins to circulate rumors that her distant relative—the first Percival Grail—murdered Saint Anastasia. And yet something isn’t quite right… Can Scarlett and Connie uncover the true history before it’s too late?

title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy
synopsis: Thanks to the power of the people’s wishes extending past kingdom borders, destruction was avoided, and peace has fallen upon the underground world. But there are many unsolved mysteries surrounding the death of the Goddess of Creation, the remaining Selected Eight, and the identity of the self-proclaimed father of the Demon King. Anos and his followers head back underground in search of clues and discover the existence of Erial—Stars of Creation that have Anos’s missing memories sealed within them. But the land where the stars are hidden is controlled by the Sorcerer King, a powerful demon from the Mythical Age.

title: The Neverending Winter, the Land of Broken Dreams
synopsis:
What was supposed to be a fun day at the amusement park turns into a nightmarish time loop for one high schooler. From the creators of the light novel and manga series The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes (also from Seven Seas), which inspired an anime film.

After winning tickets to an old theme park on the outskirts of Tokyo, Casio and his friends brave the eerie rumors surrounding the place for a little winter adventure. However, what was supposed to be a fun day trip takes a horrific turn when one friend lures Casio away from the group—and stabs him to death. While he bleeds out, his friend tearfully begs him to save someone named Asebi.

When Casio next awakens, time has rewound to the moment he set foot in the park that morning. Though he’s shaken and desperate for answers, his “second” day goes by without incident—until he tries to leave and snaps right back to that morning again. As he spirals into panic, a mysterious girl appears and introduces herself as Asebi. She tells him she’s been trapped in the park for a long time, reliving the same day over and over. Now Casio is caught in the loop as well…and according to Asebi, the only way out is to kill someone.

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court
synopsis:
MORE TWISTS AND TURNS IN THE KIN DOMAIN!

Kou Reirin, Shu Keigetsu, and Kin Seika have pulled off their grand welcome for Prince Nadir and overcome an overdose scare with a well-timed body swap. With the immediate danger past, the Maidens spring into action, infiltrating the brothel involved in the drug trade to nail down proof of their crimes. Yet when the girls come face-to-face with the brothel’s highest-ranking courtesan, the so-called “heavenbloom,” her true identity has them reeling—Seika most of all!

title: Venus Mission: I Was an Assassin-for-Hire Who Died, Now I'm Hunting Heroes in Another World
synopsis:
AN ALLIANCE WITH THE DWARVES?

Awarded S-Rank for their heroics, Rei and Lydina are sent a special appraiser to make it official. Meet Eve—a sharp-eyed, blue-haired girl who wears an eye patch. She instantly identifies Rei’s Apostle status and signs up for the cause with religious fervor. The new trio travel to the dwarven kingdom of Melgid, only to cross paths with heroes on a mission of their own.

A simple confrontation spirals into kingdom-wide conflict. Rei’s got the dwarves, magic cannons, and golem troops on his side, but will that be enough to protect Melgid?

title: Why Run? My Summoned Beast Is Cute!
synopsis:
Hey, the name’s Heresy! I was born and raised in a remote farming village, but it’s always been my dream to become a summoner. And thanks to the superspecial friend I made when I was little, I get to turn that dream into a reality! Isn’t that right, Happy?

You took the words right out of my mouth! Because of you, I was deemed worthy to enter the Meilleur Royal Summoning Academy, and I can’t wait for my exciting high school life to begin! I bet we’ll make tons of new friends and share all sorts of precious moments together. In fact, why don’t you come on out and say hello to everyone?

title: Your Forma
synopsis: After Professor Lexie leaks the RF Models’ system code to the world, Harold is captured and scheduled to be scrapped. To add insult to injury, the Electrocrime Investigations Bureau arrests Echika on false charges. Just as she is beginning to lose all hope of turning things around, however, Echika notices friction in the Alliance, including Director Schlosser’s attempt to cover up his previous failings. If Echika can exploit the fissures in the organization, she might have a shot at saving her and Harold’s skins. But can she survive the power struggle at the very heart of the Alliance?

title: By the Grace of the Gods
synopsis: Through his study of curses, Ryoma has discovered a surprising way to expand his business empire. Meanwhile, he finally achieves his goal of allowing his familiar, Korumi, to explore lands beyond the manor in the Sea of Trees. Korumi happily assists Ryoma in conducting experiments in various fields, such as food, transportation of goods, winter gear, and more. However, neither of them could have expected what fields their research would lead them to explore.

title: From Villainess to Healer
synopsis:
After the situation in Bahal, Holy Maiden Sharon and her party of trusty pals have a new goal in mind—strive for S-rank, the highest rank for an adventurer, while all obtaining one-of-a-kind unique jobs. Tarte, Sharon’s Cait Sith apprentice, is hot on the trail of the unique job known as Creator. Her task? Track down kin of every elemental spirit.

Their quest leads them first through an underwater dungeon and eventually to Shizuku, the Lakeside City, where a mysterious monster outbreak could be the key to their rank-up. New friends and new challenges await them along the way—not to mention breathtaking sights and plenty of tasty treats! And just who is this so-called World Tree Priestess wandering the world in pursuit of her own quest...?

The former villainess’s adventures continue!

title: I'm Just a Villager, So What?
synopsis:
As Ryuto steadily builds up his strength, the world remains as overflowing with malice as ever.

Cordelia’s father, having grown rich from the privilege of being the Hero’s parent, continues to exploit the people of his home village. Meanwhile, in the royal capital, the Venison Company, a major merchant house, runs rampant, employing methods that defy all human decency. Buying and forcing their way into the heart of political power, their inhumane business practices create one misfortune after another.

Little do they know… their arrogant deeds are about to incur the wrath of the strongest Villager.

title: The Poison King: Now that I've Gained Ultimate Power, the Bewitching Beauties in My Harem Can't Get Enough of Me
synopsis: A year has passed since the civil war ended and Millicia became empress. Unfortunately, peace has yet to settle in the Garnet Empire. Because of Millicia’s reforms, discontented nobles have been revolting one after another, necessitating Caim’s constant intervention. And as if that weren’t enough, the Holy Spirit Church also has decided to make its move, sending an envoy to observe Caim in the guise of celebrating Millicia’s ascension to the throne. Meanwhile, Caim is starting to feel unsatisfied in bed and considers finding a new lover who would be tough enough to endure his insatiable libido...

title: Cooking with Wild Game
synopsis:
The massive earthquake that hit Genos quite literally shook things up a great deal for Asuta and his comrades. Immense effort has gone into rebuilding, and in the middle of all that, Asuta was forced to deal with the complex emotions caused by learning of the death of a former enemy.

And even though the quake is behind them, there’s still a lot going on! When Toor Deen opens a new stall selling desserts, will it prove to be a success? And how will it go when Asuta hires a new chef to fill the gap left by the young chef’s departure? What disaster is the Suun clan facing, and will it be possible to overcome? And of course, how will the banquet with the southerners end up going?

See all this and more in the exciting thirty-fifth volume of Cooking with Wild Game!

title: I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class
synopsis:
A SURPRISE GIFT FROM THE STORK?

Just as Saito and Akane’s relationship is on the mend after another storm of misunderstandings, a new addition joins the household: Akane’s little sister Maho! Akane swings into full mother-mode as she dotes on Maho, while Saito is swept up in the chaos of having to live with not one, but two Sakuramori girls.

To make matters worse, Maho suddenly approaches Akane with a shocking proposal that leaves the newlyweds rocked to the core. Akane realizes that what Maho asks for is the one thing Akane cannot give her spoiled sibling. Can the newlyweds face both their fears and their feelings and end up stronger than ever?

title: Survival in Another World with My Mistress!
synopsis:
A CURIOUS INVITATION

After long months of building settlements around the kingdom and rescuing captured beastmen, Kousuke is looking forward to some R&R. With new allies in tow, he and his friends return to the capital city…and his growing family! Between welcoming his and Elen’s new child into the world and spending time with his harpy partners, Kousuke’s daily life and heart is full. But when an invitation to the Dragonis Mountain Nation’s memorial service arrives, it puts everyone on edge. Just what is this service truly for, and why do they want Kousuke there? And while his friends puzzle over these questions, Kousuke busies himself with something else entirely: crafting a giant airship!

title: EXP Is Golden
synopsis:
As angels rain from the heavens, Leah stumbles onto an artifact that lets her inherit the powers of other monsters. What does she do but use it in the most game-breaking way possible: absorbing traits and abilities from Disaster-class entities like Mister Plates and Sugaru to push her power to obscene new heights—all for one purpose: taking the fight to the Archangel and tearing down that so-called harbinger of destruction. Because there can only be one!

And when the devs flag the Archangel as “impossible to defeat,” they set the stage for a cataclysm-on-cataclysm clash unlike anything Boot Hour, Shoot Curse has ever seen.

Meanwhile, in Lyla’s Kingdom of Oral, a key quest begins to unfold, and the third event surges into its second half, promising to drag every last player into the fray.

title: Finding My Way to (You) in This MMO World
synopsis: Item Master Kariya’s daring escape from a fallen stronghold throws him and his liege, Prince Wald, behind enemy lines and into the vast stretches of wilderness of the Northern Bloc. Now, they must find their way home from enemy territory...but they find their options fading fast as Khrasiel zeroes in on them. Soon, their only choice will be to venture into the Grand Weald, the legendary land of the elves. However, the elves are notoriously reclusive—and famously hostile toward transmigrators. Will this truly open a path back to the kingdom of Tiuccia, or will they simply be jumping from the frying pan into the fire? Meanwhile, Wald blossoms into his own as he treads the path toward adulthood, and Kariya finds himself fighting with forbidden feelings for his liege...

title: From Two-Bit Baddie to Total Heartthrob: This Villainess Will Cross-Dress to Impress!
synopsis: Elizabeth returns from her trip to find the kingdom in a panic. A witch is on the prowl, turning every man she comes across into a drooling, witless husk of his former self. The witch seems oddly similar to the Illusory Witch, who has a starring role in the game’s sequel as its villainess. As Elizabeth teams up with the knights to hunt down the witch and bring her to justice, Elizabeth can’t help but wonder why the potential villainess is showing up four years ahead of schedule. As if dealing with all of that weren’t enough, our favorite crossdressing villainess learns that she shares a connection to her creepy homeroom teacher—one that almost gets her killed!

title: The Tiny Witch from the Deep Woods
synopsis: Though Misha and Ryne didn’t plan on traveling to the People of the Forest’s village with much urgency, it seems every time they turn around, there’s some crisis or emergency clamoring for their attention. With the realization that they are months behind schedule, Ryne decides to make up some of their lost time by boarding a ship to carry them to the Ourenge Alliance. Misha quickly becomes a favorite among the crew and passengers, but she’s also still a magnet for more incidents along their journey! What things await her in open waters?

title: A Wicked Lady's Guide to Accidentally Saving the Kingdom
synopsis:
Lady Lettie just wants to keep her subjects under her self-proclaimed “wicked” reign. Every day, she goes out to do the most evil biddings imaginable in her little countryside domain. What does she care if her exorbitant spending benefits the local economy, or if her special power to sound out others’ weaknesses helps them grow as people?
Then one day, a surprise comes knocking when her new subject shares a grand revelation: He’s actually the kingdom’s deposed prince, and he needs her help to retake the throne. Knowing she couldn’t live out her idyllic life of tyranny if the kingdom were to fall, she agrees—but only because he’d be helpless without her, of course!
She’ll do whatever it takes. She’ll say whatever needs to be said. To win back her peace, she’ll even go against her very nature and aid the wretched citizenry. And if this sweet-talking prince doesn’t stop prattling about her virtuous heart, she’ll show him just how wicked of a lady she can be too!

title: Looks like a Job for a Maid! The Tales of a Dismissed Supermaid
synopsis: Nina and Maid & Co. are back on the road with a new purpose. After surviving the most successful Council of the Sages in history, they’re surprised by a visit from Nina’s old mistress, Vasiliace, who asks for Nina’s help in the shadowy Nyxnox Realm. But the journey there won’t be a short one. Maid & Co. will encounter an old friend, a local landmark slated for demolition, a poacher suspected to be a lupalune, a chance for Emily to shine in a dungeon adventure, and, in an episode that shakes Nina’s very identity, a country that doesn’t need maids.

title: Fluffy Paradise
synopsis:
Encountering Rare Dragons in the Elven Forest!

Nefertima is determined to find the culprit who poisoned the tea and refreshments at Daux’s social and plunged him into a depression. With the help of holy beasts and elemental spirits, she uncovers the perpetrator, but it seems like there’s more going on here than meets the eye. Amid all the excitement and intrigue, Nefertima makes time for a trip to the elven forest to retrieve the completed secret potion. And, of course, while she’s there, she’ll find some cute critters to play with!

The long-awaited 10th volume of the popular isekai fluffy fantasy is finally here!

title: From Bumbling Prodigy to Villainess: Will the Duke's Love Go Unnoticed?
synopsis:
“This is a contractual marriage,” the duke said.

“Nice!” the young lady replied. “I’ll take it!”

“What…?”

Despite Avril’s unique ability, her family has always treated her like a bumbling waste of space. Eventually, her parents force her into a marriage of convenience in her wicked half-sister’s stead. Contrary to the rumors, however, the decrepit, lecherous Duke Lanchester turns out to be a gorgeous young man. Of all things, Duke Lanchester wants to marry a villainess for three years before divorcing her. For Avril, this is the perfect opportunity to secure her freedom in the future. Thus, the oddball prodigy must do her best to play the villainess, simultaneously bewildering and charming everyone around her!

title: GATE
synopsis:
Negotiations between the Japanese government and the Empire that rules the Special Region over compensation for the Ginza Incident have made little progress.

Hoping to break the deadlock, Princess Piña joins forces with the Japanese side to host a garden party, creating an opportunity for Imperial nobles to mingle with Yoji Itami and the other Japanese representatives.

Meanwhile, far from the Imperial Capital at Alnus, Tuka, an elven girl whose father was killed by the Flame Dragon, continues to suffer from the deep emotional scars left by the tragedy—

title: How I Became King by Eating Monsters
synopsis:
Farune Strikes Back!

After repelling the Ronzan Empire’s southern invasion, Farune is striking back—and Mars, needless to say, is along for the ride. But as he heads north, his footsteps are heavy. Cassandra is champing at the bit to conquer the Empire, even though it’s her homeland. Frau is ecstatic at the prospect of ruthlessly using whatever magic she pleases. And this time, Mars’s foes are going to be just as troublesome as his allies. The ruthless Crown Prince Rigen is leading the Dragon Knights, and there are reports of an army one million strong assembling in the Empire’s capital—but that isn’t even the worst of it! Mars has no clue that waiting for him after the war is his greatest ordeal yet: the second Consort Selection Tournament.

title: Rebuild World
synopsis: It’s never a dull moment for Akira! Just after he escapes the deadly Zone 3 of the Kuzusuhara depths, an impostor shows up and frames him for the slaughter of a city leader! Now wanted by Kugamayama City for murder, Akira hides out with Dragonriver, waiting for a chance to strike back at his doppelgänger and clear his name. But then the fake Akira kidnaps Sheryl and reappears in the Serantal Building accompanied by a certain girl—the very person Shirou’s been searching for! As Akira and Shirou bear down on the same place, little do they know what the convergence of their paths has in store for them!

title: Reincarnated as a Poor Farmer in Another World
synopsis:
The impoverished farming village of Barca rose up through the power of Naming. To protect their newly reclaimed land, the young Ars stands against the noble's army with his Earth Magic. After overcoming the crisis through ingenious tactics, the reward awaiting him is an appointment as a knight under the noble house... along with the obligation to make an enormous donation to the Church.

Although he has finally been granted territory of his own, Ars immediately finds himself facing a financial crisis. Determined to turn things around, he begins building a true town from the ground up. Making full use of the talented people at his side, he rapidly pushes forward with administrative reforms and the construction of a fortified city.

Just as things begin to take shape, however, an order arrives from the head of his liege house, summoning him to war. His first battlefield pits him against the army of a neighboring domain that has illegally occupied contested land. Worse still, the enemy's elite warriors possess the ability to Beastify, transforming into foxes to fight...

The curtain rises on a massive campaign to reclaim the territory!

Now the lord of a domain of his own, the young Ars unknowingly takes his first step toward unifying the realm.

title: Sorry Darling, but You Won't Kill Me Again!
synopsis:
It should’ve been the end for the young Queen Etoile. When her beloved husband, Isar, cuts her down as the enemy invades, it seems she is destined for a miserably short reign. Instead, she awakens five years in the past. Armed with knowledge of what’s to come, she now has the ultimate opportunity: fix her mistakes, take back everything that was stolen from her, and enact sweet revenge on her would-be betrayers!

The powers that be won’t let an upstart royal act with impunity, however. Malicious forces attack from every angle, and it soon becomes clear that Etoile isn’t the only one that remembers the past. Can Etoile tame the flow of time and find true happiness? Or is she doomed to the fate that has already once consumed her?

title: The Fruit of Evolution
synopsis:
After rescuing the S-Rank adventurers who had been captured by the Cult of the Wicked One, Seiichi returns to Terbelle before immediately setting out for the Underworld, where the Wicked One’s stronghold is located.

Along the way, thanks to the intervention of the “World,” the Wicked One’s chamber somehow appears right before him! Seiichi finally comes face-to-face with the Wicked One, only to find himself unexpectedly struggling against abilities that defy all common sense.

Just when Seiichi needs something to turn the tables, “that guy,” who had been away on a journey, makes his long-awaited return?!

The outrageous display of overpowered abilities is in top form once again in Volume 14 of the hugely popular otherworld fantasy series that began on Let’s become a Novelist!

title: Tsukimichi
synopsis:
A Third Season of the TV Anime Is Officially in Production!

In search of the mysterious mercenary company Picnic Rose Garden, Makoto Misumi and the members of the Kuzunoha Company take on the labyrinth of Yasokatsui. Though constantly thrown off by the strange mechanisms hidden throughout the maze, they steadily make their way toward its lower levels.

Then, while Makoto is resting at an inn, a highly skilled assassin approaches him. Introducing himself as Rokuya, the man claims to be one of the legendary “First Adventurers,” figures who played a role in the founding of the Adventurers’ Guild.

Rokuya offers to act as an intermediary between Makoto and the mercenary company. However, he also warns that his companions awaiting them on the labyrinth’s twentieth floor will stand against Makoto—?!

title: My Girlfriend Cheated on Me, and Now My Flirty Underclassman Won't Leave Me Alone
synopsis:
NEVER EVER GETTING BACK TOGETHER?

In the days leading up to Christmas, Hasegawa Yuuta’s life was thrown into disarray when he discovered his girlfriend was cheating on him. He’s since tried to move on and tried to focus on enjoying the new semester with his flirty underclassman, Shinohara Mayu, and his longtime friend, Mino Ayaka. But after his ex claimed that she actually didn’t cheat on him, everything’s been thrown into question. Does Yuuta dare consider that it may have all been one big misunderstanding?

title: Pens Down, Swords Up: Throw Your Studies to the Wind
synopsis: Having helped save the kingdom from certain devastation, Allen is very much looking forward to the upcoming spring break—though of course, his plans center less around rest and relaxation and more around adventure and adrenaline. Two months might sound like a long time, but between exploring requests, club activities, and family bonding, Allen’s bucket list is longer than Godolphen’s beard, and Allen will need to put the pedal to the metal to get everything ticked off before classes start up again. Luckily, putting the pedal to the metal also happens to be on his bucket list, because nothing says spring break like a magicycle road trip! There’s just one thing he needs to do before he can embark on the youthful trip of his dreams, and it might just be his greatest challenge yet: survive a Rovene family vacation! Will Allen’s spring break start at full throttle, or will he crash and burn before it even begins?

title: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior
synopsis:
FALLING FROM GRACE

Ever since her shocking transformation at Tiara’s birthday party, Pride has become increasingly erratic. Her kind words and gestures of goodwill are nowhere to be found, replaced by vile outbursts and self-isolation. As her nearest and dearest agonize over her condition, one man rises up to put an end to the chaos: Arthur, her dear friend and imperial knight. Will his pleas reach this heartless new version of the princess, or have her dalliances with destiny doomed them to be bitter enemies?

title: When a Clueless First-Person Shooter Player Falls into Another World
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

PROTECT AT ALL COSTS

With the mystery of how he ended up in a different world solved, Schwarz is ready to start boosting his FPS skills and taking on new missions. His talents do not go unnoticed for long, and soon he is entrusted by a lord to keep watch over his daughter, Laly. Schwarz accepts this seemingly straightforward task, but must grapple with the consequences when it becomes clear that the target of this powerful enemy may not be Laly after all.

FINAL VOLUME

title: You Were Experienced, I Was Not: Our Dating Story
synopsis:
After five long years of dating, Ryuto and Runa finally decide to move in together. But while their days are full of bliss, Ryuto is keeping a secret from Runa—he has an editing job offer in Southeast Asia. Runa has her own dream of becoming a nursery school teacher, which is incompatible with Ryuto’s plans. How will the two overcome this impasse?
Meanwhile, their friends continue going through their share of struggles. Akari has a baby on the way, Maria and Haruku’s relationship (?) is making zero progress, and Nicole is at a loss for what to do about her relationship with Ren after the disaster that happened on Christmas Eve. What does fate have in store for all of them?

title: Dahlia in Bloom: Crafting a Fresh Start With Magical Tools
synopsis: When monster pigeons begin targeting the slime farm, the Adventurers’ Guild calls on the Scalfarotto Arms Works for help, and it’s up to Dahlia and Fermo to save the day! However, the matter is far more complicated than meets the eye. Meanwhile, Dahlia’s birthday arrives, and Volf drops by with a present, as well as an invitation to meet Guido’s wife, Rosaria. Dahlia is excited yet nervous to meet the noblewoman, but when the day comes, the visit doesn’t go quite how she expects.

title: Earl and Fairy
synopsis:
Lord Edgar Ashenbert and his fairy doctor, Lydia Carlton, continue to plan for their wedding. Unfortunately, it seems as though the road to the ceremony will be a long one, beset by troubles. While Edgar wishes for Lydia to think of nothing but their upcoming union, she struggles to do so. As he works to hide a terrible secret from her, she becomes increasingly suspicious.
Meanwhile, the Carltons receive a pair of visitors from the Scottish Highlands. Not only do they claim that there is calamity coming to the fairy world, but they are from the same clan as Lydia’s mother, about whom she knows little and is endlessly curious. Will Edgar and Lydia ever catch a moment’s rest?

title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
synopsis:
ALL ABOARD!

A mysterious ship has sailed into Scuderia’s waters! This remarkable vessel is not only capable of long-haul ocean voyages, but is outfitted to resist attacks from sea monsters. Intrigued by its construction, Van gathers up his friends and heads over to Tributo, where the ship lingers just off the coast. Apparently, it’s captained by a man named Tran—and he’s willing to meet with Van the next day. What new worlds of nautical construction could this meeting open up?

title: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
synopsis:
LET THE FESTIVITIES BEGIN!

This year’s school festival has finally begun, and the maid café Melody and her friends have worked so hard on is a smashing success! And now that the festival is here, it’s also time for the Festival Ball…and a bit of romance, perhaps?

Though who knows if it’ll come to Melody, as she’s too busy with her side quests of crushing Schue in bowling, getting in hot water with Luciana for daring to attend the festivities with Lect, and dressing the imperial princess in her handmade uniforms—all while blissfully unaware of the fact she’s avoiding every major plot beat possible! But when darkness falls over the city and a monster appears, the time for distractions is over, and the magical mad maid Melody faces the crisis head-on. After all, it’s a maid’s duty to protect her lady!

title: I'm the Heroic Knight of an Intergalactic Empire!
synopsis:
HOLDING DOWN THE FORT

Aboard the Melea , Emma’s got her nose to the grindstone—but when her diligence is recognized with a promotion, she’s told to put her work there on hold. She’s got to complete the training for senior officers, so she’ll need to head back to House Banfield’s home planet of Hydra!

On Hydra, the lord of House Banfield—Emma’s longtime role model—has gone missing. Naturally, that encourages those working against him. It starts to seem like House Banfield will have to actively stave off foes, and Emma is put in charge of those defensive measures! When and if House Banfield’s lord reappears on Hydra, will he discover his domain unscathed thanks to a heroic knight—or will Emma’s chance to shine devolve into disgrace?!

title: Loner Life in Another World
synopsis:
LET’S GET PHYSICAL!

Haruka has finally managed to regain (some!) control of his body, but more training against the Dungeon Emperors is definitely in order before his new body is up to snuff in battle. In his efforts to master his new might, Haruka pushes himself to his physical limits and pays the price for it. A few setbacks won’t stop Haruka from pushing himself even harder—but the girls just might! Will Haruka be able to reach new heights under the assault of the girls’ affectionate fury? Meanwhile, Haruka finds a certain something within one of the objects languishing unused inside his item bag. Something…alive!

title: Virgin Knight: I Became the Frontier Lord in a World Ruled by Women
synopsis:
THE VIRGIN KNIGHT MUST UNRAVEL A MURDER WHILE GUARDING HIS HEART!

After his recent, risky victory, Faust hopes for a peaceful return to his Polidoro fief—but the kingdom still needs him. Queen Liesenlotte pleads for him to investigate a five-year-old murder—the unsolved case of the prince consort’s death. She insists she doesn’t want justice, only the peace of finally knowing what happened. How could Faust deny such a heartfelt request? However, the queen’s intentions aren’t as pure as they seem. Her true objective is to keep Faust close so she can steal his virtue! In this gripping fourth volume, our male knight must solve a mystery shrouded by time while fending off the advances of his queen! Can he uncover the truth, or will the virgin conqueror be conquered?

title: Peddler in Another World: I Can Go Back to My World Whenever I Want!
