synopsis: Winter has come to Ninoritch, and after having once again butted heads with Jilvared and the Setting Sun while on a mission to find a cure for the curse afflicting Dramom and Celesdia, Shiro finds himself back in his shop, sipping hot drinks and looking out across a town disappearing beneath piles of snow. A sharp cold snap means adventuring is very much off the table for the near future, which equals fewer adventurers venturing into his store—or any others in the marketplace—to buy stuff. But after the craziness of the past however many weeks-slash-months it’s been, this is one peddler who is more than glad to have a slower period. But will he actually be able to enjoy this supposed downtime? After all, his last adventure had led to two new arrivals in town, and even a couple of weeks later, the former high elf matriarch, Lasulie, and her daughter, Mia, are finding it hard to adjust to life among the humes. Will they manage to settle in before they starve due to lack of funds?

title: Free Life Fantasy Online: Immortal Princess
synopsis:
RELEASE THE KRAKEN!

Tsukushiro Kotone, aka Anastasia the Immortal Princess, has reached level 50 and has evolved yet again! And what better way to test out her new skills than a world quest to defend the port city of Imbamunte. The players of Free Life Fantasy Online must board a warship together to fight off all manner of aquatic monsters threatening to drag them down to the depths. Meanwhile, Anastasia and the other flying players take to the skies for a different kind of battle. Can they come out on top in Free Life Fantasy Online ’s very first naval battle?

title: Witch and Mercenary
synopsis:
THE LORE BEHIND WITCH AND MERCENARY

For the first time, this collection of five new short stories gives fans a glimpse into the experiences of Zig and some of the friends (and foes) he has met on his many journeys. Through these stories, fans can get an up-close look into the day-to-day thoughts and motivations of the unforgettable characters that dot the Witch and Mercenary narrative landscape.

Stories include a tale of Zig’s mercenary band and how he started using his signature weapon, an account of the Remitter Yaesar and a set of demi-human siblings, and a tale about Laika, an outcast of the Jinsu-Yah. Don’t miss the chance to peek around the curtain and learn even more about this world of witches and whirling weapons!

title: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles
synopsis: To solve the problems of her organization, Christina devised a plan with her life as the price, but Rio endeavors to save her. When faced with an impossible choice, he chooses the path of no return. As a result, Christina’s existence is tied to the world a little longer, but not in the way Rio wants. Events play out exactly as the witch plotted—and just as Rio questions his choice, an unexpected figure appears to offer him a hand...

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm: Fanbook
synopsis: The seventh official Ascendance of a Bookworm fanbook has arrived, recommended to be enjoyed after finishing the final volume of the light novels. This edition is packed with fresh content: new character design sheets, exclusive manga, stunning artwork, and coverage of two more drama CDs. Featuring the first full map of the Royal Academy and another enormous Q&A with author Miya Kazuki, there’s plenty for fans to sink their teeth into!

title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
synopsis:
The long, dangerous dungeon crawl is over, and Mukohda and his familiars are finally homeward bound! After what felt like ages underground, Mukohda’s long overdue for some R&R back in Karelina, and this time he isn’t going to let anyone stand in between him and a golden chance to lounge about and not spend every hour of every day fearing for his life. Nothing could convince him to throw himself back into trouble. Nothing!

Unfortunately for Mukohda, it’s only a matter of time before his decisions catch up with him and trouble comes calling whether he likes it or not. You can’t fly across several countries on an ancient dragon without turning a few heads, after all, and this time around, “trouble” has pointy ears, a terrible work ethic, and a pathological obsession with dragonkind even more intense than Mukohda’s desire to not get involved with any of this nonsense. What shenanigans will Mukohda’s self-proclaimed best friend in the whole wide world drag him into this time?

title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
synopsis:
Enough is enough! The Church of Rubanov has violated Mukohda’s privacy one time too many—on top of their habit of trafficking their own people and subjugating the non-human races—and Demiurge, the God of All Creation, has finally decided that something must be done about them. What, specifically? Why, sending Mukohda and his familiars over to ruin their day in the most explosive manner possible, of course!

Bringing down a dictatorial, human-supremacist theocracy isn’t the only item on Mukohda’s itinerary, though. He also has shopping to do, and conveniently enough, the one town where he stands any chance of replacing his irreparably damaged magic stove happens to be just a short hop away from the Holy Kingdom of Rubanov’s capital. However, that may not be the last stop on their trip if his familiars have anything to say about it...

title: My Friend's Little Sister Has It In for Me!
synopsis:
Akiteru has disappeared! After a face-off with Amachi Otoha, Akiteru agreed to step down as producer for Koyagi. In exchange, Amachi Otoha would recognize and support Iroha’s acting ambitions. But with Akiteru removing himself from the picture for the sake of Iroha’s future, the 05th Floor Alliance is thrown into chaos! And while he’s appointed Otoi as his replacement captain, can she actually steer this ship through stormy waters?

Where did Akiteru go anyway? And what’s he doing? The answer may lie hidden in an unexpected (and yet expected) corner...

title: The Amazing Village Creator: Slow Living with the Village Building Cheat Skill
synopsis: After the successful martial arts tournament, Luke and his village face a new challenge when the patriarch of the kingdom’s all-powerful church catches wind of the unauthorized church operating in the wasteland village. With the patriarch intent on investigating and punishing the heretics, Myria forms a task force to protect her precious Luke and the other villagers against the kingdom’s religious leaders. But that’s not the only obstacle Luke must face... Dragons, krakens, giant sharks, and monsters galore await him in the exciting next volume of this fantasy adventure!

title: Agents of the Four Seasons
synopsis: During their trip to a foreign country, the two young Autumns are caught in the chaos of a major attack. But their fellow gods refuse to sit around and let such needless violence play out, and the Four Seasons of Yamato and Kashu join the international fray. As the true source of this evil becomes clearer, Nadeshiko’s Guard, Rindo Azami, runs through the battlefield to rescue his lady. Where will the story of her love—and her sin—bring her?

title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
synopsis: Since their first trip to the beach, Masachika, Alya, and their friends have been through a lot together. From fiery debates and competing against rivals at the school festival to celebrating birthdays and revealing secrets—you think you’ve seen it all. These short stories offer a look behind the scenes and from brand new perspectives. Find out what else happened during the accidental hypnosis, what sparks Yuki’s wild schemes, and just how far the handicraft club is willing to go for the perfect model. Become an insider and enjoy this extra serving of sweet and spicy antics, young love, and barely-hidden feelings!

title: Associate Professor Akira Takatsuki's Conjecture
synopsis: A female Seiwa student comes to Professor Takatsuki and Naoya looking for advice. She tells them about going with her club friends to a building where the elevator supposedly transports whoever rides it to another world, and the next day, one of their group vanished without a trace. Next, the pair receive a request from afar and head deep into the mountains of Tochigi. They find themselves in the middle of a construction site where mysterious events continue to occur as the builders try to fill in the marshland it sits atop. However, legend has it that the marsh is home to “Nushi-sama”…

title: Black Summoner
synopsis: After encountering Ange in Gaun, the Country of Beastkin and learning of the existence of the Apostles, Kelvin, the battle junkie Summoner from another world, and his companions decide to visit the Holy Empire of Deramis. There, they are granted an audience with Pope Philip, who offers them information on Iris, the alleged leader of the Apostles, and Serge, a Hero from lore. Just then, the famous Heroes of the current age happen to return from their own journey to the Western Continent. Unbeknownst to these two groups, Deramis will soon be plunged into a commotion as the Apostles enact the next part of their plot!

title: Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
synopsis: The game’s end is rapidly approaching, and Maple Tree continues their item-collection journey. They must overcome a cloud labyrinth, an abandoned factory, underwater ruins chock-full of confusing codes, and much more…all to simply challenge the Demon Lord! Meanwhile, other guilds request the girls’ help in exchange for valuable information. It’s nearly time to finish this stratum once and for all. Can Maple and Sally emerge victorious at last?!

title: Buying a Classmate Once a Week
synopsis: Once a week, high schooler Shiori Miyagi pays her classmate Hazuki Sendai five thousand yen to make the girl follow her orders for the afternoon. Their sessions start with normal activities like snacking and chatting…until a mood strikes Miyagi, and she gives Sendai commands that veer into risky territory. No matter the order, Sendai follows, even if it means licking Miyagi’s feet. Yet after half a year of engaging in this secret dynamic, neither girl calls the other a friend. So what does that make them? And with their last year in high school looming, is their relationship doomed to crumble?

title: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
synopsis: On Christmas day, Nao disappeared, leaving me all alone. I'm Sunao, her original—the one who ran away and made my replica do everything I didn't feel like doing. Now it's time for me to figure out who I am, and how to function without her. But no matter how hard I try, I can't seem to make any progress. Then again, maybe some changes can only be seen by those around you. This is the story of my year without Nao...and how I realized I was going to be okay.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End -Prelude-
synopsis: An episode from Übel's past, Frieren's life in her home village, Serie's days as Flamme's teacher, the inner thoughts of a young demon, and the daily activities of a certain receptionist at the Northern Branch of the Continental Magic Association. These five stories from the world of Frieren shed additional light on various characters, their motivations, and the experiences that helped shape them.

title: God Sleeps in Seafoam
synopsis:
In a land of spirits, it is an unbearable shame to be born without one. Cast out from his noble birthplace, the spiritless Akira is forced to find a new life as a commoner, eking out a living by fighting the wild beasts that venture near the human lands—a far cry from the greatness he was supposedly destined for.
However, Akira’s strange nature soon comes to light. His skill in amulet crafting and unprecedented resilience to miasma hint at the potential he conceals—potential soon to be tested when a slumbering god awakens to his presence.
The fire god of the south does not awaken alone, for no sooner does Akira receive her blessings than an ancient evil rises, threatening to devour his new home.

title: How to Eat Life
synopsis: During a surprise reunion with his older brother, Seki, questions race through Tobi’s mind. Why would Seki even be here? Is this person truly him? And if so, is he the same big brother Tobi remembers? As the peaceful days Tobi and Ryuuko once knew become little more than distant memories, the zingai incidents continue to ramp up! And amid the chaos, a man from Monika’s organization, who goes by the name Hyena, approaches Tobi and Ryuuko with a peculiar proposal…

title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? On the Side: Sword Oratoria
synopsis: Loki Familia sets out for the 60th Floor, a place they’ve never been. It will undoubtedly be dangerous. Some of them may not make it. And they have little choice because the corrupted spirit waits for them there. If Orario is to ever know peace, it must be slain. Powerful allies gather around Loki Familia, taking up arms to protect their beloved city. One of the greatest forces that the city has ever assembled marches into battle. How many will see the surface again…?

title: King's Proposal
synopsis: Ever since the Garden Night Soirée, Kuroe has been diligently avoiding Mushiki. Ruri quickly deduces that Kuroe is steering clear of him out of affection, but because of her own feelings for him, she doesn’t want Mushiki to catch on. Meanwhile, Mushiki’s class at Void’s Garden heads to a Hokkaido ski resort for a school trip. But a huge surprise is waiting for him there: the supposedly dead founding members of the Knights of the Garden appear out of nowhere! The next thing Mushiki knows, the newly revived knights are asking for advice on how to date Saika! Between all the mayhem, will Mushiki and Kuroe ever patch things up?

title: My Instant Death Ability Is So Overpowered, No One in This Other World Stands a Chance Against Me!
synopsis: With the vast majority of Luu’s powers restored and the UEG dead, Yogiri and Tomochika are on the verge of finally making it back home. However, in order to undo the damage wrought by the UEG’s rampage, the Great Sage resets the entire world to the moment Yogiri’s class was first summoned. While the people Yogiri killed remain dead, everyone else is brought back to life, including Sion, the Sage responsible for summoning his class in the first place. Having retained her memories of her previous encounter with Yogiri, she agrees to help him and Tomochika collect the Philosopher’s Stones once again. While things seem poised to go more smoothly this time with her assistance, it doesn’t take long for another Sage’s carelessness to throw the entire world into a brand new kind of chaos.

title: Reign of the Seven Spellblades
synopsis: Headmistress Esmeralda is nowhere to be found, leaving Kimberly’s students and the remaining faculty to fight off an invasion by the Order of the Sacred Light. All six members of the Sword Roses are fiercely defending their positions even as both sides of the struggle deal with numerous losses. The Gnostics desire salvation, but Oliver and his allies will resist this crusade—even if it kills them. With the scales of war tipping in the enemy’s favor, Kimberly Magic Academy may very well be on the brink of total collapse…

title: See You at That Site of Grace After Work
synopsis: Wataru Aida struggles with communication, yet somehow he ended up with a job in sales. His sole source of joy is playing video games, where he immerses himself in the world and studies online strategy guides alone rather than interacting with other players. However, this all changes one day when his senior coworker Reito Kashima catches him looking at a site for the game he’s currently obsessed with during his lunch break—and rather than chew him out, Reito asks Wataru to help him with Elden Ring! As they adventure together across the Lands Between, both Wataru’s career and his life begin to lead him down paths he never thought possible…

title: Witches Can't Be Collared
synopsis: When the Sixth Precinct loses contact with one of the witches, Rogue immediately goes searching for her. The Seventh Witch, Humafu the Sleepless, can only sleep after she kills someone, but the collar’s restrictions mean murder isn’t an option. Stuck in a limbo where she’s barely awake, she keeps herself busy by leading a gang in town. One day she goes out to meet them…and doesn’t come back! Meanwhile, an urban legend is going around about an eerie figure snatching up children. Did Humafu run away, or become that creep’s latest victim? Rogue just hopes Catherine and Miseria can stop competing over him long enough that they can track down Humafu—before it’s too late.

title: You Can Have My Back
synopsis: Josef has come to the royal capital to serve his lifelong master. Lucas, the lieutenant general, gives his unchanging love to his late beloved. Dirk, adjutant to the general, who has made an unusual name for himself as a commoner, despite his facetious personality. The twists and turns of fate bring them together to face an incident that rocks the foundation of the kingdom, and Josef falls in love with Lucas in the battlefield. But Josef is suggested he become Lucas’s adopted son so that he may continue to live in the royal palace, where birthright purists run rampant. As Josef faces his own conflict, unable to let go of his yearning, Lucas, the object of his affection, points out how naïve he is, and Josef reels. On impulse, he heads out into the seedier parts of the city at night, but who appears before him but Dirk, more furious than Josef has ever seen him before...

title: Your Castle's Little Helper
synopsis: In the peaceful land of Frontera, a small child wastes away in a corner of the palace. But just before she starves to death, something else awakens inside her—the consciousness of a Japanese woman named Chihiro Sagami. To keep herself alive, Chihiro works hard doing anything she can! She’s adopted by a chef who assumes she’s an urchin, charges off into the forest in search of honey, and asks for udon when she gets sick. Chihiro is showered with love as she tears around the castle, where she’s given the nickname “the little helper.” And thanks to this one tiny girl, Frontera slowly becomes a country where kind people’s happiness is guaranteed.

title: Genius in the Library: This Bookish Rookie Will Save the Day!
synopsis:
Meet Martina, a brilliant young girl with one all-consuming obsession: books. She’s already devoured every last volume in the commoners’ library, and the last place left with unread material is the royal library inside the palace itself. There’s just one tiny problem...only civil servants are allowed inside.

Naturally, she does the only logical thing: aces the civil service exam and lands herself a job at the palace!

But Martina’s dream of open access to books galore won’t come so easily. An unusual surge of monster attacks is threatening the kingdom, and the General Affairs Office where civil servants work stands at the epicenter of the resultant chaos. Loving the written word won’t be enough—this rookie will have to use her book smarts to travel the world and defeat powerful enemies if she wants a quiet life of reading. With a photographic memory and a brain like no other, Martina might just be the key to saving them all.

title: Infinite Dendrogram SP
synopsis: The day after Ray and Hugo faced off against the vile Gouz-Maise Gang, the city of Gideon was far livelier than usual, brimming with excitement and anticipation for a certain event. As one would expect from a metropolis bearing the title of "city of duels," the event was a match between two highly notable duelists: Figaro — the local hero — and Xunyu — one of the most powerful individuals from the far-east empire of Huang He. Both were Masters wielding the powers of Superior Embryos, and both would give their all to fight, make merry and emerge victorious. But a malicious plan unfurls itself in the shadows, who is it that seeks to strike the Kingdom of Altar at its most vulnerable? More importantly, who will survive the Clash of the Superiors?

title: The Dorky NPC Mercenary Knows His Place
synopsis: Picking up right where the last installment left off, the Galactic Empire has been pitted against its longtime rival, the Kingdom of Planet Nekirelma. This all-out war will determine the fate of the entire galaxy—either the empire will continue its progressive policies, or it will be plunged into a new dark age under even more capricious nobles! Nekirelma has the most skilled fighter squadron the imperial soldiers and mercenaries have faced yet, and what kind of threat might be hiding on their homeworld? For his part, unassuming otaku and brilliant mercenary pilot John Ouzos just wants to survive without doing anything that might get him scouted by the Imperial Army. But the higher the stakes of the battles he finds himself in, and the more skilled his opponents, the harder this becomes. Meanwhile, dissidents unsatisfied with the pace of reform in the empire plot a takeover from within. Will Ouzos ever find the time to enjoy his hobbies?

title: Fluffy Café in Another World
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

THE FLUFFY CAFÉ IS OPEN FOR BUSINESS

Taichi Arima’s life takes a fur-raising turn when his heroic efforts to save a cat in his previous life send him to another world. Blessed with advanced Tamer skills, Taichi soon earns the trust of many new animal companions, and with their help, he turns his dream of owning a café into a reality. Things can get a little wild when some beasts aren’t as congenial than others, but overall, Taichi’s days at the café are tranquil ones. That is, until a rare Ore Hedgehog collapses in front of the café—an event that brings unexpected aristocratic attention to Taichi’s humble corner of this world!

title: Reborn as an Aristocratic Scoundrel, I Broke the Game and Mastered Magic Beyond Limits!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

In this action-packed isekai, one gamer finds himself reincarnated in his favorite academy game—but as the villain! Can he change the game and avoid complete ruin? And don’t miss the manga , also from Seven Seas!

Under the right circumstances, living my next life in a magical academy game could’ve been a thrill. But being reborn as Weiss Fancent, a doomed minor antagonist, didn’t exactly set me up for success in this world! The academy’s entrance exams will roll around before long, and I figure the only way to avoid Weiss’s original fate is to ensure that I’m strong enough to wipe the floor with my schoolmates-to-be. Assuming fearsome adventurer Milque Avitus agrees to help me train, can I whip myself into shape in time? Or will the entrance exams be the beginning of the end—no matter what I do?

title: The Devil Princess
synopsis:
A SECOND CHANCE IN THE WORLD OF LIGHT

Yulucia has finally gotten her wish: She’s back in the World of Life as her past self, Yuzu Togaki, once again. She’s now five years old and remembers almost nothing of her life as Yulucia. She does, however, remember that Yuzu had died in her early teens after years of being bedridden, and she’s determined not to succumb to the same fate twice.

Meanwhile, evil spirits and people with impure hearts flock to her, almost as if drawn by her demonic presence. Not to mention a black cat that keeps watching her—and why does he seem so familiar? But more importantly, by using what faint memories she has of her past lives, Yulucia-now-Yuzu is going to make sure nothing stands in the way of her second chance at life!

title: Zero Damage Sword Saint: I Enrolled in a Magic School and Wound Up in a Contract with the Demon Queen
synopsis: After dealing with the Last Dungeon, Babel, both Eugene and Sumire are now students in the prestigious Hero Course at Lykeion Magic Academy. Their peaceful days come to an abrupt end when he and his classmates receive a major request: to slay the Infernal Demonic Beasts in the Blue Sea Union and the Cardia Halidom. Though Eugene, Sumire, and Sara accept the mission, they learn that slaying an Infernal Demonic Beast places a curse on the slayer, condemning them, their loved ones, and their family to death! To make matters worse, the Fiend Dragon Glasya-Labolas—the oldest and most powerful of the Infernal Demonic Beasts—launches a sudden attack on humanity. To carry out the mission and defeat the Fiend Dragon, Eugene must take drastic measures.

title: Haibara's Teenage New Game+
synopsis: Natsuki plunges into his second summer vacation with fresh aspirations for the future. The Rainbow-Colored Youth Plan is proceeding without a hitch—his band is unified once more, his relationship with Hikari is strong, and each day is fulfilling. Everything should be great, but Natsuki’s been having enigmatic dreams of a life with a girl who isn’t Hikari. Unbeknownst to him, those blissful dreams just might spell trouble for his current reality. Life is a constant series of choices. Can Natsuki be confident in the ones he’s made this time?

title: The Capital's One-Man Golem Master Got Kicked Out!? Now Free, I'm Traveling the World with My Beautiful Heroine Disciples to Build the Ultimate Golem! Don't Ask Me to Come Back. I'm Done!
synopsis:
Horus was a man who single-handedly kept the Kingdom of Diamante's operations running through his absurd ability to remotely control countless mechanical dolls known as Golems. However, thanks to an ignorant noble, he ended up being dismissed from his position.

After reuniting with his beautiful disciples, Horus was both mentally and physically exhausted, and he had absolutely zero desire to work anymore. All he wanted was to set off on a carefree journey and devote himself to perfecting his beloved all-purpose technology, the Golem System.

Or at least, that was the plan?

"A dragon attacking a village gets knocked out in one hit!?"

"You put ingredients inside, and a meal is ready in an instant¿?"

As Horus casually deals with troublesome incidents one after another, he somehow ends up fixing problems wherever he goes. And once rumors of his deeds begin to spread, the nobles of the kingdom start chasing after him, desperate to bring him back.

"What a pain¿ Should we just do it? One punch."

A public example, an iron fist, and a clean sweep!?

title: Adachi and Shimamura
synopsis:
PUTTING ON A SHOW

Despite being third-years in high school, Adachi and Shimamura somehow completely forgot that the Culture Festival was a thing—right up until they were invited to participate! The event’s only going to last a couple days, but it seems Adachi’s got a little something extra in mind…

title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
synopsis:
“INCREDIBLE! TODAY IS THE DAY SAINT HISTORY IS MADE!”

The day of the head saint selection is here, and it’s time for Fia to flex her saintly muscles! Of course, the first round is a breeze, and Fia gets the top score…and a lot of unwanted attention for it! Despite the pressure, Fia is ready for another demonstration of her talents: healing the legs of the ex-knight Maurice. It’s a piece of cake for Fia, but when she notices Priscilla’s strong desire to heal Maurice herself, Fia does the unexpected… Will Fia be the next head saint, or will her compassion cost her the role?

title: Her Royal Highness Seems to Be Angry
synopsis: To solve the mystery of the white-cloaked man and the black fog, Leticiel turns to Nirvaan's royal library for answers. There, she encounters a strange and sinister message in one of the library's books... But before she can uncover more, Leticiel learns of a mass uprising within the Filiaregis duchy! Chaos is spreading throughout the region, and it's up to Leticiel to set things right. Can Leticiel mete out justice before it's too late?

title: Semantic Error
synopsis: Sangwoo Choo has narrowed things down to three possible courses of action, but none of them are viable! It’s not like he can force Jaeyoung abandon his plans to go to America, and there’s no guarantee that a casanova like him would patiently wait six months for Sangwoo to get into a study abroad program. As loathe as Sangwoo is to admit it, all signs are pointing to an inevitable parting of ways. With mere weeks to go before Jaeyoung’s departure, unspoken questions linger between them. Is a happily ever after even in the cards for two such diametrically opposed foes-turned-something more? Or they finally debug the semantic error and delete each other from their lives for good?

title: The Bladesmith's Enchanted Weapons
synopsis:
The craftsmen of the Shander domain are once again thrown into turmoil when they receive an order for thirty katana, and that’s not the worst part. It’s an order from King Rathbard himself. To overcome a slump in his career, Lutz travels to the royal capital and meets with the men who will be using his katana, but finds that they are a collection of oddballs.
Among them is the mysterious Captain Leonard. Beyond his reputation as a war hero, his gloomy personality tells Lutz that his past must be rather murky. To complicate matters, he asks Lutz for something so nebulous that he is left in a state of bewilderment: a katana that will act as a fitting adornment for his own death.
As is usually the case, forging such a katana for a man known as “the Grim Reaper” might only be the start of their problems. Will the wish that Lutz poured into the katana be granted, or are there some things that can’t be changed? This is a story of life, death, and what becomes of those who are left behind.

title: Disowned but Not Disheartened! Life Is Good with Overpowered Magic
synopsis:
With the Mystic Forest threatening to overflow, Peylon is under lockdown. Tragically, this means even Lera is barred from entering the earl’s domain, leaving her stuck in the royal capital where she’s bored out of her wits. Still, she’s determined to go home and help, one way or another.

But before she can even try, she’s informed that it’s time for her to succeed her father as head of House Duval, and Lera quickly learns that she’s inherited a lot more than just a noble title.

title: History of the Kingdom of Orcsen: How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came to Burn Down the Peaceful Elfland
synopsis:
THEN IT’S WAR. LET US BEGIN.

Though known for his wise and reasonable rule, King Gustav of Orcsen can also be quite cunning. With the hopes and dreams of his people riding on him, Gustav begins laying down the foundations for his next ingenuous scheme against Elfland.

Dinerúth, head of a dark elf clan, had her old life ripped away in a despicable act of genocide—by her own country’s ruling class. After receiving asylum in Orcsen, Dinerúth swore herself to King Gustav, in heart, body, and soul. But these blissful days between them are short-lived.

For Orcsen—its blades now unsheathed and fully sharpened—has finally declared war on Elfland!

title: I Like Villains, so I Reincarnated as One
synopsis:
LIKE A BEE TO HONEY

Weiss Hamilton was just a boss in a game, doomed to defeat. But when an avid fan wakes up one day as Weiss himself, he suddenly has access to cheat codes beyond his wildest dreams! This newfound knowledge pushes Weiss to victory, and even helps repair his relationship with his former foe of a sister.

Still, success is hard won. When Weiss goes on a territory investigation, he encounters the Twelve Apostles of Hades—new enemies who seem to have some tasty tricks up their sleeves. Will Weiss be able to resist the sweet temptations they put forth?

title: Magic Maker: How to Create Magic in Another World
synopsis:
MAGICAL LESSONS ARE NOW IN SESSION!

Thanks to Shion’s magical prowess, he discovers the cure for a mysterious new illness that has been ravaging the kingdom. Word of Shion’s exclusive knowledge and accomplishments reach the highest levels of the nation, and the queen orders him to teach students in the royal capital about magic and how it works. Shion’s new role as teacher is anything but smooth sailing, though, as his aristocratic students from diverse backgrounds are skeptical of his ideas from the get-go. Magical experiments are one thing, but trying to change rigid minds is a battle not so easily won! Can a mere commoner like Shion convince the royal echelons of society of magic’s existence?

FINAL VOLUME

title: I Was Reborn as a Refugee Girl, So I'm Working Toward Citizenship from Scratch
synopsis:
Lill’s stomach growls.

Of all the places she could have been reincarnated, she ended up in a refugee settlement. Worse yet, her parents refuse to work, leaving her ostracized by the others. With nothing but dried grass for a bed and uncertainty waiting for her each day, life is anything but easy.

But then Lill learns there may be a way out: if she registers with the Adventurers’ Guild and works her way up to B-rank, she’ll earn the right to live in town!

Determined to leave her life as a refugee behind, Lill starts from the very bottom. Picking up trash, cleaning, and taking whatever small F-rank requests she can find—she tackles every job earnestly, one step at a time.

And when she finally earns her very first reward, there’s only one place she wants to go: a restaurant in town, somewhere she’s never been able to set foot in before. Her first bite of the grilled skewers she’s dreamed about for so long is so delicious it nearly brings tears to her eyes.

“If it means getting a hot meal, bring on any quest!”

Starting with absolutely nothing, one hardworking reincarnated girl is determined to build a new life for herself—and earn her way out of refugee status!

A heartwarming, laid-back otherworld adventure begins!

title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
synopsis: Zagan is feared by the masses as an evil sorcerer. Both socially awkward and foulmouthed, he spends his days studying sorcery while beating down any trespassers within his domain. One day he's invited to a dark auction, and what he finds there is an elven slave girl of peerless beauty, Nephy. Having fallen in love at first sight, Zagan uses up his entire fortune to purchase her, but being a poor conversationalist, he has no idea how to properly interact with her. Thus, the awkward cohabitation of a sorcerer who has no idea how to convey his love and his slave who yearns for her master but has no idea how to appeal to him begins.

title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
synopsis: Zagan and Nephy's clumsy cohabitation continues! As they're enjoying their time together, a sorcerer coveting the power of an Archdemon comes charging in, covered in armor from head to toe. Zagan easily repels them, but finds that they're a young dragon girl named Foll. Meanwhile, the church has brought over an Angelic Knight who's rumored to have even killed a dragon to tackle the newly crowned Archdemon... Will our awkward Archdemon and elf ever close the gap between them, or will all the commotion get in their way!?

title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
synopsis: The castle has become lively with the addition of a butler and a daughter, and as Zagan and Nephy's awkward days continue, Nephy is suddenly attacked in town. And the one who attacked her... is a girl who looks identical to Nephy, but with dark skin?! Immediately following that incident, Zagan receives an invitation from an Archdemon to an evening ball on a boat?! The residents of Zagan's castle head off toward a luxurious party, fully aware of the danger!

title: Fraudulent Fiancés Roll Out the Red Carpet
synopsis:
Twenty-year-old Ebato Aoi has hit rock bottom. Out of school since his early teens, unable to keep a job or a girlfriend, and scraping by on crash-for-cash scams, he’s headed nowhere fast. Then he picks the wrong mark: the absurdly handsome CEO riding in an absurdly expensive car, Inami Takane.

Given the choice between jail time and becoming Inami’s fake boyfriend, Aoi takes the obvious option. But he soon realizes that serving time might have been easier to handle than playing boyfriend to a prickly, arrogant CEO...

title: Her Royal Highness Seems to Be Angry
Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized!
synopsis:
NEW BONDS, OLD SCORES

Wim is a support caster and current member of the elite guild Nachtlibelle, and though he is still not fully used to his new surroundings, he starts to let his guard down and open up to his fellow guild members. After being behind the scenes for so long, maybe it’s not so bad being the center of attention after all!

The guild holds a grand Expedition Celebration to celebrate conquering a new floor, but rumors about his former guild Drachenflügel and its leader Chronos prove too big of a distraction for Wim to ignore. A whirlwind of events changes Wim’s fate, but will it all be for the better?

title: Survival in Another World with My Mistress!
synopsis:
A CURIOUS INVITATION

After long months of building settlements around the kingdom and rescuing captured beastmen, Kousuke is looking forward to some R&R. With new allies in tow, he and his friends return to the capital city…and his growing family! Between welcoming his and Elen’s new child into the world and spending time with his harpy partners, Kousuke’s daily life and heart is full. But when an invitation to the Dragonis Mountain Nation’s memorial service arrives, it puts everyone on edge. Just what is this service truly for, and why do they want Kousuke there? And while his friends puzzle over these questions, Kousuke busies himself with something else entirely: crafting a giant airship!

title: The Faceless Mercenary Wants to Settle Down: Homestead at the Edge of the Galaxy
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

After an exciting life as a mercenary, one man is calling it quits and retiring—to farm life! But can he resist the pull of danger, especially when his new neighbors are in trouble? An action-packed series about a very capable guy just trying to retire! From the author of Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship! and Survival in Another World with My Mistress! , both also available from Seven Seas.

Faceless, fearsome mercenary Glenn is cashing in his chips. These days, battle appeals less than…agriculture! A charming farm on a far-flung planet gives the longtime soldier the opportunity for reinvention, allowing him to delve into pastoral passions. But even as a farmer, Glenn can detect a threat in no time. And when he discovers that a new neighbor is being harassed, he’s bound to fall back on his usual strategy: cybernetically enhanced combat!

title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
synopsis: Usato and his friends are headed to Samariarl! Known also as the Prayerlands, it is notorious for its discrimination against demi-humans and beastkin. So when the beastkin Amako and the monster Nea disappear out of nowhere, Usato fears the worst. But when he’s met by Samariarl’s knights for an audience with its king, Usato has to put the disappearance of his friends aside and focus on the task at hand. And though King Lucas casually agrees to put his support behind Llinger in their battle against the Demon Lord, he has one perplexing condition...that Usato spend time with his daughter Eva. Are Amako and Nea safe? And what happens when Usato, a healer whose actions defy common sense, meets his match in Eva, a girl whose knowledge of common sense might be less than zero? What secrets does she harbor?

title: Tokujo-chan: The Girls Who Brighten Your Day
synopsis: Have you ever met a “Tokujo-chan”? Whether it’s during your commute to school, on the train to work, or even in the corner of a classroom, you can always count on those babes to bring a little titillating joy into your humdrum routine. From sugary sweet glances to hot casual touches that electrify, find out more about the world of Tokujo-chans in this collection of exquisite, full-color moments that’s sure to fulfill your daily dose of joy!

title: When It Rains, It Pours
synopsis:
Two strangers find shelter in one another as an anonymous exchange sparks friendship. But can it lead into something more? A Boys’ Love light novel that proves every storm leads to brighter days — from the creative team behind Yes, No, or Maybe? , also available from Seven Seas!

Hagiwara Kazuaki, who’s living the “normal” life of a working man, is worried by the distance growing between him and his live-in girlfriend. Meanwhile, his co-worker, Nakarai Sei, quietly pines for his male roommate and childhood friend. One day, a misfired email sparks an anonymous exchange between Hagiwara and Nakarai, leading to an odd but comforting friendship built on shared frustrations and anxieties.

At first, anyway. Hagiwara and Nakarai’s shared secret soon blossoms into something more: a passion that risks swallowing them both up. If their turbulent feelings are rushing to find an outlet, will they find it in each other — and will it blow up their lives?

title: Let This Grieving Soul Retire
synopsis: While the rest of Grieving Souls enjoy their time in Yggdra, Krai heads home early in hopes of getting some rest. What he finds instead is a number of well-meaning people who want him promoted to Level 9. Strangely, though the advancement exam is usually done solo, he gets teamed up with two other promotion candidates. The assignment isn’t just a difficult quest: it’s practically a suicide mission, one for which the Explorers’ Association is desperate for a solution. With little say in the matter, Krai is whisked to a mysterious city of which he has no prior knowledge, with only a few Relics and the most unlikely of allies.

title: Now I'm a Demon Lord! Happily Ever After with Monster Girls in My Dungeon
synopsis:
Thanks to the newest additions to the family, Yuki finds his days busier than ever. Having fun in the dungeon, barbecuing on the beach, relaxing with his wives, and hunting monsters with his pet army—life couldn’t get any better!

One day, Eldgalia, the top ovine scholar, commissions Yuki to do a job. An investigation into ruins in a vast, remote forest is challenging her colleagues, and they need his help. It just so happens that these ruins are also connected to...the Age of the Gods?!

Well, he’s never said no to an adventure before, so off our antihero goes! What will he learn in this mysterious place? But the bigger question is, who will he meet there? These answers and more await in the latest (and final?!) installment about a demon lord who wants nothing more than to take it easy in his second life!

title: The Isle of Paramounts: Reborn into a Slow Life Among the Strongest in the World
synopsis: Just when it seems like Arata’s life on the island is finally calming down after his explosive duel with Mina, another castaway shows up—and what’s more, she’s a mysterious girl with amnesia. Arata soon finds out that she’s both humanity’s most powerful magician and Reina’s teacher! But before she even gets the chance to settle in, another familiar human has appeared! And another. And another... Just how many of them are there?! What’s worse, they’re scattered across the island and helpless against the powerful monsters inhabiting the area, so Arata has to run around all over to save them. This includes the territory of the Ancient Dragonfolk, and even the village of the yet-unseen Elves. Meanwhile, Sakuya’s romance makes a bit of progress. Several new people may have come to Arcadia, but life continues as always.

title: Al the Adventurer: That Magic Shouldn't Work!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

DEFYING GRAVITY!

It’s time to aim for the skies—namely, the ancient ruins in Tempest’s floating research tower! His search for the Fly spell leads Al to the tomb of the man who built said research tower, where he discovers giant golems that can speak with the help of special artifacts. Unfortunately, his exploration of Tempest’s tomb is interrupted when he discovers a company of knights from the neighboring kingdom attempting to infiltrate the tomb. What political shenanigans are foot? And can Al break free of them in time to take flight?

title: Knight's & Magic
synopsis:
The battle over the flying continent continues as a newly reborn superweapon wreaks havoc among the factions! With every side scrambling for etherite, how will the little alliance between the harpies, the crew of the Golden Mane, and the Shumefleek fleet turn out?

Their victory doesn’t seem likely with said superweapon around, but that brings up the question of its origins. How was it made, and who does it belong to? What do these people want? And how will Ernie’s inevitable arrival with his own jaw-dropping discovery affect this powder keg?

title: Space Orc: Barbarian Raider of the Stars, Aiming for the Queen!
synopsis:
THE PRINCESS’S ROUGH-AND-TUMBLE FIRST TIME

Kartz, warrior orc of the Tone Tekin tribe, is given a new spaceship, but with a catch: The captain is none other than Princess Peeka. With little other choice, Kartz and his team hop on board and blast off for their first mission—attacking a mining base. But while they’re busy battling the mine’s guards, fellow barbarians seize the opportunity to snatch up all the loot! Kartz and Princess Peeka team up to fight them off, barely managing to make it out. But now their ship is in need of repair, and so it’s off to Wanderers’ Galaxy Market, where they find a plethora of goods, services…and more unsavory characters?! Can Kartz and Princess Peeka shake off this series of misfortunes?

title: The Tale of a Little Alchemist Blessed by the Spirits
synopsis:
SEASIDE SHENANIGANS

With a new little sister and apprentice by her side, Daisy’s days are busier than ever! Daisy’s quest for materials to defeat the dreaded drake takes her to a seaside port town. It’s her first time to visit the beach, and she’s determined to enjoy it to the fullest!

But while Daisy enjoys frolicking in the sand in her swimsuit, she ends up rubbing the locals the wrong way when she boils a giant octopus with alchemy magic and turns an entire hot spring into potion water! Oops! Can Daisy turn the tides on her seaside adventure and smooth things over?

title: A Journey Through Another World
synopsis:
After losing his life due to a god’s mistake, Takumi is reincarnated in another world. There, he rescues the twins Allen and Elena from a forest and begins a new life as an adventurer.
During a visit to the local lord’s estate in the port town of Bailey, Takumi and the children end up staying there for a while. One day, Takumi decides to make curry for lunch. Drawn in by the irresistible aroma, more and more people begin to gather, until the entire lord’s household has assembled.
With Allen and Elena helping him, Takumi prepares a special curry for everyone. The lord is so impressed by the dish that he makes Takumi an unexpected proposal—

title: An Observation Log of My Wife Who Calls Herself a Villainess
synopsis:
Just when it seemed peace had finally returned, a new storm is about to shake the royal palace!

With Bertia's boundless energy showing no signs of slowing down despite her pregnancy, Cecil can't help but worry about his beloved wife.

Meanwhile, another crisis erupts when Charles's older brother becomes the center of a shocking scandal. Not only does he have numerous secret children, but the affair threatens to ignite a political firestorm that could upend the balance of power within the royal court.

As Charles quietly investigates the mess to clean up after his brother, his suspicious behavior sparks rumors throughout the palace that he's having an affair.

Before long, the gossip reaches Anne... and, unfortunately, Anne's best friend, Bertia.

"An unfaithful man deserves swift justice!"

Furious, Bertia declares war on the supposed philanderer—but somehow Cecil ends up being labeled an "enemy" as well, complete with strict orders to stay away from her!

Can the kingdom's most devoted royal couple survive their very first marital quarrel?

The hilariously unpredictable adventures of the former villainess continue in this heartwarming romantic comedy!

title: I Saved Myself with a Potion!
synopsis:
Mount Ormon is known as a place where magical energy easily accumulates and countless dangers lurk. Kaede and her companions set out to climb it in search of mandrake flowers, a key ingredient needed to create mana potions.

Their goal is to successfully produce the potions before Sargis can steal them for himself.

Meanwhile, Kaede begins searching for a man named Barrow. The name sounds strangely familiar, and after meeting Jay, a disciple of Alberum, she finally learns the truth about Barrow’s identity.

Determined to find him, Kaede leaves the royal capital—but where will her search lead her...?

title: Reincarnated Onmyoji
synopsis:
One month after opening the Itsuki Kamo Onmyoji Office, Kamo Itsuki could not be more satisfied. Thanks to a lucrative request offered in gratitude by Shion Gokido’s family, the Gokido Family, his finances are thriving—and he has even earned a promotion to A-Rank Onmyoji. Everything seems to be going perfectly.

Then the government takes notice of his extraordinary power and assigns him an impossible task.

His mission: subjugate a massive horde of vengeful spirits belonging to the Murakami pirates, who have seized control of the Seto Inland Sea! To make matters worse, every top-ranking Onmyoji will be there to observe him.

“The last thing I need is the government keeping an eye on me and interfering with the purification of my soul.”

Though he sighs at the troublesome figures in power, Itsuki never cuts corners when it comes to exterminating yokai. With his companions at his side and a formidable host of Shikigami under his command, he sets out for an unprecedented battle at sea!

“Let’s have some fun hunting ghost ships, shall we?”

The Onmyoji boy who rose again from hell returns in Volume 2 of this overwhelmingly powerful supernatural odd-jobs fantasy!

title: Re:Monster
synopsis:
After completely crushing the coup that shook the kingdom, Aporou has become a figure whose name is now known far beyond its borders. With clashes against extraordinary beings such as the Hero, the Legendary Hero, the Demon King, and the Beast King seemingly only a matter of time, Aporou follows his curiosity into a labyrinth said to have been created by the gods.

Inside awaits a dungeon filled with monsters far stronger than any he has faced before, along with even greater treasures and the finest ingredients imaginable. The new power Aporou gains from conquering the labyrinth will propel him to even greater heights!

title: Repeated Vice: I Refuse to Be Important Enough to Die
synopsis:
Lofus and Raymond charge into battle to save Lilka from an untimely death, only to come face-to-face with Lars, the first Demon Lord of the previous timeline! Lars claims that he is Lofus’s ally. He desperately tries to recruit the young Lightless heir to the side of evil, claiming that Lilka has only fed him lies, and the boy was actually meant to join forces with Lars to take over the world!

The young noble is also forced to infiltrate the Holy Dragon Land, only to get caught by Tatiana, another heroine from the game.

How will Lofus’s battle against Lars pan out? Lilka’s busy wrestling with feelings of her own, but how does Lofus feel? And Lars’s words are oddly persuasive. After all, Lilka did lie to Lofus before...and Lofus is adamant about not repeating his mistakes.

In this action-packed volume, only Lofus knows what route to take to avoid his own death.

title: The Fearsome Witch Teaches in Another World
synopsis: After her initial visit to Aqua Vitae, Aoi promises to return to finish what she started. Now she has a meeting with one of the most important people in the elven country, who happens to also be the father of Solare’s former bully. Aoi aims to change his mind—and the minds of all his fellow elves—about elven superiority, but it’s going to be an uphill battle. As backup, she’s brought Glen, Elisa, Strath, and Shenley, but they’re facing off against the self-proclaimed best sorcerers in the world. New heights, new challenges and an old face await Aoi in Aqua Vitae. It will be up to her how she navigates everything in her pursuit of advancing the standard of sorcery education across the world!

title: From Bumbling Prodigy to Villainess: Will the Duke's Love Go Unnoticed?
synopsis:
“Will I have to keep up my villainess act to return Lord Dylan’s love?!”

At long last, Avril has recognized Dylan’s love and is enjoying life to the fullest in the royal capital. Before long, however, Crown Prince Lawrence visits and asks her to accompany Dylan to a certain masked ball. After undergoing grueling dance lessons, Avril attends the masked ball. There, she uses her bumbling genius to overcome an unexpected crisis and fulfills her duty. Even so, a new problem arises. To solve it, she must visit the Duchy of Lanchester—Dylan’s old home. Avril is eager to get along with Dylan’s father—known as the decrepit, lecherous duke from the sticks—and his mistresses. Yet as soon as she arrives, she’s mistaken for a newly hired maid, of all things!

title: The Villainess' Journal: Newlywed Life of an Obsessive Researcher
synopsis:
What will ignite first: her research materials or their love?!

“Will you marry me, Villainess Estelle Aublanc?”

Estelle, a viscount’s daughter with a passion for science, loves nothing more than to conduct research in her field of expertise—magic circles. But one day, the “Ice Marquess,” Gerald, proposes marriage during their very first meeting. Her father explains that this man wants to share his life with the “ultimate villainess,” as she’s known throughout high society. But that nickname wouldn’t exist if her little sister hadn’t gone around misbehaving while using Estelle’s name! As she leaves for the marquess’ house, still unsure of what to make of the arrangement, Estelle’s father threatens to burn up all her research materials if this new marriage ends in a divorce.

“That leaves me no choice. If I don’t become the villainess he’s looking for, all of my data will be destroyed. How did it ever come to this?”

Estelle decides to live as a villainess to protect her precious research, all while keeping a journal of her daily life at the home of the Ice Marquess.

title: Keep Me Close: Finding My Home in You
synopsis:
When Claudia’s father passes away, she’s convinced she’ll never find happiness again. Forced to work as a servant in her own home rather than inherit the family business, she’s ridiculed and tormented by her stepmother and sister day in and day out. To make matters worse, she’s falsely accused of a crime she didn’t commit, stripped of her noble status, and banished to the farthest reaches of the kingdom.

There, she’s prepared for a life of hardship living with Duke Julius Graz—a man so cruel that it earned him the moniker of the “unmelting ice sculpture.” But the cold and heartless man Claudia expected to meet is nowhere to be found. Instead, he welcomes her with warmth in food, new clothes, and kindness she thought she’d never again receive.

With Julius on her side, Claudia works to overcome the wounds of her past and find the confidence to clear her name. And maybe, just maybe, find a new home where she can truly belong.

title: Didn't I Say to Make My Abilities Average in the Next Life?!
synopsis:
BELLES OF THE BALL!

Princess-slash-Arch-Saint Estorina has a wild favor to ask of the Wonder Trio—and to see it through, Marcela, Mile, and Mavis will have to attend a ball at the royal palace, soak up the limelight, and turn the whole party upside down! The chaos continues when a pretty young girl drops in from beyond the stars, followed by more hijinks with the elder dragons. There’s never a dull moment for the invincible girls of the Crimson Vow!

title: Her Royal Highness Seems to Be Angry
synopsis: To solve the mystery of the white-cloaked man and the black fog, Leticiel turns to Nirvaan's royal library for answers. There, she encounters a strange and sinister message in one of the library's books...But before she can uncover more, Leticiel learns of a mass uprising within the Filiaregis duchy! Chaos is spreading throughout the region, and it's up to Leticiel to set things right. Can Leticiel mete out justice before it's too late?

title: Housekeeping Mage from Another World: Making Your Adventures Feel Like Home!
synopsis: Now that they’re roommates, Shiori and Alec are paving their way toward a beautiful life together. Alec has decided to face his past, and arranges a meeting with his brother Olivier as well as his former lover, Rebecca—to apologize, make amends, and look forward to a brighter future, one unburdened by regrets. Before that, however, he and Shiori start their search for a place to turn into an adventurer sharehouse and education center. As luck would have it, the perfect place has just landed in their laps, except for one little snag: There might just be a couple of ghosts in the attic!

title: I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class
synopsis:
A SURPRISE GIFT FROM THE STORK?

Just as Saito and Akane’s relationship is on the mend after another storm of misunderstandings, a new addition joins the household: Akane’s little sister Maho! Akane swings into full mother-mode as she dotes on Maho, while Saito is swept up in the chaos of having to live with not one, but two Sakuramori girls.

To make matters worse, Maho suddenly approaches Akane with a shocking proposal that leaves the newlyweds rocked to the core. Akane realizes that what Maho asks for is the one thing Akane cannot give her spoiled sibling. Can the newlyweds face both their fears and their feelings and end up stronger than ever?

title: Miss Medic's Diary at War
synopsis: The Sabat Union has rejected Austin’s unconditional surrender! Now, Major Lenvil must cobble together what remains of the Austinese Army and prepare for war once again. Unfortunately, every combat medic was wiped out during the Sylph Attacks...all except for Tory. As the last one standing, it’s only natural that she’s put in charge of Austin’s new health squad as its chief combat medic. Tory has her work cut out for her since not only are all the members amateurs but almost all of them are older than her! How is a fifteen-year-old supposed to be a squad commander?  In the army, a superior’s orders are absolute, but how can she keep them in line when she’s so weak? All Tory can do is stumble through navigating her new role and hold on until they can reconvene with the Southern Field Army!

title: The Apothecary Diaries
synopsis: The fallout from an insect plague weighs heavily on I-sei Province. Although Jinshi wants to aid the distressed land, he knows his power doesn't stretch as far in the western capital. What if his efforts only serve to feed the prestige of Gyoku-ou? Ruling on behalf of his absent father, Gyoku-ou keeps his motives to himelf. Though nobles vying for prominence are none of Maomao's concern, trouble always finds her; an ill child and a mystery surrounding Lakan's favorite shogi opponent occupy her time. But unraveling each riddle only creates a new one...

title: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior
synopsis:
FALLING FROM GRACE

Ever since her shocking transformation at Tiara’s birthday party, Pride has become increasingly erratic. Her kind words and gestures of goodwill are nowhere to be found, replaced by vile outbursts and self-isolation. As her nearest and dearest agonize over her condition, one man rises up to put an end to the chaos: Arthur, her dear friend and imperial knight. Will his pleas reach this heartless new version of the princess, or have her dalliances with destiny doomed them to be bitter enemies?

title: Déjà Vute: Betrayal Begets New Beginnings
synopsis:
“Did you really think he loved you?”

On the verge of death, Freesia learns the soul-crushing truth: her fiancé, Vute, has betrayed her. Her beloved younger sister, Kalmia, has yet again taken something precious from her.

Then Freesia opens her eyes and finds herself two years in the past.

With a second chance at life, she resolves to cast aside everything Kalmia once stole from her—her engagement, the people who abandoned her, and the life that led to her ruin. This time, she’ll live on her own terms.

There is just one problem. For some reason, Vute refuses to let go of their betrothal, and little by little, Freesia finds herself backed into a corner...

title: Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash
synopsis:
The star fell, the two gods reemerged, and the children of humanity were reduced to servants.
With fate having thrust yet another burden on him, Haruhiro’s journey isn’t over yet...
“Awaken.”
A boy awakens. His comrades are nowhere to be seen. Where is he? The masked man in front of him says, “That’s...your name, is it? Manato?”
Grimgar has become a battlefield where the believers of Lumiaris and servants of Skullhell fight a neverending battle. Manato will live in this new land rife with death. Together with a new group of comrades, he must cut a path for himself through the light and the darkness!

title: An Otaku Prince Finds Love in Akiba
synopsis:
A love story that crosses nations and status between the otaku prince and the game developer who stole his heart.

Charmed by the poignant simplicity of an indie game called Hanabi, Alphonse Eklund, fifth prince of Edihara, knows he has to meet the Japanese developer behind his favorite game. It has no quests or battles, only a small sparkler that burns down to nothing. Against his father’s better judgment, he moves to Japan to do exactly that. But Akito, the game’s sole creator, turns out to be an anxious university student who has no faith in his work. 

Bewildered at first, Alphonse soon becomes determined to make Akito see his creations’ true worth. Concealing his royal identity, Alphonse starts visiting the café where Akito works, closing the distance between them little by little. The closer they grow, the harder it is to keep his heart—and his hands—to himself.

title: I'm Running for Crown Princess, but All I Want is a Steady Paycheck!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

One woman is out to get a much-needed payday by competing to be the next crowned princess—but she’ll find the competition is fiercer than she could have ever imagined! And don’t miss the manga adaptation , also from Seven Seas.

When Therese decides to try her luck at the castle, she’s not looking to snag the position of crown princess. She’s only after the lavish sign-up bonus the castle offers to candidates. Her father may be a marquis, but his pockets are empty, so Therese needs to earn money herself.

Still, other young ladies are eager to compete for the role of crown princess. And once Therese reaches the castle, she’s going to be witnessing that competition up close. The proceedings seem sure to stir up drama; can Therese avoid getting dragged into it by keeping her nose to the grindstone?

title: Mirror, Mirror on the Wall
synopsis: Former child actor turned struggling idol Eiri is on the verge of being fired from his agency when he’s handpicked by Shoui, a perfectionist photographer whose model is treated as nothing less—and nothing more—than his muse. As this generation’s muse, Eiri knows that Shoui will sleep with him if he asks, but that won’t melt the icy walls around the notoriously distant genius’s heart. Determined not to fall too deeply in love, Eiri suppresses his feelings for over a decade...until the day a new muse appears. Now Eiri must choose which fear he’s willing to face: potentially being rejected, or losing his only shot before he even has a chance.

title: Reincarnated Into a Game as the Hero's Friend: Running the Kingdom Behind the Scenes
synopsis:
RESOLVE AND REVELATIONS

After falling into a trap set by the demons, Werner von Zehrfeld faces his greatest challenge yet. Not only has Lily been abducted, but a large army of monsters is steadily approaching the royal capital. This is the moment Werner has long been preparing for, ever since awakening to his memories of having played the game this world was based on. But between his fiancée now being in the clutches of a mysterious demon with a connection to a past hero, and the many mysteries he uncovered at the underground library, not even a walkthrough guide would be enough to save the day! With the war against the demons reaching a fever pitch, can Werner save Lily without sacrificing the city?

title: Fired? But I Maintain All the Software!
synopsis: After turning down Eito Kanzaki’s one-billion-yen offer and helping two unique individuals overcome their traumas, Ai Sato is now faced with the challenge of recruiting a virtual idol to promote the platform she’s developing with Megumi. Given her lack of experience in this sphere, how will she navigate her foray into a virtual world fraught with surprises?

title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
synopsis:
After suffering a defeat at the hands of Marchosias, Zagan has yet to regain consciousness. As his faction finds itself on the brink of an unprecedented crisis, Nephteros, alongside Archangel Richard, rises to save her brother-in-law from this predicament!
In their quest for a way to wake Zagan up, they view old memories and finally meet the seraph sealed within Sacred Sword Camael—the light of hope that will bring salvation!

title: Fleet-Footed Dungeon Delver: Tune in for Magical Girls and Motion Blur!
synopsis:
On an alternative Earth filled with fantasy dungeons, Nonomura Nodoka dreams of making it as a dungeon streamer. As one of the world’s superpowered delvers, she braves the dungeons’ depths in search of treasure, glory, and internet fame...whenever she can get her streams to stop crashing. Her luck changes when she saves up-and-coming streamer Hachisuka Subaru from a mutant cerberus, and Subaru discovers that Nodoka moves too fast for cameras to capture.

With Subaru's savvy showmanship and Nodoka's ridiculous speed, the two form an unlikely team. Now these two girls are racing to the big leagues hand in hand—and leaving their competition in the dust!

title: Isekai Tensei: Recruited to Another World
synopsis:
Tenma’s back in the capital after his journey to the Haust margravate, and now it’s time to weather a storm of marriage mix-ups, love confessions, and furious girls! 

No sooner has he returned than Maria confronts him in a full-blown rage over his latest misstep. One thing leads to another, and before he knows it, he’s somehow agreed to marry Primera?!

And that’s just the beginning! Stepping up to stand in for Amy’s family at an academy party, Tenma watches Tida gather all his courage to confess his feelings—only for the young man to faint in shock at Amy’s reply. Wait, is that really what she meant?

While Tenma’s faced lots of enemies, this might be his biggest challenge yet!

title: Isekai Tensei: Recruited to Another World
synopsis: Tenma’s triumphant tournament win leads straight to his boldest move yet! He asks noble beauty Primera to dance at the celebration ball, and as they spin across the dance floor, rumors of their engagement explode overnight...and Tenma actually does pop the question! However, there’s no time to bask in the afterglow: Between creating a brand-new type of golem and surviving the chaos of dungeon diving, Tenma’s hands are full. Meanwhile, the legendary adventuring party, the Dawnswords, returns from conquering the Sagan dungeon and is recovering at Tenma’s estate while awaiting royal recognition. What new adventures await as Tenma’s world grows even more unpredictable—and a little more romantic—in this whirlwind 12th volume?

title: Making Magic: The Sweet Life of a Witch Who Knows an Infinite MP Loophole
synopsis: After ten years resettling the new residents of the Witch of Creation’s Forest, wanderlust strikes Chise again. Itching to embark on a new journey, but weary of her fame, she decides to blow her copious reserves of mana on disguising herself. Forging a new identity as a C-rank adventurer and marginally older girl, she departs with her bestie Teto for the Sunfield Empire. The pair spend their days in leisure until a job gone wildly off-track lands them an invitation to the elves’ great forest, an enigmatic place where outsiders are rarely welcomed. Eager to learn more about elves’ customs and culture, Chise eagerly accepts the invitation. But who knows what awaits them there?

title: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer! This White Mage Is One Heck of a Healer
synopsis: Boot camp is over, and Lloyd and his party are back to normal days of average adventuring—not that it will last for very long. Soon, the party is asked to join a convoy that will deliver Claira back to the imperial capital, but just a few days before the journey is set to begin, Lloyd...is kidnapped?! Thankfully, it’s only by Master Merlin. Regardless, Yui and the rest set out on the quest without him, fearing the worst...

title: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows
synopsis:
With the Ashen Harvest neutralized, Zenos at last finds himself able to return to the slums. He and the gang decide to celebrate with some rest and relaxation via camping! Enjoying the fading warmth of early autumn, they swim in a nearby lake, dine on delicious soup, and in the dark of the night, gather around the campfire to tell ghost stories. But just as Carmilla finishes her tale about a mysterious being known as Galhamut—King of the Fell Dragons—a strange girl stumbles into their camp. She claims to be nothing more than a maid, but it quickly becomes obvious that she’s on the run. Begrudgingly, Zenos agrees to conceal her, even as he feels the situation around him taking a turn for the complicated once again. 
Elsewhere in the Kingdom of Herzeth, a room at the top of a tall white tower lies empty, and the Royal Guard scurries around in a panic. Zenos has brought home someone they cannot afford to lose...

title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy
synopsis:
Having apprehended Izabella’s attacker and the mastermind behind Fallforal’s destruction, Anos is rewarded with the promotion of Militia’s World into the Holy Six Academies. With the Demon King Academy occupying the exclusive sixth seat of the alliance, Anos is granted the knowledge of how Pablohetra was once formed.

Yet looming over all is the Ruinous Abyss World Evezeino’s ruler and chief god, the Disastrous One Izark, whose awakening from a seemingly endless sleep draws near. When Anos discovers an ancient promise was once made between Izark and Oldof, the previous king and ruler of the Holy Sword World Hyphoria, the possibility for peace between Evezeino and Hyphoria suddenly becomes tangible. In order to resolve the long-standing feud between the two worlds and prevent a devastating war from breaking out, Anos will have to track down Oldof—and his promise—himself. The Holy Sword World arc begins here!

title: Argonaut: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Tales of Heroes
synopsis: This is a tale that takes place in the distant past, long before the Gods’ blessing came to the land. It is the legend of a hero, still told today in its various forms. He was by no means the strongest or most inspiring figure from history, so how did Argonaut come to be called the First Hero? It is the story of a fool, someone with improper dreams, beholden to the many whims of others—yet who persevered. A comedy to echo through the ages.

title: Catalog of Wonders
synopsis: Nozome and Nieno have been working together for a long time, gathering despair from humans through curious items like Extra Days, Secret Seasonings, and Read-It-Before Bookmarks. But how exactly did these two Inhumans first meet, and how did they get involved with these peculiar catalogs? Just like the goods they peddle, there’s more to this story than meets the eye!

title: Days with My Stepsister
synopsis: Saki and Yuuta have finally found a small group of people who accept their relationship, but big changes are coming for them as they enter their final year of high school. The pair must navigate being in the same class, preparing for college entrance exams, and planning for the future as they approach their new family's first anniversary. They've grown so much closer over the past year, but it may be time to reevaluate that distance.

title: High School DxD
synopsis: It’s third term, and Xenovia’s running for Kuou Academy’s student council president! Issei and the others have their hands full supporting her, which means it’s the perfect time for something to go horribly wrong! A group of exorcists stages a coup within the Church, and Xenovia and Irina have been tasked with quashing it. Xenovia already had plenty on her mind with the election coming up, but once the identities of the coup leaders are brought to light, running for president will be the least of her worries…

title: I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History
synopsis: I, Alicia Williams—undercover in Laval as Lia—am making incredible strides in my efforts to build a villainous reputation. I've hit a major milestone…by recruiting my very own assassin! So it's time to show my new underling just how amazing his master is. Laval is plagued by a nearly incurable disease, so whoever acquires the rare madi flower and creates a cure will have the country in the palm of their hand! Only one thing stands between me and the cure: opponents so overpowered they rival Duke. This world sure has been holding out on me, but at least I can go down in a blaze of glory.

title: Kusunoki's Garden of Gods
synopsis: Minato sets about repairing the vine bridge on the mountain in an effort to restore people’s belief in the Yamagami. To do that, he’s going to need a lot of help—but after using Fujin’s power to fix up the mountain path and selling some carvings imbued with the four spirits’ protection, that dream gets a lot closer! Seeing Minato working so hard, the martens give their all trying to get more accustomed to humans and looking after their new younger brother, the flying squirrel divine spirit. But meanwhile in town, something seems to be keeping the onmyoji busy…

title: Magical Explorer
synopsis: As the dust settles from Kousuke’s time-travelling adventure, a group of students from Susanoo Martial Arts Academy come to Tsukuyomi to promote their school’s Martial Arts Tournament. Winning the competition is a must for Kousuke to secure the game’s true ending, but that’s no small task when the Beast King of Susanoo, the favorite to win, is way out of Kousuke’s league. To power themselves up, Kousuke and his friends resolve to clear a grueling dungeon where his party members will each have to confront their deepest childhood traumas...and Kousuke will finally have to come clean about his secret. But are they tough enough in mind and body to survive the trials that lay in store?

title: My Girlfriend Cheated on Me, and Now My Flirty Underclassman Won't Leave Me Alone
synopsis:
NEVER EVER GETTING BACK TOGETHER?

In the days leading up to Christmas, Hasegawa Yuuta’s life was thrown into disarray when he discovered his girlfriend was cheating on him. He’s since tried to move on and tried to focus on enjoying the new semester with his flirty underclassman, Shinohara Mayu, and his longtime friend, Mino Ayaka. But after his ex claimed that she actually didn’t cheat on him, everything’s been thrown into question. Does Yuuta dare consider that it may have all been one big misunderstanding?

title: On the Way Home After Defeating the Demon King
synopsis: The prophesied hero Yuma and his party have successfully slain the Demon King, and it’s now time for the final leg of their adventure: the return home. However, what should be a joyous occasion takes a turn when one member abruptly leaves, spurning the rewards and acclaim awaiting them. Yuma quickly realizes that although they risked their lives together to defeat a common enemy, he and his comrades are almost complete strangers. The route back to the capital becomes an opportunity to hear his companions’ life stories, and some of the things he learns will shock him to his core…

title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Short Story Collection
synopsis: Tales from all eras of the Re:Zero world! Having finally been released from their curse, the demon sisters working at Roswaal Manor decide to celebrate together. Natsumi Schwartz makes her long-awaited reappearance—this time joined by two strange new beauties. And a witch who left the Sanctuary to find freedom tells a young girl the conditions to become one of her kind. The irreplaceable past, invaluable present, and inconceivable future come together in this new collection of short stories!

title: Rise of the Lowborn: Ascending the Ranks by Crushing Incompetent Nobles
synopsis: Hazen Heim is a newly appointed imperial military officer who had the poor luck of being born without a silver spoon in his mouth. This means that instead of landing a cushy nepotism gig, he’s being sent to the front lines to deal with the worst of the worst. Awaiting him are scumbag supervisors who constantly steal credit, low-life leaders who love to abuse their power, and bumbling members of the brass who have never had to make a hard decision once in their lives. Fortunately, Hazen racked up decades of knowledge and experience in his past life as a legendary mage. Now it’s his turn to put the tyrants in their place, and they’re going to learn that when they go low, he goes lower…

title: The Azure Sword, Slayer of Distortions
synopsis: Having risked his life in battle to defy fate, Shin Karamori returns to his daily high school life. However, with Tyrfing’s curse still hanging over his head, Karamori can’t help but feel burnt out. While off on a mission with Hitsugi, he meets a girl named Yura Hitoribe whose distortion renders her invisible to humans. Yura wants to be in a band, which seems impossible given her condition, but Karamori and Archive want to help make her wish come true. The azure clash that ensues is a cry for freedom that resonates with them all!

title: The Demon King Seems to Have Infiltrated the Hero's Party
synopsis: Kyle was reincarnated into a new world as a member of the hero’s party. He’s forged unbreakable bonds with his crew over the course of their journey—Noelle the High Priestess, Dal the thief, Tiger the beastfolk, Sasha the mage, and Eclair the hero. Their expedition appears to be going well, but before long, a goddess appears before Kyle and tells him an earth-shattering truth: one of his dear friends is actually the Demon King in disguise. Can he figure out the identity of his greatest foe before it’s too late?!

title: The Empty Box and Zeroth Maria Collector's Edition
synopsis:
Kazuki Hoshino treasures nothing more than his ordinary life, and March 2 should have been an ordinary day. The arrival of a transfer student, the mysterious Aya Otonashi, shouldn't have shattered the world he knows. He's never seen this girl before in his life, but she says she's met him thousands of times--and declares war on him for a crime he can't even remember... As the truth begins to unravel, nothing is as it seems, and at the heart of it all is a wish powerful enough to change everything. 

Read all seven books of this beloved series in a beautiful collector’s edition!

title: The Executioner and Her Way of Life
synopsis: To save both her own world and Japan, Menou must face off against Hakua, the very girl who created her. Just as it seems Menou and her allies will emerge victorious, however, Hakua manages to turn the tables and teleports herself, Menou, and Akari to a new world of her own design.
