In this idealized Japan, Menou experiences peace and material abundance for the first time in her life, while Akari and Hakua get to live a version of their high school days they could only have dreamed of. But the beauty of the nascent realm comes with a price—it’s absorbing the real Earth with potentially disastrous consequences. Do Menou, Akari, and Hakua have it in them to join hands and put a stop to the assimilation process?

title: The Story of the Moon Waiting for the Evening
synopsis: High schooler Yohana Sakaki lives in a town full of ghosts, spirits, and other ethereal beings, where the eminent Yashiro family is tasked with keeping these beings in check. Yohana has distant ties to the family, but she lacks any abilities and has resigned herself to an ordinary life. When she falls into a pond at the Yashiro estate, she seems to catch the eye of a high-ranking member of the Yashiro hierarchy—only to be ignored in favor of another girl, who strangely had the same accident. Having apparently lost her golden opportunity, Yohana is instead aided by a mysterious young boy named Chitose, who has little status but quite a few secrets. And when she begins spending time with him and assisting in his spiritual work, she learns that her destiny may have changed more than she realized—but whether for good or ill, no one can yet say.

title: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside By My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom
synopsis:
WEDDING CRASHERS

Mia and Prince Fernand are tying the knot! Though eager to attend her sister’s wedding, Philia is apprehensive about returning to Girtonia, the land that sold her away. Her fears prove justified when the nuptials are interrupted by Erza announcing a demon has infiltrated the castle! Even worse, the disgraced Prince Julius seems to have a hand in this newest mess. But nothing can compare to the greatest shock of all—when they finally face off against this demonic foe, Philia finds she cannot use her magic! What could possibly nullify an Archsaint’s power? And does she stand a chance without any of her hard-won skills?

title: The World's Strongest Witch
synopsis: Oblivious to her growing reputation as both a powerful threat and a godlike savior, Lorna heads for Webenheim, the royal capital. But the so-called City of Gold is full of temptations, and Lorna soon finds herself addicted to slots! Despite the riches she's amassed so far, she quickly racks up massive debt. Can her new friend, a merchant who isn't quite what she seems, help Lorna recoup her losses in a high-stakes street vendor competition?

title: Valkyrie Bullet
synopsis: In the near future, Earth has been invaded by monsters from another world called giju, forcing humanity into a never-ending war for survival. Conventional weapons are ineffective; the world’s only hope lies in the Valkyrie Dress—suits of powered battle armor with extraordinary combat abilities that can only be piloted by women. However, one day, a man is transferred to the Third Academy, where the ladies who wear these dresses of hardened steel are trained. His name: Ren Hifumi, the test pilot for a prototype humanoid weapon created to combat the giju that has never had a successful trial run…until now.

title: A Tale of the Secret Saint ZERO
synopsis:
SAINT SERAFINA’S TIME TO SHINE!

An unexpected encounter with a demon shakes the kingdom to its core, prompting Sirius to arrange for Serafina to be sent far from the castle, lest the demon return. But Serafina has plans of her own. Disappointed that she had fainted in the face of danger, she secretly decides to train with the Saint Knight Brigade to toughen up. Training, however, isn’t quite what Serafina expected. She finds herself dealing with chaos caused by knight captains under a monster’s spell, her father’s sudden desire to become a knight himself, and traveling to an orphanage to heal an injured knight, who happens to be a familiar face. This may not be what she bargained for, but Serafina is determined to do her best to prove she’s got what it takes to be a saint!

title: Royal Spirits Are a Royal Pain! Give Me a Regular Romance
synopsis:
Bon voyage, Deirdre! In recognition of Azelia’s assistance in restoring peace to neighboring Luftanen, Deirdre and her family have been invited to attend a Luftanese royal wedding. It’s time for Deirdre’s first ever trip to the island nation...but it’s not all fun and games. With the third and fourth princes both unaccounted for, danger lurks around every corner.

Intrepid Deirdre answers the Royal Spirits’ plea for her to assist in the princes’ capture—as bait! What originally seemed like a relaxing vacation is now part diplomatic mission, part sightseeing excursion, and part undercover sting operation!

As she balances her duties as a fairy princess with her longing to soak in all the new sights and flavors, will Deir ever find the time to work toward her ultimate goal of experiencing romance...?

title: The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash
synopsis:
“EVEN IF I’M LOST, I STILL CHOOSE MY OWN PATH!”

After discovering the church was behind the drug epidemic all along, trash-collector Ivy and her friends make quick work of demolishing the cartel’s processing facility in a cave, luring out the nobles who had been in cahoots with the church, discover a new summoning circle, and rid the village of all evil! Whew! But just when she’s riding the high of a job well done, Ivy is floored by a shocking truth that leads her to connect the dots of an unthinkable connection between the church and the fortune teller from her past… But despite the doubts and fears now clouding her heart, Ivy isn’t ready to call it quits just yet. Trusting in her own judgement, she presses onward!

title: Too Many Losing Heroines! Short Stories
synopsis:
THE SECRET LIVES OF LOSING HEROINES

For the first time, over forty short stories that were bundled as purchase bonuses, made available at events, or were a part of a collaboration with Toyohashi’s Nonhoi Park, are now available all together in English!

Sometimes sweet, sometimes silly, take a glimpse into the lives of the many losing heroines in between their tales of love and loss.

title: The Vampire and the Chocolatier
synopsis: Coming soon.

title: Free Life Fantasy Online: Immortal Princess
synopsis:
RELEASE THE KRAKEN!

Tsukushiro Kotone, aka Anastasia the Immortal Princess, has reached level 50 and has evolved yet again! And what better way to test out her new skills than a world quest to defend the port city of Imbamunte. The players of Free Life Fantasy Online must board a warship together to fight off all manner of aquatic monsters threatening to drag them down to the depths. Meanwhile, Anastasia and the other flying players take to the skies for a different kind of battle. Can they come out on top in Free Life Fantasy Online ’s very first naval battle?

title: Magic Maker: How to Create Magic in Another World
synopsis:
MAGICAL LESSONS ARE NOW IN SESSION!

Thanks to Shion’s magical prowess, he discovers the cure for a mysterious new illness that has been ravaging the kingdom. Word of Shion’s exclusive knowledge and accomplishments reach the highest levels of the nation, and the queen orders him to teach students in the royal capital about magic and how it works. Shion’s new role as teacher is anything but smooth sailing, though, as his aristocratic students from diverse backgrounds are skeptical of his ideas from the get-go. Magical experiments are one thing, but trying to change rigid minds is a battle not so easily won! Can a mere commoner like Shion convince the royal echelons of society of magic’s existence?

FINAL VOLUME

title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
synopsis: Dokja’s companions, who had been scattered all over the Seoul, gather on a quiet island in the middle of the Han River. There is no time for a happy reunion, however, as the long dreaded finale of the fifth scenario begins! Being the sole reader of TWSA, Dokja knows that the Catastrophe of Floods is the most powerful of them all, and the most tragic. That’s why he has been building up to this moment—his master plan to turn it all around! But this time, the bad ending he wants to change seems all but written in the very stars above…

title: Reluctant Space Commander: From Death Wish to Galactic Hero!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

Things aren’t exactly what Nao was expecting upon completing the impossible refurbishment of the astro-destroyer Verna Somnus . The third princess’s warm welcome back to the capital comes with an irrefusable invite: captain the flagship of the government agency she’s founding, the Regionwide Criminal Investigation Agency.

At the princess’s side, Nao’s swept into glamorous parties to bump shoulders with influential nobles—only further solidifying his reputation…and pushing him farther and farther from his dreams of a heroic death. But when he and his crew stumble upon the space pirates’ secret base, Nao sees the perfect chance to die in the line of duty. Has his time come at last?

title: Grinding My Way to a Happy Ending: If Only My OP Big Bro Didn't Make Things So (Sister) Complex!
synopsis:
Former office worker Reine is delighted to be reincarnated into an otome game as the beautiful protagonist Renee Wainwright. Or she was, until she realizes the game was notorious for hiding its romance routes behind a grueling grind. Worse still, she’s at the very bottom of the academy’s social ladder and on the verge of expulsion, all while she doesn’t even have the protagonist’s memories as aid.

Fortunately, Renee’s tough previous life has sharpened her resolve. Armed with an iron will, she’s determined to climb the ranks, win over one of the love interests, and rewrite her fate. If only her elite and estranged older brother would stop inserting himself into every corner of his “amnesiac” sister’s life! Can Renee beat the odds and claw her way to the top? And what is that her brother seems to be hiding?

title: Worthless at Home, Whiz to the World
synopsis:
After his safe promotion to A-rank adventurer, Noa is given his next training task: Participate in the next Great Sword Festival for the title of Swordmaster.

As soon as they arrive in Elbania, the First Princess Merlia approaches the party for help. According to her, the First Prince is plotting to usurp the throne, and she needs them to win the Great Sword Festival to prevent it. But the competition is fierce, featuring the warmonger Godart, the wanderer Kikujiro, the runner-up from last tournament, Alzarof... and even the tournament’s sponsor—Noa’s eldest sister Aeria—makes an appearance!

title: Being Famous Is NEET! Going Sister-Rank on Livestream
synopsis:
Suzuta Maya is a bright and cheery high school girl who also happens to be a streamer signed with a talent agency. But she’s not the protagonist of this story. That honor belongs to her older brother, Jin—an unemployed loafer who may love his little sister a little too much, but whose heart is always in the right place. So when Maya goes to the dungeon to stream her battles, Jin happily serves as both cameraman and security guard.

Everything changes when a trap sends Maya straight into an encounter with a deadly S-rank monster. Jin steps in without a second thought, unaware that his incredible feat has just been broadcast live to the world. Suddenly on the fast track to becoming a streaming sensation, Jin is about to discover what surprises await him in a modern world with a magical twist.

title: I Parry Everything
synopsis:
Milva, the Magic Empire’s headstrong new empress, pays the Kingdom of Clays a surprise visit. But while our heroes prepare to throw her a welcome banquet, two mysterious figures—with curiously tapered ears—set in motion a surprise of their own.
Thankfully, Noor and the others aren’t alone. Chief among them is Rei, the Phantom Princess, whose Gift makes her invisible to just about everyone. Will she be able to save the day? Will anyone even notice if she does? And what about Noor’s new publishing deal?!

title: Tearmoon Empire
synopsis: Thank the moons! Mia is finally back home from Ganudos! But just when she thinks it’s time to enjoy a relaxing winter break, a request from the Holy Lady throws a wrench in her plans. The son of Count-Bishop Lucina of the Holy Principality of Belluga is about to enroll in Saint-Noel Academy, and Rafina wants to make sure he doesn’t take the seat of student council president (for very non-selfish reasons, of course). The only problem is that according to Ludwig’s diary, if Mia wins this student council election, Bel will never be born! Welp, that’s certainly a problem. Whatever shall she do?

title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires
synopsis:
Elizabeth Leiston, daughter of the influential prime minister, is a picture-perfect lady on the path to becoming the future queen of the Kingdom of Haldoria. But her life takes a sudden turn for the worst when her fiancé makes a show of publicly calling off their engagement. Soon after, he throws her in jail and starts spreading nasty rumors about her.

The encouragement Elizabeth receives from her loyal waiting maid, Mireille, and her inner fury are all she needs to reconsider her goals. Why should she continue devoting herself to a country that doesn’t respect her when she can trample over it instead? She will get even with those who wronged her and bring down the damned kingdom, even if it’s the last thing she does! Luckily, Elizabeth is no damsel in distress and has seven powerful magic grimoires she won’t hesitate to use. Get ready because this ruthless lady is out for blood!

title: Elegance in Exile: From Alchemy to Luxury with My Ardent Knight
synopsis:
Raised to be the perfect consort to the crown prince, Anrietta Augustia’s careful plans for the future come crashing down when her fiancé publicly breaks off their engagement, calling her a foul witch and exiling her from the kingdom. For a sheltered daughter of a duke like Anrietta, it’s essentially a death sentence...but fate has one more twist in store.

The crown prince’s dramatics awaken something buried deep within her: memories of her past life as a mighty sorceress, along with a powerful gift waiting to be used. With her newfound knowledge and power, Anrietta decides to set out and start anew. First, though, she'll need a servant—one who will never betray her the way those she trusted did in this life...or the last.

title: Formerly, the Fallen Daughter of the Duke
synopsis: Claire’s precious incense burner has been stolen, and Paffuto teeters on the brink of war with Ignice! Together with Vik and her friends, she must join the diplomatic delegation to the empire and brave the tangled web of politics that is the Ignicean court. But when disaster strikes before the delegation even crosses the border, Claire finds herself facing her greatest challenge yet. An amnesiac prince, a sinister prophet, an old friend destined to turn traitor—how can Claire hope to save them all?

title: Invaders of the Rokujouma!?
synopsis:
After Kenji leaves with the Gray Knight, Koutarou swears to rescue him once more.  Meanwhile, with the fate of Forthorthe on the line, the fleet showdown against Maxfern is about to begin. Residual thoughts will be the key to defeat Maxfern, who has taken over the body of his descendant. In the center of the operation to reclaim those residual thoughts are Elexis and the former members of Darkness Rainbow!

It’s time to team up with space pirates to target the enemy’s heart in volume 49!

title: It Was Supposed to Be My Second Life, but It Turned Out to Be My Third So I'll Change History with Knowledge and Reform
synopsis:
“This time, I’ll protect my family—no matter what.”

Takheel, a young baron branded as useless, could do nothing as the people he loved were taken from him. But at the moment of death, a sudden awakening of time-space magic sends him spiraling back to childhood—along with memories from lives even further back.

War and plague won’t break him again.

Armed with modern knowledge, Takheel starts building what his world has never seen: waterwheels, dried noodles, and even crossbows. He supports his struggling parents, forces his brother’s doomed fate off its rails, and turns the Solis barony into a thriving, resilient domain—mitigating crop failures, floods, and famine while recruiting talent by any means necessary.

But his shameless, all-in tactics don’t stop at saving one household. Before long, his “family-first” revolution ripples beyond the Kyle Kingdom, stirring a continent-wide wave of history itself being rewritten.

A once-in-a-generation prodigy takes on a tragic destiny—and a rebellion unlike anything this world has ever witnessed begins.

title: Middle-Aged and Mid No More: Rising in Ranks over Drinks with an Elite Priest
synopsis:
At thirty-two, veteran tank Rondo Glass is known as Forever Silver, a worn-down adventurer with a tarnished badge, patched-up gear, and no party left to call his own. But after one night of drunken misery leads him to Lydia Claystia, a legendary Adamantite Rank priest buckling under impossible expectations, Rondo finds himself dragged back toward the dream he’d all but abandoned.

Between monster hordes and assassins, new friends and old, and the Guild’s dreams of dragon slaying, Rondo will have every lesson from his fifteen years in the field put to the test. He may not be the strongest adventurer around, but he knows one thing better than anyone: how to protect the people who count on him.
Silver Rank or not, Rondo’s second chance starts now!

title: Min-Maxing My TRPG Build in Another World
synopsis:
Commissioned in death to save a world in peril, a tabletop RPG fanatic is reborn as a humble farm boy with the rulebook for the universe at his fingertips! Young Erich’s quest for an invincible character build will require more than his decades as a number-crunching munchkin, though. Even with power-leveled skills, feudal life is no cakewalk—especially when you keep drawing more attention than you can handle…

Can Erich adapt to his strange new world before his worst impulses take the campaign of a lifetime completely off the rails? Let the dice fall where they may!

title: The Water Magician: Arc 1
synopsis:
Ryo is living his best second life in Phi and doing as he pleases. Ever the adventurer, he accepts an escort job for a merchant heading to the Principality of Inverey. Unfortunately, he forgot to withdraw money before leaving the Kingdom of Knightley, so he finds himself at a complete loss in its capital and penniless in a foreign land. In order to return to Lune where all his friends are, he takes on another escort mission, this time back to the Kingdom of Knightley...or so he thought! The job actually has him acting as the body double for a prince being targeted by assassins, but then the real prince ends up kidnapped anyway?!

A major power’s ulterior motives and the real reason the prince is being targeted lurk in the shadows. However, to each and every problem that falls in his lap, Ryo’s solution is always simple: “I’ll bury anyone who gets in my way in the permafrost!” The adventures of the strongest freewheeling water magician continue in this frenetic third volume!

title: History of the Kingdom of Orcsen: How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came to Burn Down the Peaceful Elfland
synopsis:
THEN IT’S WAR. LET US BEGIN.

Though known for his wise and reasonable rule, King Gustav of Orcsen can also be quite cunning. With the hopes and dreams of his people riding on him, Gustav begins laying down the foundations for his next ingenuous scheme against Elfland.

Dinerúth, head of a dark elf clan, had her old life ripped away in a despicable act of genocide—by her own country’s ruling class. After receiving asylum in Orcsen, Dinerúth swore herself to King Gustav, in heart, body, and soul. But these blissful days between them are short-lived.

For Orcsen—its blades now unsheathed and fully sharpened—has finally declared war on Elfland!

title: I Like Villains, so I Reincarnated as One
synopsis:
LIKE A BEE TO HONEY

Weiss Hamilton was just a boss in a game, doomed to defeat. But when an avid fan wakes up one day as Weiss himself, he suddenly has access to cheat codes beyond his wildest dreams! This newfound knowledge pushes Weiss to victory, and even helps repair his relationship with his former foe of a sister.

Still, success is hard won. When Weiss goes on a territory investigation, he encounters the Twelve Apostles of Hades—new enemies who seem to have some tasty tricks up their sleeves. Will Weiss be able to resist the sweet temptations they put forth?

title: Sakamoto Days: Assassin's Blues
synopsis: The Sakamotos try to enjoy a family vacation at the hot springs, but will their hit man history land them in hot water? Then, in a throwback to Sakamoto’s school days, follow the young assassin in training on a midnight heist to steal test questions. From part-time job panic to dessert date disasters, find these tales and more in this short story collection full of Sakamoto Days hijinks!

title: Trapezium
synopsis:
Grab your light sticks, practice your chants, and get ready for the realest look into Japan’s idol culture in this gripping, coming-of-age story—written by an actual idol! Inspired the anime film and manga adaptation.

Azuma Yuu is a high schooler with big dreams of becoming an idol—by any means necessary! Chasing fame is no easy task, but she’s not afraid to put in the work and starts befriending girls from every corner of the prefecture to create her ideal group. It’s not long before people start taking notice of the newfound idols, and suddenly, opportunities seem to just fall into their laps.

While her friends celebrate their good fortune, the truth is Yuu is working hard behind the scenes to get them on every stage possible. Researching locations, timing each appearance just right, and hustling hard to keep her dream alive—while also performing and practicing! As the stages grow bigger and the pressure mounts, Yuu has to face the harsh reality that carrying the group’s success on her own has a toll. One misstep could cost her everything if she can’t figure out the secret to success. But can she face the darker realities of idol life, or will she fall just short of fame?

title: Witch and Mercenary
synopsis:
THE LORE BEHIND WITCH AND MERCENARY

For the first time, this collection of five new short stories gives fans a glimpse into the experiences of Zig and some of the friends (and foes) he has met on his many journeys. Through these stories, fans can get an up-close look into the day-to-day thoughts and motivations of the unforgettable characters that dot the Witch and Mercenary narrative landscape.

Stories include a tale of Zig’s mercenary band and how he started using his signature weapon, an account of the Remitter Yaesar and a set of demi-human siblings, and a tale about Laika, an outcast of the Jinsu-Yah. Don’t miss the chance to peek around the curtain and learn even more about this world of witches and whirling weapons!

title: Return of the Corpse King: Reining in My Cringe Secret Society
synopsis:
The proud greater demon, Marquis Marchosias, trembles with rage. The very concept of heroes has become a farce—entertainment to be consumed and discarded. It was with bravery and conviction that a true hero once cut down the mighty Demon King. To belittle the Hero is akin to insulting every demon who fell before his blade. So as news of yet more “heroes” appearing reaches his ears, Marchosias ventures forth with a question: Are they the real deal?

Meanwhile, Helheim, after saving the Sleepless City and taking in a Cait Sidhe, sets its sights on restoring the Corpse King’s lost power and heads for the Empire’s Lv9 Hidden Land, the Heavenly Prison. Their timing coincides with Hyouka and the other heroes, who have come with an escort of color explorers including the Empire’s own Black Valor, Artel Nanoire.

It is here—in a hidden land shrouded in mystery and fraught with danger—that their convictions shall collide.

title: ROLL OVER AND DIE: I Will Fight for an Ordinary Life with My Love and Cursed Sword!
synopsis:
THE SAGE LEADS THE WAY

Cast into despair by the loss of Milkit, Flum swears revenge on Origin. Led by the hyper-intelligent scumbag of a sage known as Jean Inteige, she and the demon Neigass set out on a last-ditch journey to save humanity from this scourge. A glimmer of hope appears along the way as they are miraculously reunited with Sara, Flum’s friend and Neigass’s beloved—before being smashed once more as the girl transforms before their eyes into something horrific. Can Flum take yet another loss? Or will this be the final blow to her faltering resolve?

title: Cooking with Wild Game
synopsis:
As always, things keep on changing for Asuta and everyone at the forest’s edge. Toor Deen’s got a new business that seems to be off to a booming start, Asuta has a very promising new hire named Marfila Naham, and Pops Balan and his team were sent off in style with a farewell banquet.

But what will happen when Yumi’s family learns of her plans to marry into the forest’s edge? Will everyone be able to come together and reach an understanding, or will the ties between the people of the forest’s edge and The Westerly Wind be severed? Plus, a surprising face from Asuta’s past returns.

See all this and more in the exciting thirty-sixth volume of Cooking with Wild Game!

title: Dinners with My Darling: How the Former Monster King Ate Her Way to Happiness
synopsis:
The Monster King Relocates?!

Abigail, the former Monster King reborn as an earl’s daughter, and Gerald, the serious military man helplessly in love with her, lead a happy married life. Their days are only marginally chaotic as Abigail makes her first friend and eats her way through various new dishes. Until, suddenly, Gerald learns that he will be transferred for work, and the couple must relocate to the port city of Orta, which they visited on their honeymoon! Tabitha and the rest of the household staff will accompany them, so a delicious new chapter is about to begin! The long-awaited fourth volume of the foodie love story is finally here!

title: Isekai Walking
synopsis: The resolution of the Demon King threat did not come without a cost. Mia hangs between life and death, and her only hope lies back in the Altair Dungeon. While Sora travels there with Hikari and Eris, Rurika and her friends return to Elesia hoping to find the elves rumored to be hidden somewhere in the area, with a promise to reunite there later. Meanwhile, tensions between Elesia and its neighbors continue to rise, the demons have a score to settle, and one last otherworlder is still unaccounted for. The city where Sora first began his journey is a powder keg waiting to go off!

title: Private Tutor to the Duke's Daughter
synopsis:
Allen’s students have forced him to accept them as his equals and abandon his reckless plan. But Lydia’s time is still running out, and the tutor and his pupils soon head east together, determined to end at its source the curse eating her alive. The power behind the church is already a force to be reckoned with, however, and if the false Saint reaches the final altar, the ancient black gates will make her unstoppable. Allen races to find the altar first while untangling the mysteries of her past—and his own.

Meanwhile, Stella remains in the capital, praying for her “magician’s” safe return and pouring all her strength into Lydia’s treatment. Her mastery of healing magic has grown to rival that of the kingdom’s finest, yet her struggle against the ever-growing curse threatens to turn as deadly as any battle. As long-buried secrets come to light, the threads of history converge on a looming catastrophe.

title: The Disfavored Prince is a Genius Alchemist
synopsis:
“I’ll make you emperor.”

The great and easygoing big brother fights for his younger brother’s future in Volume 3 of this heartwarming brothers’ fantasy!

One day, a proposal is raised for the Empire to send troops into a minor conflict along the frontier. The deployment offers the nobles absolutely nothing to gain, and the person they intend to place at the head of this thankless campaign—and quietly dispose of—is Asha, whom the dukes consider an obstacle.

However, Asha knows that his current position offers no guarantee that he will be able to continue living happily with his younger brothers. So, he decides to pretend to fall into their trap and use the campaign as an opportunity to build his achievements!

His enemies spare no effort to ensure that he never returns. They appoint an incompetent general as the field commander, limit the number of troops, and saddle Asha with a fragmented army that lacks any unity.

But such obstacles are nothing to a genius alchemist. Asha has a secret plan capable of uniting the army and resolving an international crisis in one fell swoop—but what could it be?

For the sake of his future with his younger brothers, the great and easygoing big brother marches onto the battlefield in Volume 3 of this heartwarming brothers’ fantasy!

title: The New Gate
synopsis:
Over 150,000 copies sold! The smash-hit fantasy web novel returns with its long-awaited fifth volume!

After escaping the Sacred Land of Kalgia, Shin is met with a terrifying sight—a massive horde of monsters marching on the fortress city of Balmel.

Rushing to the city's defense, Shin finds himself facing an even greater shock.

Standing among Balmel's defenders are players who were supposed to have died during THE NEW GATE's deadly game era.

Reunited with powerful allies from a forgotten past, Shin joins forces with some of the strongest warriors in the world to confront an overwhelming enemy.

As tens of thousands of monsters descend upon the fortress city, the strongest swordsman once again takes the battlefield!

title: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon: My Trusted Companions Tried to Kill Me, But Thanks to the Gift of an Unlimited Gacha I Got LVL 9999 Friends and Am Out For Revenge on My Former Party Members and the World
synopsis:
Phinea, princess of the Centaur Steppes, was once on the run, but now she’s ready to turn the tables! She’s determined to reform the homeland that betrayed her, and to save her friend Palu, the one who sacrificed her freedom so that Phinea could escape capture.

Standing at her side is Elio, the human farm boy sworn to guard her with his life—and the one who has quietly captured her heart. Elio commits to forging himself into a capable warrior under the tutelage of the mighty knight Gold, all so he could fight Phinea’s battles and become worthy of marrying the love of his life!

Yet Santor won’t go down without a fight! The centaur prince plots a devious plan to escape the wrath of both his sister, Phinea, and the vengeful dungeon lord, Light!

Passion, romance, and retribution collide in this ultimate gacha fantasy, now adapted into a well-acclaimed anime. Will Phinea achieve her wildest dream, or will her love become another casualty of war?

title: Legend of the Accidental Sword Saint: Playing the Mentor from the Sidelines
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

One man plans to fake it ’til he makes it in this fantasy-action light novel! Can he be a successful con man or will his lack of skills be his true downfall?

You’d think being in a fantasy world full of sword-wielding heroes and ferocious monsters would make one yearn for the role of hero: to be the one who saves the day through epic skill and weapon wizardry. But for one man who finds himself reincarnated into such a land, being the hero is not so appealing. Why not just revel in the glory of being the best—and being the one to train the best—while saving one’s hide in the process? With this plan in mind, he gets to work training in the art of swordplay, determined to become the mentor any hero would cherish. Unfortunately, the mentor-to-be’s confidence takes a hit when, despite years of arduous training, a battle with a weak little squirrel monster makes him nearly lose his life.

Won only by the skin of his teeth, the battle sparks an idea: Why not just fake it? He could bring a young apprentice under his wing and then split before his lack of talent could be discovered! However, this mentor-to-be is unaware of how incredibly strong all monsters in this world are, regardless of size—so strong, in fact, that no single swordsman can take one on themselves and end the battle alive. Can a conman truly con if he is actually as good as he says?

title: Space Orc: Barbarian Raider of the Stars, Aiming for the Queen!
synopsis:
THE PRINCESS’S ROUGH-AND-TUMBLE FIRST TIME

Kartz, warrior orc of the Tone Tekin tribe, is given a new spaceship, but with a catch: The captain is none other than Princess Peeka. With little other choice, Kartz and his team hop on board and blast off for their first mission—attacking a mining base. But while they’re busy battling the mine’s guards, fellow barbarians seize the opportunity to snatch up all the loot! Kartz and Princess Peeka team up to fight them off, barely managing to make it out. But now their ship is in need of repair, and so it’s off to Wanderers’ Galaxy Market, where they find a plethora of goods, services…and more unsavory characters?! Can Kartz and Princess Peeka shake off this series of misfortunes?

title: To Another World... with Land Mines!
synopsis: Meikyo Shisui finally resumes their journey into the Summer Resort Dungeon after getting the brewery around and upgrading their equipment, but the twenty-first floor proves to be quite the challenge! They eventually discover a cave where they face off against mysterious new monsters and golems. Although they’re overjoyed to discover raw gemstones there, they find the golems just keep getting bigger and bigger! There’s not only plenty of action in this volume, but a thick side story regarding Satomi’s fate following her encounter with our heroes is included too!

title: I'll Become an Elegant Villainess! Time to Enjoy My Second Life to the Fullest
synopsis:
Mitia Lumiol decides to take things easy and sets her sights on going to some cushy school and becoming its top dog! On paper, the Arcadia Academy of Magic looks like the lowest of the low and an easy target, but a major misunderstanding means that Mitia’s gotten herself into the realm’s toughest school, one filled to the brim with elite noble children.
Grades and magic mean everything here, and Mitia’s secret inability to use Common Magic is just another barrier to her success. Still, nothing is about to stop this elegant villainess from making allies, carrying out evil deeds, and declaring herself enemy to even the top of the first-year S-Class, Prince Felix von Elmia himself! After all, isn’t that what being a villainess is all about?

title: Lacey Longs for Freedom: The Dawn Witch's Low-Key Life after Defeating the Demon King
synopsis: Lacey has finally realized her true feelings for Wayne! A few months after their last adventure, Wayne returns to Plume Village with a new request from a mysterious client—this time from the neighboring country of Eharaja. The request seems innocuous enough, but with her client’s flippant demeanor and the content of said request, there seems to be more than meets the eye. A new client, an unfamiliar country, and her burgeoning feelings towards Wayne—can Lacey handle everything in this new adventure?

title: Notorious No More: The Villainess Enjoys Feigning Incompetence
synopsis:
Class D has decided to run a ramen stand at the Academy’s annual cultural festival! But when a demon’s plot to make a full comeback continues to unfold and a poisoned concubine plots to bring harm to our intrepid heroine, the cultural festival she’s been looking forward to is soon plunged into utter chaos!

Laviange unleashes her hidden power and shows her true fury!  How will Laviange fare when miscommunication raises its ugly head? And what will happen when the world finds out she’s not as incompetent as she pretends to be?!

title: After-School Dungeon Diver: Level Grinding in Another World
synopsis:
How about an unusual mission in another world?

After successfully completing a large-scale, multi-team dungeon mission, Kudo figures it’s time to go back to his usual daily dungeon-diving routine...until Hiro, his friend from Japan, offers Kudo an unusual mission. What antics will follow as he and Carbuncle take on this mission together?

A mysterious side of Kudo’s daily life finally comes to light! The sixth volume of this laid-back otherworldly adventuring story from the duo Hitsuji Gamei and Karei is here!

title: Imperial Reincarnation: I Came, I Saw, I Survived
synopsis:
"If you wish to take our head, then come at us!" (Am I gonna make it out of this alive...?)
With a dazzling reveal of his magic, Carmine has managed to crush Rocourt's forces and draw the kingdom to the negotiating table. And sure, the divinity remains a major pain, and there are still two more kingdoms to handle in this war, not to mention what comes after. But at least for now, things seem to be going...well?
As Carmine has learned, though, things are never quite so simple. And sure enough, just as he judges things to be safe and proceeding smoothly, an unbelievable assault is launched upon his very home. Can Carmine rally his troops to counter an attack so thoroughly out of the blue? And even if he can, what will it cost him in the process?
Plentiful negotiations and shocking violence in the heart of the Empire fill the pages of volume 8 of Imperial Reincarnation!

title: From Villainess to Healer
synopsis:
Charlotte Cocoriara: duke’s daughter, fiancée to a prince, villainess, and...NPC? Framed as the villainess in a spin-off of an MMO dating sim, Charlotte suddenly regains memories of her past life as a player of the same MMO. Armed with her new understanding of the world, she happily accepts the end of her betrothal and her accompanying exile. Who needs a cheating prince fiancé when there’s a whole fantasy world to explore?
Using knowledge from her gameplay, Charlotte strikes out on her own. Her first task is to switch jobs, something apparently no one else in this world knows how to do. With her new role secured, she’ll make friends, join parties, challenge dungeons, and...! Follow Charlotte as she sets off on a grand adventure, free for the first time in her life!

title: Haibara's Teenage New Game+
synopsis: We all have embarrassing memories or deep regrets from high school, right? Socially anxious college senior Natsuki Haibara sure does. When he thinks back on that time of his life, all he has are fleeting fantasies of a happy adolescence that could have been. Imagine his bewilderment and surprise, then, when he inexplicably finds himself seven years in the past—one month before his first year of high school! Can Haibara avoid his previous mistakes, make his way to the top of the school social pyramid, and end up with the girl of his dreams? Or will he be forced to relive three years of solitude as the most hated guy in school? He’ll need all the help he can get in order to succeed, from a workout regimen to online how-to guides, a childhood friend, and plenty of sheer willpower. Watch as Haibara takes a second shot at his teenage years!

title: My Quiet Blacksmith Life in Another World
synopsis: Winter is waning in the Black Forest, and the buds of spring have begun to emerge. Unfortunately, this is also a season of political intrigue for Forge Eizo. Counterfeit knives are still circulating around the kingdom, threatening Eizo’s and Camilo’s livelihoods. Ever the enterprising merchant, Camilo comes up with a scheme to catch the perpetrator: Marius and the margrave will lay a trap, and Eizo will forge a forgery of his own. This will be no ordinary counterfeit—Eizo must make a knife using the legendary metal orichalcum! With opposing political factions roiling beneath the surface of the kingdom’s hierarchy, everyone must play their part to expose the counterfeiters. Can Eizo master the unyielding orichalcum? Or will his failure hammer the final nail in the coffin of his blacksmith life?

title: The Despicable Duke Settles His Affairs
synopsis: After careful consideration and meticulous planning, Kashimiya Tsukasa ends his life to save his family. However, instead of reaching the afterlife, his eyes snap open to scenes of torture, mutilation, and so much pain…all inflicted by his own hands. When his head clears, he realizes that he’s been reincarnated into the world of his favorite novel—not as a hero, but as the sadistic Duke Heinreid von Rodvelia. Haunted by the memories of the duke’s vile deeds, he vows to atone by giving himself the permanent ending he deserves. But soon, his shift in personality arouses the suspicions of Craig Bauer, Heinreid’s personal knight and the one who finally kills him in the original novel. Craig’s attention slips into obsession, and as his fate intertwines with Heinreid’s doomed destiny, the story of the novel begins to warp around them. Will Heinreid end up skewered down to the hilt of Craig’s sword? Or can even the most despicable duke find a reason to keep living beyond the final page?

title: The Water Magician: Arc 1
synopsis:
After escorting Prince Willie to the capital of Knightley, Ryo feels a weight lift off his shoulders. He’s even managed to secure a position teaching the young prince how to use water magic. Life couldn’t be better!

Before long, Ryo and Sera happily go on a sweets tour together. The two of them bond as they visit the other elves, but after they go their separate ways, a horde of monsters emerges from underneath the Temple! And then while he and Abel are trying to find the cause of this outbreak, an “island” falls from the sky and crashes right through the royal castle! As one crisis crops up after another, Sera struggles to protect her friends and is attacked by a powerful opponent.

“Do you really think I’ll let you hurt the people I care about?!” Ryo will use his superhigh-pressure water currents to stave off a scheming enemy nation that has bared its fangs! The adventures of the strongest, freewheeling water magician continue in this frenetic fourth volume!

title: 86--EIGHTY-SIX
synopsis: With the Legion ahead of them and their retreat route disrupted, Shin and his companions establish a defensive line at Rustkammer base. They continue to fight valiantly as they hold out for Operation Overlord. However, after a fierce onslaught, the unthinkable happens... Shin falls into the clutches of the Legion!

title: Accel World
synopsis: In the first round of Brain Burst 2039, Silver Crow was just barely able to repel the invasion led by Eurochion and took the victory. Meanwhile, Metatron and the other seven high-ranking beings hold fast against their invaders. And elsewhere, a certain someone has a fated encounter with an ethereal entity. Crow’s next battleground is the castle of Nyx, the Goddess of Night!

title: Bride of the Barrier Master
synopsis: Practitioner society is shaken by an unimaginable betrayal. Kazura, a well-respected figure and the most powerful obsidian-rank practitioner, attempted to overthrow the five clans. His attack on Hana’s school ended with him behind bars, but tensions only continue to rise as shades begin capturing low-rank practitioners and lives are lost. The abductions seem too deliberate—as if the shades are under someone's control! At the same time, Hana and her shikigami come across more mysterious curses that victimize animals in the area. When they encounter Enju Goyougi, a specialist in curses, it seems like a stroke of good luck. He provides Hana with a counter-curse…but it turns out he's no generous benefactor. Meanwhile, Saku is posed with a difficult question: In a crisis, would he choose to protect Hana, or save the nation?

title: Classroom for Heroes
synopsis: Rosewood Academy is as lively as ever! First, Eliza's latest invention fuses Earnest and Lunaria, creating a girl two times as strong! She might be even more powerful than Blade, if only her two halves could get along...Meanwhile, the other students find a way to nerf Blade's powers in the virtual world, allowing him to experience the limitations of a normal human. Unfortunately for them, Blade is a lot happier about the situation than they expect. Later, the usually bright and cheerful Yessica struggles with a big secret—she's been ordered by a certain organization to assassinate Blade!

title: Date A Live
synopsis: After Kurumi saves his life dozens of times, Shido decides to tell the other Spirits the truth. Right when they’re grappling with harsh memories of the past, the Ratatoskr crew engage in an all-out war with DEM! How will Shido and the girls get out of this pinch?!

title: Gods' Games We Play
synopsis: The showdown with the formidable Chaos brought Fay’s team one step closer to discovering the truth behind the gods’ games. But before they can even catch their breath, Chaos’s defeat draws the attention of the god known as the Great Beast Nibelung. She springs a game on them: solving a murder mystery in a village where the headman has been found dead…and the killer is among them! Fay’s team, and even Chaos and Chief Secretary Miranda, falls under suspicion. They’ll have to juggle their roles as townsfolk and investigators as they attempt to deduce the identity of the perpetrator before time runs out. Their most dangerous opponent yet might just be their mistrust of each other. After all, isn’t it always the ones you least suspect?

title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Familia Chronicle Episode Asfi
synopsis: Asfi is never not busy, so it takes some doing to get her to accept a quest to investigate a mysterious ship that keeps showing up recently. But when she, Hermes Familia, and Lyu board the vessel, they are attacked by a horde of ghosts! They endure an endless stream of inexplicable phenomena while the ship takes them to a place that shouldn't exist—Asfi's lost homeland.

title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
synopsis: I've been killing slimes for 300 years, and now Godly Godness is stuck as a frog! I figured she'd turn back eventually, since she's a god and all, but I'm afraid she's getting a little too comfortable in her new form...  Later, I participate in a cooking contest with Vania as her assistant, send Shalsha off to be a spirit's apprentice (sob sob), and encounter a dubious delivery service that's opened up in Flatta. Plus, don't miss Laika duking it out at the Red-Dragon Academy for Girls!

title: Orc Eroica
synopsis: Having traveled the world over and struck out with beauties of all races, Bash returns to the land of humans. Along the way, he meets a Sage who offers to teach him everything he knows… The sweet-talking Orc Wizard has a wife and child of his own, and Bash finds himself with a mentor for the first time in his life. Meanwhile, Nazar, Thunder Sonia, and Judith reunite in the Night Crown Territory, where the final piece required to resurrect the Demon King rests.

title: Playful Relationships
synopsis: Welcome to board game café Gather Round, where love starts with a roll of the dice! Join interim manager Kotarou “Banjo” Tokiwa, who has a crush on the youthful, fashionable part-timer Mifuru Takanashi but can’t ask her out because she has a boyfriend!

title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
synopsis: Chaosflame is facing an unprecedented disaster that, if left unchecked, will mean the end of the empire! As those gathered in the city continue to fight, Abel resolves to seek out a certain astrologist who might hold the key to victory. At the same time, the bad news reaches Rem—a terrifying girl leading a swarm of dragons has arrived, and all hell is about to break loose!

title: Mafia
synopsis: In the violent, crime-ridden underworld of Broken Ark, everyone knows Amrita—it's one of the biggest gangs in the city, and also the most philanthropic. But precious few have seen its enigmatic boss, Lucy. And so, when she's targeted by a series of escalating attacks, the suspects are limited. Someone among Amrita's top brass is a traitor, but who?

title: Shino & Ren: Future
synopsis: Lovebirds Ren and Shino have left their school days behind and set out into the world of working adults. Independence is exciting, but living on their own and starting their careers comes with a whirlwind of challenges. Ren is struggling to make time in her busy modeling schedule for her girlfriend. Shino is happy about Ren's success, but she can’t help but notice all the admiring gazes Ren attracts. Then when they’re finally alone, Shino shies from physical intimacy! And to top it all off, Shino gets along with her coworkers and students so well that it's stoking Ren's jealousy. Do these high school sweethearts have what it takes to clear these hurdles and build a future together?

title: Tale of the Wizrain Kingdom: The Nation's Dragon Guardian Is Reborn as a Downtrodden Young Lady
synopsis: Elna, the adopted daughter of a baron, lives in the Wizrain Kingdom and endures constant abuse from her elder stepsister. But one fateful day, it all comes rushing back to her: In a past life, she was the famed dragon Elnarfia who protected the nation and longed to be human! Soon, a kingdom-wide search for the girl who is Elnarfia’s reincarnation brings Elna face to face with a dear friend from her previous life: the legendary hero, now reborn as the king of Wizrain. But can the two of them rekindle their old bonds, or will they have to start from square one in this new life…?

title: The Immortal Witch Would Sacrifice Ten Thousand Lives to Fulfill a Simple Wish
synopsis: After being reincarnated in another world as an immortal witch lich with the appearance of a young girl, Yuurai is arrested by royal guards on the charge of killing and manipulating the corpse of a princess. While being tortured, she casts her “Descend into Darkness” skill, consuming twenty thousand souls to gain the mighty power of a Demon Lord—and in doing so, becoming a target for extermination. Yuurai is targeted by holy knights and first-rank adventurers before eventually coming face to face with the kingdom’s army of ten thousand soldiers. All she wants is to live in peace, but the vicious cycle never ends.

title: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless… More Stories to Love!
synopsis:
THERE CAN’T BE MORE HEARTWARMING STORIES! UNLESS…

After a traumatic middle school life where she spent most of her time in her room playing video games, Amaori Renako set out to become the ideal version of herself in high school. Now, she’s a member of a group of popular girls called the Quintet, dating the most beautiful girl in school, and living the high school dream! Her daily life is so exciting that you could even fill a book with all the stuff she and her friends got up to in between the drama and romance!

title: The Tale of a Little Alchemist Blessed by the Spirits
synopsis:
SEASIDE SHENANIGANS

With a new little sister and apprentice by her side, Daisy’s days are busier than ever! Daisy’s quest for materials to defeat the dreaded drake takes her to a seaside port town. It’s her first time to visit the beach, and she’s determined to enjoy it to the fullest!

But while Daisy enjoys frolicking in the sand in her swimsuit, she ends up rubbing the locals the wrong way when she boils a giant octopus with alchemy magic and turns an entire hot spring into potion water! Oops! Can Daisy turn the tides on her seaside adventure and smooth things over?

title: The World's Strongest Rearguard: Labyrinth Country's Novice Seeker
synopsis: Arihito’s party finally defeated the Shining Simian Lord and rescued Elitia’s friend Rury. Their achievements have earned them permission to advance to District Four where the key to turning Theresia back into a human lies. But before them stands the White Night Brigade, the top ranked Seekers in District Five who already have bad blood with Arihito and his friends. Both groups have formed pacts with opposing Hidden Gods, and they’re about to find out what that entails—a Divine War?!

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword—GrimoActa
synopsis:
Will and his childhood friend Elfaria enroll at Regarden Magical Academy, each with their own challenges to overcome. Even among the incredible mages at the Academy, Elfaria quickly shows her talents and is scouted to join the Tower, the group at the very heart of magical society. Will, on the other hand, considers himself talentless and falls into despair…but in that despair he draws a blade. In a world of wands run by the Magia Vander, one young boy alone wields a sword! 

A prequel to the smash hit manga series written by the original author!

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
synopsis:
After letting loose, Nia manages to bring a temporary end to the insect threat of Marvelia. Now free of the state’s and the mafia’s harassment, she begins to enjoy her time in the Mech Kingdom, taking Akashi’s experimental horseless carriage for a spin, training her new students, and making desserts with the children.

On the horizon is Winterfest, a festival to welcome in the safe winter. While the celebrations usually include a display of duels between mech knights, Nia’s romp out east has left many of them in need of repairs. Responsibility for the exhibition shifts to the Mech Studies students who are now down their ace pilot after Nia’s negotiation with the king. When the opportunity to win their ace pilot back is offered, they jump at the chance.

But while Nia is entirely disinterested in fighting mech knights herself, she’s more than ready to put her students through their paces. It’s time for the Merciless Maiden to have her fun—by training others to wreak havoc once more.

title: Reborn to Reign: Imposing My Rules with My Mastery of Magic
synopsis:
School is in session for Vanitas! After winning over his slaves and saving his temporary fiancée from bandits, it’s finally time for the nameless man reincarnated as Vanitas Lindblum to attend the Zenhood Imperial Magic Academy. There, he’ll face the one person he was hoping to avoid—the original novel’s protagonist. 

Classmates and teachers alike are stunned by the changes in Vanitas, and new friendships quickly bloom as he enjoys his life as a student. Between helping Mayurelika establish her business and investigating the academy’s seven mysteries, there’s never a dull moment for Vanitas. But how long can this peaceful life last before the original story forces him into conflict with the protagonist...?

title: A Tale of the Secret Saint ZERO
synopsis:
SAINT SERAFINA’S TIME TO SHINE!

An unexpected encounter with a demon shakes the kingdom to its core, prompting Sirius to arrange for Serafina to be sent far from the castle, lest the demon return. But Serafina has plans of her own. Disappointed that she had fainted in the face of danger, she secretly decides to train with the Saint Knight Brigade to toughen up. Training, however, isn’t quite what Serafina expected. She finds herself dealing with chaos caused by knight captains under a monster’s spell, her father’s sudden desire to become a knight himself, and traveling to an orphanage to heal an injured knight, who happens to be a familiar face. This may not be what she bargained for, but Serafina is determined to do her best to prove she’s got what it takes to be a saint!

title: Chivalry of a Failed Knight
synopsis: Thanks to Lunaeyes’s deft negotiating, the war between Vermillion and Cradleland has gone back to being a battle between teams of Blazer representatives. But after seeing how powerful Desperados are, Stella knows she needs to get much stronger in a short amount of time to stand a chance against them. Her only hope is to ask the world’s strongest swordsman, Edelweiss, to train her. But little does she know that the trials that await her will be far harsher than she can possibly imagine.

title: Isekai Tensei: Recruited to Another World
synopsis: The empire has officially declared war on the Kingdom of Krastin, and to make matters worse, their undead army has broken through the front lines of Margrave Haust’s lands. The mere mention of zombies lights a fire in Tenma, and he and Merlin immediately head to the battlefield! They overwhelm a horde of more than a hundred thousand zombies, but their victory is cut short by the appearance of a terrifying grim reaper. This creature is unlike anything they’ve ever faced before and pushes Tenma to his limits! Old grudges and painful memories start to collide, setting the stage for an otherworldly final battle.

title: The Devil Princess
synopsis:
A SECOND CHANCE IN THE WORLD OF LIGHT

Yulucia has finally gotten her wish: She’s back in the World of Life as her past self, Yuzu Togaki, once again. She’s now five years old and remembers almost nothing of her life as Yulucia. She does, however, remember that Yuzu had died in her early teens after years of being bedridden, and she’s determined not to succumb to the same fate twice.

Meanwhile, evil spirits and people with impure hearts flock to her, almost as if drawn by her demonic presence. Not to mention a black cat that keeps watching her—and why does he seem so familiar? But more importantly, by using what faint memories she has of her past lives, Yulucia-now-Yuzu is going to make sure nothing stands in the way of her second chance at life!

title: Proud to Be the Villainess
synopsis: Noble society is still reeling from the mind-manipulation case, but Iora is now officially engaged to Leo. To Wellmy, it’s all that matters. Can her beloved sister finally have her happily-ever-after? Maybe...but not just yet. Leo and Iora meet yet another obstacle: they struggle to find ladies’ maids to serve the future crown princess, given Iora’s past and the whispers that follow her. But it doesn’t take long for Wellmy to cook up a plan to select the perfect servants for her dear, dear sister. Is it a little convoluted? Yes, but when have her schemes ever been straightforward? Her plan requires moving into the main Ormirage estate, which Aides readily agrees to as their own engagement is about to be made public. But will Wellmy get along with the many ladies working for Aides, many of whom bear the scars of curses and nefarious items? And most importantly, will she find people worthy of serving her beloved Iora?

title: Revenge of the Soul Eater: Cast Out as a Weakling by My Sword Saint Father
synopsis: Sora and company return home to Ishka at last! But there’s no time to relax, because with the royal wedding in the capital imminent, the town is bustling! As Sora’s reputation and responsibilities to the kingdom increase, he finds himself back in Onigashima, finally crossing the Demonic Gate. Just what will he find in the devastated realm of the demonkin?

title: The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan
synopsis:
As Alus heads to the Outer World in search of answers, much to his horror, he discovers the corpse of a Single. No normal person could’ve done this—and it’s the signal for war. Furthermore, a terrorist attack occurs in Rusalca, pinning him as the prime suspect!
Knowing he’s out of luck, Alus and Loki flee to the Outer World, evading capture, leaving Cicelnia to pick up the slack and defend her nation’s Single. With a seemingly insurmountable amount of evidence against Alus, she knows that she’s fighting an uphill battle, especially when she learns that the seven nations might have to team up with the Kurama!

Meanwhile, Alus and Loki are in survival mode. No help is headed their way, and they’re desperate to live another day. Tensions are high, and little by little, Alus finds himself opening up to his partner, Loki...

title: Record of Wortenia War
synopsis: Despite achieving what Hideaki Saito believes to be a triumph in the second invasion of the Kingdom of Xarooda, his superiors clearly disapprove. Tension mounts between Shardina, Celia, Guinevere, and Saito, who are all nominally on the same side but have drastically different goals. Meanwhile, after scraping through in a dangerous duel to win the Organization’s respect, Ryoma Mikoshiba shores up his other alliances to counter the invading enemy’s numerical advantage. Before they can mobilize, however, there’s a pretender king in the Kingdom of Myest who must be dealt with.

title: Chillin' in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
synopsis:
It’s a new leaf for the House of Flio, with the mild-mannered merchant from another world finding himself thrust into the world of nobility as the newly appointed marquess of Houghtow! 

But who among his household—composed of demon defectors, shinobi from the far east, amnesiac angel maids, and former threats to the world of Klyrode itself—could possibly have the experience and level head to stand by his side as he makes his first foray into the realm of politics and diplomacy via the Grand High Moot of the Magical Kingdom of Klyrode? 

Can Flio navigate the jealousy some long-standing nobles might have towards the Maiden Queen’s favorite upstart? And how will the Fli-o’-Rys General Store fare while its proprietor is busy with affairs of the state?

Someone might need to force Flio to take another vacation before his ever-precarious work-life balance takes a turn for the worse yet again...

title: The Diary of a Middle-Aged Sage's Carefree Life in Another World
synopsis:
Having defeated the dragon ruler and settled a long-standing score with his sister, Zelos is back to his normal life in Santor. Until, that is, Alphia Magus—the Dark God—emerges out of the blue one day to walk the world once more.

Zelos had been counting on that, of course...but he hadn’t prepared for it to happen so soon. How is he going to explain the presence of this ‘young’ girl in his house to visitors? And where is a middle-aged man supposed to get underwear for a naked goddess, anyway?

Shortly thereafter, Duke Delthasis asks Zelos and Ado to head out on another job. A body has been found in mysterious circumstances near Solistia’s border, and the duke wants Zelos and Ado to investigate. But this is no ordinary murder...

Meanwhile, as Zelos sets out on his latest journey, Alphia decides to make the most of her newfound freedom and attend to matters of her own. After millennia spent sealed away, it’s finally time: The Dark God’s counterattack starts now!

title: A Wicked Lady's Guide to Accidentally Saving the Kingdom
synopsis: The Great Costume Festival has ended, and Lettie’s domain is raking in the dough! With her well-earned profits, she decides to make another “purchase,” but it’s yet another bombshell—she ends up with thirty injured soldiers, including the former prince of a country the Kingdom of Stowrein just destroyed! How will she handle these defeated men eager to seek revenge against the kingdom that razed their homeland? And with the dangerous Wolves of Hell on the move, it’s only a matter of time until their terrifying leaders—the Five Direwolves—come knocking on Lettie’s door...

title: Date A Live
synopsis: After Kurumi saves his life dozens of times, Shido decides to tell the other Spirits the truth. Right when they’re grappling with harsh memories of the past, the Ratatoskr crew engage in an all-out war with DEM! How will Shido and the girls get out of this pinch?!

title: Liar's Journey: Reborn as a False Hero – I'll Save the Tragic Heroine from Every Death Route!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

FIGHTING AGAINST FATE

Liar and Aatan accept a monster slaying request that takes them to the village where Aatan’s long-lost sister, Aibel, was raised. Aware that the village is doomed to be destroyed by the Demon King’s general, Liar throws himself into a desperately fight to keep that future from coming true. But an enemy he didn’t expect—one who isn’t working with the Demon King’s forces at all—senses Liar’s presence and begins hunting him down. Can Liar counter this fearsome foe? Or will the chaos prove too much for him to handle?

title: Reincarnated Into a Game as the Hero's Friend: Running the Kingdom Behind the Scenes
synopsis:
RESOLVE AND REVELATIONS

After falling into a trap set by the demons, Werner von Zehrfeld faces his greatest challenge yet. Not only has Lily been abducted, but a large army of monsters is steadily approaching the royal capital. This is the moment Werner has long been preparing for, ever since awakening to his memories of having played the game this world was based on. But between his fiancée now being in the clutches of a mysterious demon with a connection to a past hero, and the many mysteries he uncovered at the underground library, not even a walkthrough guide would be enough to save the day! With the war against the demons reaching a fever pitch, can Werner save Lily without sacrificing the city?

title: Too Many Losing Heroines! Short Stories
synopsis:
THE SECRET LIVES OF LOSING HEROINES

For the first time, over forty short stories that were bundled as purchase bonuses, made available at events, or were a part of a collaboration with Toyohashi’s Nonhoi Park, are now available all together in English!

Sometimes sweet, sometimes silly, take a glimpse into the lives of the many losing heroines in between their tales of love and loss.

title: A Dumped Villainess Married Me, a Lazy Villain Noble and We Became the Ultimate Power Couple
synopsis:
Alban realizes the truth: he’s a villainous noble in a novel.

And if he follows the script, he’ll lose a duel to the hero, fall into ruin, and die forgotten. Determined to avoid that ending, he finally drags himself into sword and magic training—actually working for once.

Then trouble arrives in the form of his new bride: the infamous villainess, Leticia, a girl surrounded by nothing but terrible rumors.

Except… the moment Alban meets her, he’s struck speechless. She’s exactly his type—an incredible wife in every way.

The “villainess” reputation? A scheme by her former fiancé. In truth, Leticia quietly shelters and cares for homeless children with a kindness that borders on angelic.

Alban nearly forgets his own downfall-avoidance plan. Instead, he decides to thaw her guarded heart by force—and to take revenge on the trash of a duke who framed the woman he loves.

Using their notorious “villain couple” image as bait, they lure their enemies out into the open…

“If you get in our way, we’ll just crush you.”

A ruthless, deliciously satisfying revenge-and-reversal fantasy starring the most dangerous villain × villain married couple!

title: A Late-Start Tamer's Laid-Back Life
synopsis: Yuto returns home to do big things on his farm—namely, enjoy his newly expanded field of nemophila flowers and the Lakeside Tree. But before he can get too comfortable, friend and fellow farmer enthusiast, Tagosack, invites him to attend an agricultural fair to showcase crops, meals, and more to first- and second-wave Farmers. Yuto enthusiastically agrees to join—and host—the fair, but of course nothing is ever simple when Silver-Haired is involved. What do a livestreaming Zashiki-Warashi, a wooden statue of the Lakeside Sequoia Dryad, and a mysterious entity known as the divine spirit have in common? They’re all part of a Silver-Haired phenomenon!

title: I'm Just a Villager, So What?
synopsis:
“I’ll make you regret picking a fight with me even after I’ve sent you to hell.”

Josef, the uncle of the Hero Cordelia, threatens Ryuto over Liz, the young girl under his protection.

Using Cordelia’s ties to the nation and her supporting merchant company against her, Josef forces the discussion forward with her half-held hostage. Ryuto refuses to hand Liz over under any circumstances, but in order to buy time, he pretends to go along with Josef’s demands. That decision, however, leads to the worst possible outcome.

Josef and his cohorts sink to a level of depravity beyond anything expected, incurring the wrath of the strongest Villager and setting the stage for an all-out act of annihilation with his full fighting strength.

title: Looks like a Job for a Maid! The Tales of a Dismissed Supermaid
synopsis: After parting ways with Firth, Nina and her friends travel on to the dictatorship of Nost with Myriad, master of the Magic Tower, in tow. But their excitement to explore this country’s new and exotic culture is short-lived. It turns out that the selection ceremony to choose Nost’s next ruler known as the shin’en jokun is about to begin, and the powers that be are eager for Myriad to participate. It sounds like trouble waiting to happen, but Nina and her friends know it might be their only chance to meet the lupalune serving in Nost’s army—their best hope of getting information on Tien’s parents. Nost is like nowhere they’ve traveled before, and they’re going to have to learn quickly if they want to make it through unscathed!

title: The Tiny Witch from the Deep Woods
synopsis: After pirates attack their ship and Misha falls overboard, she is rescued from the open waters by some dolphins she’d befriended. She ends up in a little fishing village hidden in a small, sheltered cove. Her skills as an apothecary make her immediately popular in the isolated community as she saves lives and makes medical breakthroughs in record time. But this idyllic seaside village holds a dark secret, one that a pair of boys is determined to unravel about their hometown, and Misha’s skills and status as an outsider quickly become key to their plans. As Misha tries to find her way back to the outside world so that she can reunite with Ryne, she finds herself once again saddled with a dilemma: There are people suffering, even if just out of sight, and she might be the only one who can help them. Yet doing so might reveal that dark secret, a secret no one has been allowed to take out of the village for generations...

title: The Villainess Speaks Not
synopsis:
With the deadliest assassin now working for her, Liliana finds it much easier to investigate the kingdom’s ongoing power struggle. Tensions between Slivegrandia and Yunatian continue to rise—and what better time could there be for an unwelcome visit from the empire’s notoriously foolish prince? Accompanying him is his lovely but exceptionally gullible younger sister, the so-called jewel of the empire, who immediately sets her sights on Riley. However, it soon becomes apparent that there is more to the siblings than meets the eye.
Meanwhile, knights and mercenaries from across the kingdom are preparing for the combat tournament to be held during the imperial visit. Among the participants is Liliana’s enigmatic guard, Olga, a mage warrior whose true power remains a mystery. Is she really competing for the prize money, or does she have reasons of her own for challenging the powerful mage knights of the Second Corps?

title: Classroom of the Elite: Year 3
synopsis:
FIGHTING FOR SURVIVAL

It’s time for this year’s Uninhabited Island Special Exam. Classes will face off in a four-day game of survival, and the first class to fall will incur a penalty in the expulsion selection, so every move counts! Students will move through the battleground, collecting food and bullets while duking it out with students from the other classes. And with GPS making their every move visible to the commanding officers in each class, strategy and group coordination is key for survival! In an exam where one wrong move can doom them to failure, can Ayanokouji lead his class to victory?

title: ROLL OVER AND DIE: I Will Fight for an Ordinary Life with My Love and Cursed Sword!
synopsis:
THE SAGE LEADS THE WAY

Cast into despair by the loss of Milkit, Flum swears revenge on Origin. Led by the hyper-intelligent scumbag of a sage known as Jean Inteige, she and the demon Neigass set out on a last-ditch journey to save humanity from this scourge. A glimmer of hope appears along the way as they are miraculously reunited with Sara, Flum’s friend and Neigass’s beloved—before being smashed once more as the girl transforms before their eyes into something horrific. Can Flum take yet another loss? Or will this be the final blow to her faltering resolve?

title: The Berserker NPC Unknowingly Destroys the World
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

In this action-packed isekai tale, one man is determined to become more than just a random NPC! Inspired the manga —also from Seven Seas!

As the youngest son of a revered warrior clan, Albert Falconer is shouldering a lot of pressure. But all his battlefield experience can’t prepare him for the sudden revelation he experiences the tender age of fourteen. In a past life, Albert realizes, he lived in a different world completely. In that world , the Falconers and their society were part of a video game—one Albert remembers just well enough to know that he was a far cry from a main character! Albert begins his studies at the Radford Royal Academy of Magic with that past life in the back of his mind. But it’s soon crystal-clear that, despite what he remembers, he’s not going to end up some minor, lackluster NPC. Albert Falconer’s life is on a more exciting course!

title: The Condemned Villainess Goes Back in Time and Aims to Become the Ultimate Villain
synopsis:
A TREASURE HUNT FOR THE TRUTH

As part of their vacation, Claudia and Sylvester attend an international conference together. The countries’ future leaders assemble in an impregnable fortress on a remote island, assured of its security—until the banquet begins, and some attendees vanish without a trace! During the ensuing investigation, our heroine is joined by an eastern prince known for his philandering ways. Their efforts to solve the mystery soon evolve into a search for treasure rumored to be hidden within the ancient halls!

title: The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash
synopsis:
“EVEN IF I’M LOST, I STILL CHOOSE MY OWN PATH!”

After discovering the church was behind the drug epidemic all along, trash-collector Ivy and her friends make quick work of demolishing the cartel’s processing facility in a cave, luring out the nobles who had been in cahoots with the church, discover a new summoning circle, and rid the village of all evil! Whew! But just when she’s riding the high of a job well done, Ivy is floored by a shocking truth that leads her to connect the dots of an unthinkable connection between the church and the fortune teller from her past… But despite the doubts and fears now clouding her heart, Ivy isn’t ready to call it quits just yet. Trusting in her own judgement, she presses onward!

title: From Two-Bit Baddie to Total Heartthrob: This Villainess Will Cross-Dress to Impress!
synopsis:
After winning the main character’s heart, putting a stop to her older brother’s engagement, and subduing a witch, Elizabeth finally finds herself with enough time on her hands to start seriously thinking about her future. And it’s a good thing too—graduation is right around the corner!

But just as she’s beginning to weigh her options, the question of her career path is snatched right out of her hands. Each and every knights’ division, along with a foreign government, will be competing in an event called “Biff! Pow! ☆ The Ultimate Tournament to Decide Who Gets the Biggest Say in Elizabeth Burton’s Future” in the hopes of employing Elizabeth for themselves!

title: Hell Mode
synopsis:
Allen and his friends finally make it to the Heavenly Realm! Determined to become stronger than ever, Allen must adapt to new systems and fight powerful monsters to achieve his goal.

The Summoner is eager to defeat spirit monsters, which allow him to meet new gods through a gacha system, and the party manages to win its way into meeting several important deities, including Isley, the ruler of the Spirit Garden. The group then splits up to meet the deity of their choice in hopes of attaining newfound power.

Convinced that this is the ticket to making Sophie and Luke stronger, Allen eagerly sets out to the Spirit Garden to meet with Isley, only for Rohzen and Faable to be taken prisoner! Now, the group has ten days to clear the two of their crimes lest they revert to nameless, powerless animals.
Can Allen save Rohzen, the God of Spirits, and Faable, the Sovereign of Spirits? Can Allen gain more power, or will the ruthless gods prove that he’s bitten off more than he can chew?

title: Haibara's Teenage New Game+
synopsis: Beaches, local Okinawan cuisine, and making memories with friends—that’s what the long-awaited school field trip was supposed to be about. However, days before departure, Natsuki loses Hikari’s trust and she bids him farewell, instantly plunging his world into monochrome. On top of that, he finally meets the god who, on a whim, granted his wish for a second chance. The god forces Natsuki to face the anxieties that have taken root in his heart. Were all of his efforts for nothing, or can he still salvage the here and now?

title: Black Summoner
synopsis: The weddings continue as Kelvin moves to Deramis to marry Colette, but with many more ceremonies and battles to go, will everything truly go to plan, especially with powerful hitters like Adam still in the fray? And during their time apart, what’s happened to Luquille?!

title: Flung into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse!
synopsis:
Former janitor and unintentionally summoned hero Akira has a lot on his plate right now, to put things bluntly. Between trying to prevent an apocalypse, attempting to convince everyone that he’s not their new lord and savior, and raising a steadily growing number of children, it’s impossible to decide what to prioritize first—and so he doesn’t, choosing instead to figure out a way to help a three-headed (and hopefully friendly) “dog” hatch from its weird egg. Okay, maybe there’s a reason he wasn’t meant to be summoned...

With the Cerberus’s hatching on the horizon, Akira realizes he might need to start getting ready to escort it back to its true home, which unfortunately happens to be the demon realm. It’s gonna be the journey of a lifetime—that is, if the demon realm’s inhabitants don’t come looking for their missing pet first... As simple misunderstandings descend into almighty mayhem, Akira might not even survive long enough to face the apocalypse!

title: Reincarnated as a Sword
synopsis:
BLACK LIGHTNING STRIKES TWICE

Having saved Sophie in Cendia, Fran and Teacher head to a new battlefield under orders from the Adventurers’ Guild. There, they join forces with S-Rank adventurer Izalio and Adol the Godsword Knight to save a town from being destroyed—but the appearance of several strange, giant antibodies sets off what might just be the greatest swarm Goldicia has ever witnessed. In the midst of all this chaos, a mysterious Black Cat surrounded by black lightning arrives on the scene. Who is this person? Will she prove friend, or foe?

title: Saving a Weapon Shop from Bankruptcy after the Demon King's Defeat
synopsis:
REVOLUTION’S ON THE RISE—BUT WHAT ABOUT PROFITS?

Corio’s weapon shop was on the brink of bankruptcy after the defeat of the Demon Lord left adventurers without a need for gear. But rather than give up, Corio banded together with his sister Eni, his friend Kizza, and the clever moneylender Frista. Together, they launched a new business, eking out a profit and just barely avoiding ruin.

Yet their patchwork venture brings no end of trouble. One day, a girl named Lillian, an analyst from the church’s Bureau of Prophecy, appears and begs Corio’s help in halting a rising religious reformation. Though the tale sounds too wild to believe, Lillian’s persistence sways Corio, and he agrees to assist.
