Now juggling commerce and church intrigue, Corio finds himself back in dire straits. And just when things seem like they can’t get worse, Kizza receives a shocking proposal…

title: You Were Experienced, I Was Not: Our Dating Story
synopsis:
After three months apart, Ryuto returns to Japan from his new post in Indonesia to tie the knot with Runa. All that’s left for them to do is get everything ready, walk down the aisle, and leave Japan once more—together this time.

Things aren’t as simple for most of Ryuto and Runa’s friends, though, as nearly every couple in their orbit is still trying to find out where their love might take them. With the main pair’s wedding just around the corner, what does fate have in store for their friends in the grand finale?

title: Predator Witches
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

THE PREDATOR BECOMES THE PREY

After fending off the incubi’s massive assault, Silver Lotus presses her advantage, using the familiars she deployed to their realm to strike their bases. The incubi retaliate by using enslaved witches to target her familiars’ one fatal weakness—the fact that they weren’t designed to fight other humans. Before long, the conflict spirals into chaos as even global powers such as China and the United States, seeking Silver Lotus’s powers, go to war alongside the witches. Meanwhile, Azure Nova begins a secret witchhunt to eliminate anyone who would dare threaten Silver Lotus…

title: Making Magic: The Sweet Life of a Witch Who Knows an Infinite MP Loophole
synopsis: With Chise’s new business, the Hexen Company, up and running and a non-aggression pact signed with the forest’s neighbors, she can finally take a hard-earned break...for a few months. Just as she and Teto begin planning their next adventure, a missive from the Pope arrives, summoning Chise to Palma, home of the Church of the Five Goddesses. Unfortunately, even the mighty Witch of Creation can’t afford to offend the Church’s head honcho, so she has no choice but to heed the call and make the journey. Hopefully, she can get her audience with the Pope over with quickly and devote the rest of her time to her and Teto’s favorite activity: sightseeing!

title: Villager A Wants to Save the Villainess No Matter What!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

Villager A is barely even an NPC—but he’s going to be the one to save the villainess?!

Allen, reborn into an otome game, has finally recovered his memories. Now he knows that he has only a few short years to prevent the heroine from destroying his home and family…but how?! Not only is he an NPC, he’s the least relevant NPC in existence, without even an actual name! However, all is not lost. Armed with his memories, he vows to make full use of his greatest cheat code—game knowledge—and change his destiny! Using his knowledge and skills gained from menial labor, he manages to become a C-rank adventurer and enter the fabled academy grounds. But will his efforts be enough to defeat the heroine and save the villainess, or is an NPC all he’ll ever be?

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm: Hannelore's Fifth Year at the Royal Academy
synopsis:
After refusing Ortwin’s proposal, Hannelore returns to her dormitory only to receive more bad news: she no longer has a say in whom she marries. Her father, the aub, has judged her too indecisive and made the decision for her.

Hannelore racks her brain for a way forward. Having resolved to stay in Dunkelfelger, she reassesses her relationship with her retainers and considers what she needs from a partner who can stand beside her. But just as she finds clarity amid her tangled emotions, an urgent summons arrives from the Zent.

As threads weave across time and space, Lady Crybaby finally launches a charge of her own in the third volume of this love-battle fantasy, featuring two original short stories and four-panel manga by You Shiina!

title: By the Grace of the Gods
synopsis: Tasked by Duke Jamil to treat and develop a mountain rife with cursed energy, Ryoma takes this opportunity to kick his warlock training into full gear. While his slime and goblin familiars work hard to rapidly pave a mountain path, Ryoma continues to shock his friends by accidentally designing hexed products. However, his projects are interrupted when a shady noble appears...

title: From Villainess to Healer
synopsis: Charlotte Cocoriara: daughter of a duke, jilted fiancée of a crown prince, and possessor of past-life knowledge of her world. Using that knowledge, she’s shed her old life to adventure as Sharon, the Healer who helped the Hero’s party conquer a new dungeon. Now, they’ve invited her on a visit to the Cait Sith homeland to help a sickly—and adorable—little girl. Concocting life-saving potions, taking on an apprentice...saving the Pope?! This former villainess will face plenty of tribulations as she continues her life of adventure!

title: Almark
synopsis: Following the events at Wendy’s mansion, Almark and Morgan go back to the institute before summer vacation is officially over. As the rest of the students return to campus, preparations are getting underway for the upcoming martial arts tournament, and Almark takes this opportunity to train Morgan, who’s not particularly adept in combat. On the day of a solar eclipse, Almark, Morgan, and Wendy stumble upon a mysterious ruin beneath the institute… Who and what will the three friends find shrouded in the eerie darkness?

title: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
synopsis:
THE THINGS WE DO FOR LOVE

Marie, a girl who escaped an unloving home, and Kyros, the richest man in the kingdom, are in love and just can’t wait to get married! Only problem is, for some reason, they just can’t get permission to marry! After investigating the matter, they learn that the crown prince is trying to pin a crime on Marie to force the two apart!

The couple are distraught and don’t know what to do. But when Luifon, the third-eldest prince and close friend of Kyros, hears of it, he decides to sacrifice himself for their happiness. Is there really no other way?!

title: Buying a Classmate Once a Week
synopsis: In the aftermath of their springtime kiss, Miyagi and Sendai find themselves returning to familiar dynamics. Miyagi gives the same orders she always has, and Sendai obeys without putting up any novel forms of resistance. And since the two have explicitly agreed not to see each other over holidays, their relationship seems bound to stagnate during their imminent summer vacation. That is, until Sendai floats the idea of being Miyagi’s home tutor for the duration of the break, and Miyagi accepts. Both girls know that spending this much time around each other could be dangerous while they’re still dancing around their feelings. But will the intensity of the situation be the shake-up their relationship needs…or the thing that warps it even further?

title: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
synopsis:
The Holy Husk Titan’s coup d’état has been thwarted! Now back in Muno County, Satou has a jam-packed schedule—he attends the wedding of Count’s heir, is appointed viceroy, and forges an alliance with some kobolds. Ringrande doesn’t care much for that, though. Following his arrival, Satou is dragged off to the Yowork Kingdom to hunt a demon lord.  

He fights alongside the Saga Empire Heroes to defeat the threat, only to realize that perhaps there’s more to the foe’s arrival than meets the eye...

title: Four Child Life
synopsis: My name is Mifu Miyabi. My three identical sisters and I have been getting used to life at our new school, but recently, we’ve been swarmed with attention. Rumors have been circulating left and right, and it all comes to a head when the school paper receives an anonymous letter…claiming that we’re bullies?! If we can’t put a stop to the lies, our reputations are finished. It's time to get to the bottom of this!

title: Hell Mode
synopsis: The No-life Gamers find that everything is not well in the Prostia Empire. As he scrambles to unlock a new Summon and rig the Songstress Contest to obtain new gear, Allen struggles to find any trace of Beast Crown Prince Beku—the man who incited a failed rebellion against his nation and was forced to flee. After Allen and his friends split up, each tending to their own tasks, Allen notices that his merchant friend, Pelomas, is missing! Where could he have gone?! Was he just wandering about, or was he abducted? Time is not on Allen’s side. If the effects of Mimic wear off on Pelomas, he will transform back into a human and drown in the underwater empire! This already awful situation takes a turn for the worse when Allen is stopped by the Demon Lord himself! Why is the Demon Lord here anyway?! Can the Summoner save his friend? Or will Pelomas meet a grisly, hellish end without proving his devotion to his beloved Fiona?

title: Honey Lemon Soda
synopsis: After years of bullying, plain-faced honor student Uka Ishimori has sealed away her feelings and become a stone, just like her cruel middle school nickname, Rocky. But when a gorgeous boy with lemon-yellow hair offers her encouragement, she decides to change herself completely and live life to the fullest. Instead of the good school she’d been aiming for, she follows her heart and enrolls in Hachimitsu High—the same school that the boy who saved her goes to. With a fresh start and a little help, can Uka finally fill her gray world with color and maybe even find love?

title: If the Villainess and Villain Met and Fell in Love
synopsis:
After the failure of Oscar’s initial attempt to change the spirit contracting ritual, Brigitte is under round-the-clock protection. While she and her allies wait for Oscar’s next move, however, trouble seems to be brewing in the spirit world, as more and more contracted spirits fail to manifest in the human world. Finally, Brigitte, Yuri, and Tonari head into the Crack to solve the problem at its source. But they find much more than they expected—including the truth behind who Brigitte really is.  

The story of this once-villainous young couple reaches its conclusion!

title: I'm in Love with the Villainess: Come on and Notice Me Already
synopsis:
The hit yuri/Girls’ Love series returns with a third arc—this time featuring the daughters of the beloved main couple! The curtain rises on a new story with new characters and even some familiar favorites.

The story of I’m in Love with the Villainess continues as Rae and Claire’s daughters, May and Aleah, enroll at Bauer Girls’ Private Academy! There, they share a room with Lilly Lilium, who remains hopelessly in love with their mother, Rae. But Aleah has feelings for Lilly of her own, while May isn’t about to give up her place as the most important person in her sister’s life!

Love triangles, heartbreak, friendship, and adventure await in this next-generation sequel, proving that no matter how much the world changes, some things never do.

title: Into The Night – YOASOBI Story Collection
synopsis:
The inspiration behind YOASOBI’s hit single, Into The Night , is now available in English! Five enthralling short stories that were so powerful they inspired music that touched the world.

YOASOBI—the chart-topping duo behind hits like “Into The Night (Yoru ni Kakeru)”—is known for turning short stories into songs. Their breakout debut reached No. 1 on the Billboard Japan Hot 100.

This collection features the original stories behind some of their most popular tracks, including “Into The Night,” “Tracing A Dream,” and “Haven’t,” along with additional related works.

Go back to where the songs began—the stories that inspired them.

Includes a special interview with YOASOBI.

title: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire
synopsis: Sixteen-year-old Inglis Eucus has more to deal with than just a haywire Artifact practically putting her back in the stroller—Eris’s weapon form as a hieral menace is broken too! What better excuse to visit Highland in search of a solution? Inglis gets everything she wants and more, with a warm—no, blistering—welcome from mechanical dragons before she even sets foot on dry land. But as Inglis and her friends will soon learn, life is made of meetings and partings.

title: Reincarnated as a Dragon Hatchling
synopsis:
THE PUPPET SAINT

After climbing the endlessly long spiral staircase of the Skypiercing Spire to escape Ngai Forest, Illusia and his friends find themselves in the cellar of the Church of the Holy God’s cathedral. There, inscribed in a revelation stone, is a message from a saint of the distant past: Saint Yornes. In it, she warns that one day in the far future, her visage and identity will be stolen by the Divine Voice, and she would become its puppet. And it seems like the future is now, because when a loud boom outside draws Illusia out to investigate, he finds the holy city of Lidom desolated and overrun by monstrous creatures…and floating above the carnage is a woman in black—Saint Yornes!

title: The Chef of the Adventurers' Tavern
synopsis: Yoishi the tavernkeeper has a big problem with adventurers...because they have awful diets! One day, some rookie adventurers happen to bring back the bitter stone walnut from the dungeon, considered by many to be inedible. Hoping to find a way to incorporate it into a new dish, Yoishi taps into his knowledge of previous eras and embarks on a new culinary adventure!

title: The Holy Grail of Eris
synopsis: It's been over a year since Daeg Gallus’s plot rocked the kingdom, and Connie and Randolph are finally preparing to get married. But as the date approaches, Randolph grows strangely cold, and Scarlett’s behavior becomes increasingly erratic. Meanwhile, Connie, now working for Abigail as a detective, winds up entangled in a major art forgery case involving a dangerous marquess. With her wedding plans floundering and Scarlett MIA, how is Connie supposed to cope?!

title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy
synopsis: Anos successfully avenges the death of his father by defeating his mortal enemy, Graham. In the aftermath of regaining most of his lost memories from the Erial, something abnormal happens to Sasha, whom he entrusted with the final Star of Creation; she proclaims herself the reincarnation of Abernyu, the Goddess of Destruction. In order to confirm the truth, Anos and his friends follow the fragments of her revived memories and explore the depths of the Demon Castle Delsgade, where they find traces of Abernyu everywhere. The Goddess of Creation who made the world, and her sister the Goddess of Destruction: the secrets of these two gods are about to be revealed in volume 9, Demon Castle Depths arc!

title: The Unimplemented Overlords Have Joined the Party!
synopsis: Cheers erupt throughout Allistras as the players who were thought to be dead respawn. Crest jumps in to assist those who have been revived while Shoukichi shares a tearful reunion with his party—and then Shuutarou and the Evil Overlords show up with fresh determination to put an end to this deadly game! Wataru, meanwhile, has ended up in prison amid scores of player killers, but he remains undaunted. No matter what happens, he will see his plans to fruition, even if he has to team up with several unsavory characters…

title: The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess
synopsis: When the remaining Fools of Observatory are spotted in the Imperial Capital, the empress rallies Komari and the other Crimson Lords to oppose the organization. However, it quickly becomes apparent that one of the Crimson Lords—Millicent Bluenight—has vanished along with an Extermination Armor that had been confiscated from Observatory. Hoping against hope that Millicent hasn’t turned traitor, Komari and the others comb the Imperial Capital for both her and Observatory, all while the Fools plot to bring Mulnite to its knees. Has Millicent really betrayed her country? Is the Mulnite Empire any match for Observatory? These questions and more will be answered on the night of the new moon…

title: The Weakling Who Died a Million Times
synopsis: Hey there. I’m a goon. Wouldn’t even call myself a bandit or thief—nothing that official. Just one of many desperate folks who’ve sunk really low to survive. Bottom-of-the-barrel guys like me end up following the orders of the strongest scum around. I’m simply another disposable henchman, but I do have a special ability. No matter how many times I die, I respawn into the body of a new ruffian! What a shame. My dream is to become like the adventurers that regularly wipe out me and my fellow goons. I want to help people. It’s not that I want to die but…what’s five or six lives if my death can protect someone’s future?

title: To Sir, Without Love: I'm Divorcing You
synopsis: After being accused of spying and order to divorce her husband by the Imperial Army, Byletta’s business is suffering. But when she journeys northward in the hope of finding a new opportunity, she once again encounters Arnald, who is in the middle of a military operation! Byletta tries to keep her distance, unable to understand why Arnald never fought against the divorce—but she has no idea that he is still deeply in love with her and carrying out a secret mission of his own. How long will this couple continue to talk past each other?

title: To the Monster I Love
synopsis: Two infamous Unlaw have escaped the capital, and the Elementary Detective Agency are dispatched to recapture them. Norman leads the group to a seedy casino for what should be an easy mission…only to be confronted by enemies from the not-so-distant past. To make matters worse, these villains appear to be a lot stronger than they once were. And as the battle heats up, the line between ‘human’ and ‘monster’ becomes that much thinner...

title: The Trials and Tribulations of My Next Life as a Noblewoman
synopsis: To bring about a new age with a new emperor, Karen has her work cut out for her. She’s made it to the Tower of the Eye, but it won’t be easy to release the mage Six and open a path for Reinald to overthrow the current emperor. Before she can even start on the problem of Six, however, she’ll have to make it past an infatuated, insane suitor, a squadron of undead soldiers, and the corpse of her best friend, transformed into a monstrous defense mechanism.

title: Chronicles of an Aristocrat Reborn in Another World
synopsis:
WHEN THE SAINTS GO MARCHING IN

So far, Cain’s new life after reincarnating into another world has certainly kept him on his toes. The blessings he received from the gods on his fifth birthday are some of the strongest around, and his power does not go unnoticed.

So when the Adventurer’s Guild leaves the town of Drientl a wreck, the leaders of the Esfort Kingdom promote Cain, a mere twelve years old, as lord to clean up the mess. With one success after another, Cain is up for any task that comes his way—but can he handle being guard to a Holy Woman?

title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
synopsis:
AN UNFAMILIAR KRISHNA

There’s been an interruption to Hiro’s usual travels through space; space pirates have ambushed his ship! To make matters worse, they haven’t just caught him off guard. He’s also facing an enormous fleet of foes.

The psionic abilities Hiro has recently been honing offer him an edge against space pirates, of course. But in his attempt to get past his attackers, Hiro winds up affecting the Krishna itself—and the consequences are enough to astound even a tough, well-traveled space mercenary!

title: She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man
synopsis:
INDECENT PROPOSALS

Mira tracks Eugust, one of Ira Muerte’s leaders, to the city of Miditoria. Problem is, he’s holed up in the red-light district! But Mira is determined not to lose this opportunity to corner her prey—and a little bit too excited to experience such a den of vice herself for the first time—so she decides to disguise herself as a courtesan and infiltrate the hotel where Eugust is spending the night. Will this plan end in disaster? Or even worse…will it work way too well?

title: A Serious Error in Chihaya-chan's Reputation
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

Chihaya-chan doesn’t dream of labor; she only dreams of retiring. An action-packed light novel about a gloomy girl with poor communication skills and the remote job that changes her life and how people see her!

Chihaya is a gloomy, lonely girl who dreams of early retirement. Well, she’s gotta get a job to retire from first, which is not gonna be easy with her severe communication disorder. So when the chance for a fully remote job comes her way, Chihaya jumps on it and becomes an operator for a humanoid machine—an Actanoid—and joins the race to explore and develop the New World! Unable to ask others for help, Chihaya has to rely on her own resourcefulness to get through the workday…but turns out she’s actually supergood at it?! And by with her genius piloting skills and explosive endings to foil countless schemes, she unwittingly earns herself the title of warmonger! Now everyone’s got the wrong idea about Chihaya, who was just trying to do her job! Just what kind of mess has she gotten herself into?

title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires
synopsis: The border conflict between the Kingdom of Sarjas and the Yutear Empire gave Elizabeth her first opportunity to take revenge. After thwarting the plans of her worst enemy, Prince Friede, and utterly destroying his closest friend, Robert, Elizabeth returns to the imperial capital. Unrest is growing in the Kingdom of Haldoria, but she is still far too weak to take on its power and vassal states by herself. She must keep growing her firm, Traitre, and extend her influence. Fortunately, the emperor may have provided her the perfect opportunity: a chance to obtain an invaluable certification, called a Special License, that comes with a wide array of benefits. All she has to do is prove herself worthy in the eyes of the sovereigns of the financial world—the seven members of the Empire’s Merchants’ Guild Council.

title: Min-Maxing My TRPG Build in Another World
synopsis: The magus Agrippina saves the munchkin hero Erich by the skin of his teeth. But this favor does not come without a cost—she brings news that little Elisa is actually a changeling! To protect his sister’s future, Erich’s only choice is to accompany the magus to the imperial capital as a servant, leaving his hometown behind...but not before making an oath to his childhood friend. When fairies suddenly appear on his path to the capital, will he be able to avoid a critical failure?! The Henderson scale-breaking, number-crunching TRPG adventure returns for another session!

title: The Water Magician: Arc 1
synopsis:
After helping handle the mayhem in the royal capital, Ryo finally returns to Lune. Back home, he accepts a job with the members of Room 10 in the coffee-growing haven of Kona! As he and his friends solve the village’s problems and savor its delicious food, he learns something wildly unexpected—his best friend and partner in crime, Abel, is the second prince of the Kingdom of Knightley.

While Ryo is still processing what he initially brushed off as a joke, the Handalieu Federation declares war on the neighboring Principality of Inverey! To make matters worse, his beloved disciples are kidnapped after being embroiled in the war...

If his enemies think they can disturb his peace, they have another thing coming! They’ll be trembling in fear when Ryo shows them what his water magic can really do. And when he joins forces with Prince Abel, their enemies won’t know what hit them! The adventures of the strongest, freewheeling water magician continue in this frenetic fifth volume!

title: Chihaya Re:Start!
synopsis:
Chihaya Sakurazaka’s got one thing that sets her apart—her legs are fast as the wind!  

When Mio Koshimizu introduced her to track and field in middle school, a whole new world opened for Chihaya. Before she and Mio went to different high schools, they swore to be rivals for life and meet again in an inter-high tournament. But when the time finally comes, something unexpected brings Chihaya’s ambitions to a screeching halt...

title: Gear × Magic: Reincarnated as an Engineer, I'll Save the Villainous Princess
synopsis:
When a beggar boy stumbles on a rusted mech, he suddenly unlocks memories of his past life! Can he be the hero needed to rewrite this universe’s story or will his meager status hold him back? Catch all the action in this new isekai x mecha light novel series!

When Grimm, a young beggar boy, stumbles upon a suit of rusting GEAR in the ruins of his destroyed home, he awakens memories of his past life. He realizes he’s been reborn into the world of GEARxMAGIC, a hit anime about humanity’s war against half-human, half-machines known as Gargoyles—but wait, didn’t that anime have a bad ending?!

The protagonist killed the imperial princess and doomed everyone! But maybe it doesn’t have to be that way… Armed with his knowledge of the IP and his engineering skills, Grimm hatches a plan to invent GEAR advanced enough to defeat the protagonist and save the princess’s life! But can he really rise from his humble beginnings to become a hero?

title: Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash
The Reincarnated Mastermind: Sundering Fate with Magic Swords
synopsis: Several months have passed since the deadly battle against the undead red dragon Asval. Despite wanting no part to play on the stage of the game’s story, Ren finds himself going to the imperial capital with Licia where he has a fateful reunion with Fiona Ignart, the girl he saved in the Baldr Mountains. Other encounters also await him, from people whose names are well known across all of Leomer to the main cast of the very tale that he so wants to avoid!

title: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
synopsis: Following a battle with the demonic forces, Alia finds herself a captive in their fortress dungeon. An unexpected reunion brings her face-to-face with a friend who’s in a bind of his own—and Alia isn’t about to let him face it alone. She steps into the fray to fight in the Rites of Selection, a dungeon battle royale for which the demon clan chieftains and their followers have gathered. The prize? A seat on the throne of the demonic nation!

title: In Another World with My Cat: A Software Engineer Uses Code to Master Magic and Build a Territory
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

A programmer and his beloved cat are transported to another world where their skills open new opportunities and the ability to reform their domain! A purrfect isekai series featuring an engineer and his precious paw-tner.

Transported into a strange new world, Matsumoto Isamu—a systems engineer, thirty-four, recently divorced—and Orihime—his cat—are granted unique powers. Those from other worlds usually command respect and protection, but Isamu’s seemingly useless skill, Magi Debugger, barely secures him the patronage of a poor, low-ranking noble.

However, when paired with Isamu’s programming knowledge, Magi Debugger allows him to engineer anything and everything, from portable lanterns to magic swords. With the equally talented Orihime by his side, Isamu sets forward to innovate and improve their new world to turn it into a home.

title: The Apothecary Diaries
synopsis: The political tumult of recent days shakes I-sei Province to its core, leaving the western capital looking for leadership. But Gyokuen’s sons scoff at the idea of ruling, while Gyoku-ou’s oldest child is volatile and violent. Although Jinshi tutors Gyoku-ou’s more competent sons in the ways of politics, greater dangers than they could have imagined appear at every step. Maomao still craves a simple life, but perils escalate around her. Between a foreign prince and secrets continuing to swirl around Chue, it may be quite some time before the apothecary gets her wish...

title: Virgin Knight: I Became the Frontier Lord in a World Ruled by Women
synopsis:
AN APPRENTICE’S AWAKENING!

Faust von Polidoro, a frontier lord, is reincarnated from modern Japan into a medieval fantasy world where gender roles are flipped. In this strange society, he becomes a rare male knight. Martina von Bosel, a young girl serving him as an apprentice knight, visits the Polidoro fief ruled by Faust.

Under orders from Duke Astarte to do some snooping in the Polidoro fief, Martina deepens her inquiry to satisfy her own curiosity. As she watches Faust spend time with his people, she gradually finds her thoughts turning to her late mother, Caroline—a woman who betrayed the kingdom and was executed by Faust.

In the exciting fifth arc of this heroic gender-bent saga, an apprentice knight’s journey to accept her mother’s loss turns to unexpected romance!

title: Fluffy Café in Another World
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

OUR MENU HAS EXPANDED!

The Fluffy Café is a wild success—so much so that things are starting to feel a little cramped inside. Taichi realizes it is time for a renovation, but fix ups do not come cheap! Taichi agrees to go on a mission on behalf of the Tamers’ Guild to get his renovation plans off the ground. His mission sends him to investigate the ecology of a mountain, where he makes a surprising discovery: a squirrel-like creature he has never met before! These creatures quickly warm up to Taichi, but an encounter with one in need of assistance puts Taichi’s unmatched animal-helping abilities to the test when it matters most.

title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
synopsis: Zagan's group heads off to Nephy's hometown in order to learn more about high elves. However, when they arrive, they get trapped in a barrier that distorts time! While they're in there, Zagan's beloved bride Nephy is... turned into a little girl!? The precocious little Nephy is cute in her own right, but there's no way Zagan can just leave her be! Will Zagan and the others find the culprit behind Nephy's curse before it's too late?

title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
synopsis: Nephy and Zagan have finally confessed their feelings to each other, but neither of them have any idea how to act like a normal couple. After getting some advice, Zagan finds out about a mysterious event know as a 'date,' and goes on a research trip in town where he coincidentally saves the blind therianthrope, Kuroka, a newly dispatched priest. At the same time, Nephteros discovers the truth of her origins and escapes to Zagan's territory while being pursued by Bifrons' chimera.

title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
synopsis: Zagan and the others turn Foll older temporarily to help her grow stronger. However, the ritual goes berserk, and when Foll grows bigger, Zagan shrinks! Following Orias' advice, they decide to attend the Continental Interracial Elders Conference in the Far-East in order to obtain powers aside from sorcery. What awaits them there is a member of the Night Clan, beings who live eternal lives, Alshiera. And somehow, this girl they meet for the first time seems to know Zagan and Nephy...

title: From Villainess to Healer
synopsis: When Charlotte Cocoriara’s engagement was broken, she regained game knowledge of a fantasy world and decided to use her unique insights to become Sharon, an adventurer and Healer. Alchemist Tarte and Sharon’s apprentice rescue Pope Tithia, who is on the run from a mutinous cardinal who took over the cathedral in Zille. Determined to help Tithia win back the church, Sharon works hard to grind the levels of her entire party. When she discovers that the cardinal is trying to summon L’lyeh, Goddess of Darkness, she ventures into the Abbey to thwart his attempt once and for all.

title: Tearmoon Empire
synopsis: The fishing tournament begins! Princess Mia is on a mission to visit Ganudos Port Country in search of her long-lost great-uncle, but the king has refused to meet with her, and his daughter Orania has been avoiding her at Saint-Noel Academy as well. That’s when Mia devises a plan: How do you win over the princess of a coastal nation? By fishing, of course! Orania loves fishing, and Mia sets her sights on befriending her by throwing a school-wide fishing tournament! But will it really be enough to win over the fish maniac princess?

title: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
I Became a Necromancer After Beating Up My Angel Guide and Accidentally Triggered the Apocalypse
synopsis:
Who knew triggering the apocalypse could happen so…accidentally? A disaster-level mistake in a VR game leads one woman down a powerful path to becoming the world’s ultimate threat! The action-packed series that inspired a manga —also available from Seven Seas.

After decking the angel that was supposed to act as her guide to the game world she isekai’d into, Rinne pulls a hidden event and receives an exclusive class under the dark god Babylon: Necromancer. Using its unique skills, she recruits party members, and alongside her, they grow stronger at lightning speed.

As Rinne and her allies discover hidden events one after the other, they use perfectly executed teamwork to kick any and all enemies to the curb. And before they know it, they’ve become a supremely powerful group strong enough to turn the world on its head—all with Rinne being completely unaware!

title: Reincarnated in a Mafia Dating Sim
synopsis: Francesca once lived the life of a granddaughter of the local yakuza boss...but when she is reincarnated into the body of the main character of a mafia dating sim, Francesca, her goal in life becomes a simple one. "I want friends!" But to live the life of a normal high school girl is not going to be an easy one...especially when she's part of one of the five major mafia families, and she's even betrothed to the big bad villain of the game! Just as things seem to to turn bleaker and bleaker for poor Francesca, her fiance and villain of the game, Leonardo, proposes a suggestion... "Why don't I be your friend?" Francesca can't be any happier! Now she just needs to use her quick wit and guts to avoid the dreaded dead end!

title: EXP Is Golden
synopsis:
The third event is over. The angelic threat is contained. All is well in the world of Boot Hour, Shoot Curse—until three new shadowy figures emerge. Draped in hooded robes of red, white, and black, they stalk the Kingdom of Peare, stirring trouble in their wake. The player base is abuzz with speculation. Who are these mysterious figures? What’s their aim? Could they possibly be the ringleaders of a grand conspiracy, whose tendrils span the very breadth of the continent?

Meanwhile, Blanc, Leah, and Lyla have fun exploring the Pearesian countryside! Hidden artifacts, new underlings, a rumored real-life dragon, oh my! Their travels are meandering and their methods digressive, but their ultimate goal remains clear: Cultivate the six keys needed to unleash the golden dragon that sleeps at the top of the world, and claim its power for themselves.

title: Al the Adventurer: That Magic Shouldn't Work!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

MESSAGES FROM THE PAST

With the Fly spell finally in his hands, Al heads for the research tower, where golems and artifacts of a bygone era await him. The problem is, he doesn’t know how to use them! As he sets about solving this problem, the Assistant given to him by Patricia wakes up—and begins to reveal the history of how the ancient kingdoms came to an end. What will these earth-shattering revelations do to Patricia’s already conflict-wracked homeland of Tempest? And can Al resist being pulled into it all?

title: I Reincarnated as the “Villain” Commander of an Order of Knights
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

One man reborn into a light novel wants to avoid his bad ending…but can he change from a villainous commander to a big brother type?! A hilarious isekai light novel and manga about avoiding ruin by being a better man!

Justin, a knight commander infamous for his arrogance and insolence, suddenly regains memories of his previous life as a college student who spent years taking care of his seven younger brothers. With that clarity comes a grim realization: If he continues down the villainous path laid out for him, both he and his entire order are headed straight for execution. Determined to avoid that fate, he sets out to turn both himself and his troublemaking knights around.

Using the same brotherly instincts that once kept his siblings in line, he tackles everything from his subordinates’ bad habits to the politics of high society. Before long, the man once reviled for his attitude is being praised as a reformed leader…and even a hero.

title: The Petty Villain Plays by the Rules: Rewriting This Otome Game with Honest Work!
synopsis:
Reid is finally back in the Valdia Mark after the incredibly hectic but fruitful trip to Lenarute. Instead of taking a moment to breathe and settle in, he’s already planning for what comes next. Now that his engagement to Princess Farah is official, the Valdias will be constructing a new residence to welcome and house his future bride. This is an opportunity to bring some Lenarutian culture to the mark, including tatami mats, cherry blossom trees, and perhaps even a special bathhouse!

Of course, the little lord’s got several more irons in the fire. Reid’s crafting local delicacies, mass-producing charcoal, revolutionizing shipping and logistics, and even making progress on a cure for his mother’s illness! While it sounds like a ridiculous workload for a young boy, the nonconventional prodigy is determined to secure a happy future for his family and the mark. Now that he has an even wider network of allies, Reid will use all the resources he has to tackle any obstacle that comes his way!

title: Reborn as an Aristocratic Scoundrel, I Broke the Game and Mastered Magic Beyond Limits!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

THE TEMPERATURE’S CLIMBING…AND THE CLOCK’S TICKING!

Living my next life in a magical academy game would’ve been exciting—except that I was reborn as Weiss Fancent, a doomed minor antagonist. To avoid Weiss’s original fate, I chose a specific strategy: Make sure I’m way too powerful for anyone to beat! Even during summer vacation, I keep drilling my swordplay and magic skills (not counting my time on the beach, of course). It’s not long before academy students will compete in the Noblesse Sword and Magic Cup, after all! After a summer of training and practice, I’m confident enough to challenge the academy’s smartest student. But have I honed my skills enough to beat her? Or will my summer of training just end in humiliation?!

title: Rebuild World
synopsis: Akira’s got a new mission from Sakashita. His target: Shirou! Armed with a brand new set of Front Line gear, Akira sets off to determine where the hacker’s allegiance lies—but he’ll have to find him first, as Shirou has run off with Udajima’s former collaborator, Haruka! Where are the duo headed, and what is their goal? Depending on the truth he uncovers, Akira might well find himself with Shirou’s blood on his hands! But first, he has to make a quick detour to an Old World Lion’s Tail facility with Reina and an unexpected guest—the very head of the Laurence family!

title: The Water Magician: Arc 2
synopsis:
Ryo is delighted to be reincarnated into the fantastical world of Phi, where he thinks he’ll get to live a quiet life learning to use his newfound water magic. Going with the flow here, however, means something very different. Ryo is immediately pitted against the wild lands he winds up in and the slew of deadly monsters that call the remote subcontinent home.

You’d think he’d forget about taking it easy when he’s stuck fighting for his life, but lucky for Ryo, he’s naturally optimistic, clever, and blessed with the hidden “Eternal Youth” trait. Twenty years pass in the blink of an eye, and each encounter along the way pushes him one step closer to the pinnacle of human magic. Little does he realize that’s only the opening chapter of his tale. A fateful meeting soon thrusts Ryo to the forefront of history, forever changing the course of his life...

Thus begins the adventures of the strongest water magician the world has ever seen—who also likes to do things at his own pace!

title: The Faceless Mercenary Wants to Settle Down: Homestead at the Edge of the Galaxy
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

THIS FORMER FIGHTER IS STILL “FIELDING” DANGER…

Onetime mercenary Glenn beat the odds and reinvented himself as a farmer! The women of his new planet are already noticing his agricultural appeal: Elyca and Lyla’s presence is proof enough of that. But when Myuzen shows up at the farm, her circumstances are unique—to put it mildly. Myuzen isn’t just hoping that farm life will be a good fit. She’s hoping that farm life will allow her to escape…

Meanwhile, Lyla’s shop is attracting quite a customer base. The word-of-mouth she’s helping the farm drum up doesn’t work entirely in its favor, though. The Pureblood Human Alliance’s Inspection Unit is sizing up the farm, and they’re not just looking to snag fresh produce or delicious preserves!

title: Goetia Shock
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

When famed Cyberdetective Alicia takes on her latest case, she’ll uncover an even bigger mystery that could change everything in this sci-fi action series.

Welcome to a world controlled by corporations, one that neuromancer Alicia Arkwright calls home. Hired to track down a missing father-daughter duo on a man-made island of artists, Alicia takes full advantage of her genius hacker skills to manipulate others’ cyber-brains and crack this case open. But Alicia’s about to realize solving this mystery might end up more trouble than it’s worth!

title: DUNGEON DIVE: Aim for the Deepest Level
synopsis:
After finally confessing his feelings, Kanami is able to become Lastiara’s boyfriend.
Joined by Maria and Reaper, the group heads for the mainland to settle the score with Nosfy. However, Nosfy is ready and waiting for them, and Kanami discovers that he’s now at a unique disadvantage.
Furthermore, at the local Adventurer’s Guild, they learn that a mysterious man skilled in Blood Magic is contaminating the World Tree, threatening the world at large. And yet only in accepting this quest can Kanami and the party move closer to their own goals.

title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
Wandmaker of the Ruined World
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

A global blackout forces one loner out of his comfort zone and right into the role of hero in this fantasy series!

When a global blackout wipes out electricity overnight, shut-in inventor Ori Kenshi finds his carefully isolated life in the mountains of Okutama turned upside down. A mechanical genius who prefers machines to people, Kenshi once made a quiet living crafting intricate devices and anime weapons from his workshop. But when a meteor crashes into his garden during the outage, he carves it into a wand just to pass the time—only to discover that the meteors which destroyed the world’s power grids have unleashed something else entirely: magic. As civilization collapses and chaos spreads, Kenshi’s handmade wand might be the key to a new kind of power. Now this reluctant loner must step beyond the safety of his workshop and use his unusual talents to survive in a world where technology is gone and magic has taken its place.

title: I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class
synopsis:
THE RUMOR MILL’S RUN AMOK!

Saito and Akane’s efforts to make their secret marriage stay under the radar of their classmates have been successful—until now. It seems the jig might be up, and an uproar begins to rise within the school for answers. What’s a couple to do? Akane casts her entrusted friend Himari to play the part of Saito’s new girlfriend to make the rumor mill die down once and for all.

The charade is a success, but things get complicated when the extended time together makes Himari and Saito see a side of each other they had never noticed before. Akane acts like all is well, but this new arrangement brings to light feelings that Akane has no choice but to finally confront.

title: Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized!
The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom
synopsis:
ANCIENT BLOODLINES, ANCIENT PLOTS

With her sister Mia happily married off and Prince Fernand on the throne of Girtonia, Philia’s world seems, at last, to be settling into a hard-won peace. But then a missive arrives from the pope, asking her to go to Erza’s aid! It seems a complicated family legacy has caught up with the exorcist, who has become a pawn in someone’s plot to undo the severing of Heaven from the Demon Realm. Philia races at once to help her dear friend—but the Pope isn’t sending her alone. Who is this mysterious sorcerer he has chosen to accompany her? And what do you mean, he’s been alive for over a thousand years?!

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court
synopsis:
THE TIES THAT BIND

With matters in the Kin domain taken care of, Kou Reirin and friends hit the road home. Concerned for Reirin’s deteriorating health, Shu Keigetsu puts off reversing the body swap by claiming to have exhausted her magic. Thankfully, Reirin has just the idea to help her friend “recover”: a detour to the Kou estate for a few days’ rest! During their visit, Keigetsu learns the truth about Reirin’s parents and her formative years—and why the Kou Maiden remains trapped in her mother’s shadow. Meanwhile, as the others make the most of their brief respite, Shin-u is haunted by memories of his troubled past…

title: My Girlfriend Cheated on Me, and Now My Flirty Underclassman Won't Leave Me Alone
synopsis:
LIMITED-TIME LOVERS

With Yuuta and Reina’s cheating scandal having finally been resolved, their relationship evolves into one of friendship. However, with the ground now clear for new love to blossom, the flirty underclassman, Shinohara Mayu, steps in with a proposal. Still unsure of what it really means to be in love, she asks Yuuta to be her boyfriend on a trial basis. But after having already settled into such a close friendship, will the two be able to see each other as something more?

title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
Classroom of the Elite: Year 3
Too Many Losing Heroines!
Reluctant Space Commander: From Death Wish to Galactic Hero!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

NO REST FOR THE WICKEDLY TALENTED

Nao’s crew has checked off their most recent to-do list: Space pirate trafficking operation? Shut down. Kidnapped children? Rescued. Corrupt nobles? Brought to justice! Now that’s all dealt with, surely they’ll get their much needed R and R, right?

Alas, nothing’s so easy for Nao and his crew. There’s no time for a break! He’s immediately promoted to squadron commander and put in charge of an assault on a pirate stronghold. There’s a silver lining, though—Nao may finally be granted his heroic death wish!

title: History of the Kingdom of Orcsen: How the Barbarian Orcish Nation Came to Burn Down the Peaceful Elfland
synopsis:
THE WAR WITH THE ELVES HAS FINALLY BEGUN

Despite being an orc, King Gustav is a ruler known for his benevolence, intelligence, and gentle nature—a result of being born into this world under rather peculiar circumstances.

The beautiful dark elf Dinerúth—a survivor of the genocidal purge in her homeland—has become one of Gustav’s loyal subjects…and important to him beyond that. With her support, Gustav launches a surprise attack on Elfland.

This sudden declaration of war should’ve given Orcsen an overwhelming advantage. But things aren’t turning out as expected…

title: I Like Villains, so I Reincarnated as One
synopsis:
OLD SCORES AND FAMILIAR FACES

With one die-hard fan now in the cockpit and living life as Weiss Hamilton, the video game villain’s tyrannical tendencies have become a thing of the past. Armed with game knowledge and a determination to change his favorite’s fate, he manages to reconcile with the game protagonist Cress, as well as drive off the Twelve Apostles lurking in the royal capital.

However, as the dust of his latest victory settles, Weiss is approached by Kaiser, a former suitor of Aigis Bloody. Kaiser tells Weiss he has come to deliver swift justice to an evil lord in the area—a lord who subjects his people to heavy taxation, binge drinks, and even appoints the head of a criminal organization, who disrespects the rule of law, to be his rep.

Weiss sympathizes, but cannot help but wonder: Who is this dastardly lord, and why does his backstory sound so familiar?

title: I'm Running for Crown Princess, but All I Want is a Steady Paycheck!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

LIVING PAYCHECK TO PAYCHECK

Training diligently to become a lady-in-waiting, Therese stays focused on the reason she came to the castle: cash flow. If she saves up the sums she envisions, maybe she and her technically-noble family can live more lavishly! But not everyone around Therese is as industrious as she is—nor do they all intend to help her pursue her goals. And even if Therese did get advice from her mother about navigating the castle, it’s still not clear that this fledging lady-in-waiting can look out for herself. After all, there’s another competition for a high-ranking role around the corner. If it’s as cutthroat as the last competition, can Therese come out unscathed yet again…?

title: Loner Life in Another World
synopsis:
A FLIGHT OF FANCY

A young demon girl is the latest addition to teenage loner Haruka’s cast of companions. The problem is, she may be a little too young. Escaping social scrutiny is now foremost on Haruka’s list of worries—a list that is growing longer by the minute! But when Haruka discovers the Elf Kingdom is poised on the brink of ruin, he springs into action. Step one: destroy the Merchant Kingdom. The Merchant Kingdom is accessible via ship, but if Haruka wants to carry on to the Elven Territory, he will have to go on foot. Or…via spontaneously crafted airship?! As Haruka plans his campaign, Omui is treated to a visit by a delegation of elves. One elf appears to descend from Japanese ancestry, much to Haruka’s delight. Time to whip out yet another costume made on the sly that is sure to turn heads!

title: The Devil Princess
synopsis:
THE SLEEPING DEMON STIRS

Yuzu Togaki’s memories of being a powerful demon may have finally come back to her, but she has more pressing matters at the moment like math homework and dealing with her friends at school. Still, Yuzu can’t help but try to make sense of the memories of the life she once lived and the knowledge of a mighty organization lurking in the shadows, trying to track down and slay a great evil.

Will Yuzu finally reawaken her true power before they discover her true identity, or will this reincarnation be short-lived?

title: The Most Notorious “Talker” Runs the World's Greatest Clan
synopsis: DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

title: The Tale of a Little Alchemist Blessed by the Spirits
synopsis:
THE TOWER’S TREASURE TROVE

Daisy and her friends have been working hard preparing to take down the mighty drake in the Sage’s Tower once and for all. And now, armed with the ultimate equipment crafted with Daisy’s Alchemy, Lynn’s blacksmithing skills, and the finest techniques of the capital’s master craftsmen, there’s no way they’re gonna lose this time!

But their rematch takes an unexpected turn. They stumble upon an Alchemy workshop left by a great Sage…and all the priceless grimoires inside it! With these precious tomes, Daisy and her friends’ adventures are sure to go to the next level!

title: The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash
synopsis:
ADVENTURER BOOT CAMP!

Ivy and her friends continue on their trash-collecting journey, now with three new adventurers in their party—well, rookie adventurers, anyway. Seeing how weak and naive their new companions are, Ivy can’t help but recall how she was once in their shoes, and so she and Druid decide to train up their new recruits. They visit a cave tame enough for novices and launch into some hands-on training, and even Ivy picks up a thing or two! But the real test of their skills is about to begin: an overnight stay in a cave. Can they make it through the night unscathed?!

title: The Suspects of Necromancy
synopsis:
In a crumbling kingdom, the art of necromancy is finding its return. Can a devoted knight find the master of the undead and stop them? A fantasy novel that will keep you on the edge of your seat!

Necromancy has returned to the kingdom of Rahma, and someone is wielding this terrifying forbidden art to shape the kingdom’s fate. Conrad, a young knight sworn to the crown, sets out to uncover the necromancer’s identity. His investigation leads him to a remote village and a mysterious girl named Luna—whose pale skin, golden hair, and crimson eyes set her apart from everyone around her. Is she the one commanding the dead? And could Luna somehow play a role in Rahma’s unraveling?

title: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
synopsis:
TROUBLE IN PARADISE

Despite all the misunderstandings and obstacles thrown in their path, Marie and Kyros are finally ready to tie the knot. But before they head down the aisle, Marie and Kyros decide to enjoy a romantic getaway in the land of everlasting summer, Lehav Island. There, they meet Kaede and Angelo from Mizuho, an island nation in the east. But after meeting the pair, Marie and Kyros soon find themselves faced new challenges they hadn’t anticipated!

title: She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man
Trapped in a Dating Sim: Otome Games Are Tough For Us, Too!
7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy!
Gear × Magic: Reincarnated as an Engineer, I'll Save the Villainous Princess
synopsis:
A SHOT AT GLORY

Since being reincarnated into the hit anime GEAR x MAGIC, Grimm has clawed his way up from humble beginnings to become the personal engineer of Princess Rouge—but he’s just getting started. In order to prevent the bad ending this story is destined for, Grimm works tirelessly as a mechanic to create a new system of GEAR. One day, he catches wind of a military-sponsored GEAR competition: TRYOUT.

Seeing this as the perfect opportunity to learn and strut his stuff, Grimm plunges into preparations for the competition. Meanwhile, the train Princess Rouge is riding on is suddenly attacked by a GEAR from anti-imperial rebel forces. Grimm and Princess Rouge quickly crush this foe, but wait…doesn’t this seem awful similar to the incident that set off the chain of events leading to the former protagonist’s downfall…?!

title: I Reincarnated as the “Villain” Commander of an Order of Knights
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

REDEMPTION POWERED BY BROTHERLY DETERMINATION

Justin might have escaped execution once, but his life as the reformed “villain” commander of a knight order refuses to calm down. When a new crisis threatens the realm, he sets out to find the mother of the baby dragon he accidentally contracted with—an assignment that should be simple, except trouble erupts in the capital the moment he leaves.

With the knights deployed far from home, strange incidents spread through the city, and whispers of the Great Demon’s revival begin to stir. Justin’s lingering reputation might put him in danger once again.

Armed with nothing but grit, luck, and the big‑brother instincts that once wrangled seven younger siblings, he charges into chaos once again in this hilarious continuation of his unlikely redemption.

title: Villager A Wants to Save the Villainess No Matter What!
synopsis:
DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE!

A SHORT-LIVED PEACE

It seems Allen’s schemes have been working out wonderfully for him so far. After all, he’s managed to go from a no-name NPC to the designated representative for the villainess Anastasia herself and defeat Prince Karl. Not only that, Aimee and the others have finally stopped causing him so much trouble and school life has become somewhat peaceful—but not for long. Because as Allen’s actions drive the game’s story further and further off course, it’s growing harder for him to predict what’s in store. And when Anastasia gets kidnapped, he’s going to have to pull every punch he’s got to get her back!

title: The Saint's Magic Power is Omnipotent
There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless… Even More Stories to Love!
synopsis:
IT’S ALL ABOUT RENAKO! UNLESS…

While Amaori Renako panics over maintaining her image as a cool, popular girl who absolutely did not only recently stop shutting herself up in her room, the world keeps on turning. Sena Ajisai runs for the student council, Hitoe Hanatori joins the girls at the pool, and Satsuki writes a fan letter to her favorite author. It’s No Freaking Way , but this time, Renako’s sharing the spotlight!
